programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc:
Pain is a fact of life. For many, it is excruciating and inescapable, a truly disruptive force. But amid the continuing fallout of the global opioid crisis, new technologies are being developed every day to limit and potentially even eliminate pain.
Professor Hannah Fry learns about the future of pain management and how revolutionary technologies are being developed to directly control pain signals. She talks to the scientists behind these technologies about how this unprecedented breakthrough works, as well as meeting pain research participants themselves in order to understand the life-changing implications of such research. Along the way, she considers how society views pain and what a pain-free future would truly mean for humanity.

Raised by Santa's helpers at the North Pole, human infant Buddy matures into a strapping adult and outgrows his cramped surroundings. His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

programme.title: Nativity!
programme.desc: Comedy starring Martin Freeman. Despite being traumatised by a bad review years earlier, primary school teacher Paul Maddens is tasked with directing the annual Nativity play. Taunted by a teacher from a rival school, Paul foolishly promises that an old flame, now a Hollywood producer, is coming to see his production.

programme.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy starring Jim Carrey. It's Christmas in Whoville and preparations are well under way. Meanwhile, up in his mountain lair, cold-hearted hermit the Grinch sits alone resenting the Whovians' happiness. But then he's befriended by a little girl.

programme.title: Scrooged
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy, starring Bill Murray, Karen Allen and featuring Robert Mitchum. Frank Cross, the youngest network president in television history, is a man who hates Christmas and plans to exploit the holidays to attract as many viewers as possible, no matter what it takes. However, Frank is about to be visited by three unconventional ghosts who will go to any lengths to make him change his mean-spirited ways.

programme.title: Love Actually
programme.desc: Ensemble romantic comedy featuring Hugh Grant, Emma Thompson, Alan Rickman, Keira Knightley and Bill Nighy. In London, during the weeks leading up to Christmas, people from various walks of life - among them adult film performers, a washed-up rock star and the British Prime Minister - suffer the emotional highs and lows of being in love.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson and Donnie Yen. After years in exile, agent Xander Cage is brought back into action when a potentially lethal space weapon falls into the wrong hands.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Britt Robertson and Dennis Quaid, and featuring the voice of Josh Gad. Young Ethan is devastated when his dog and best friend Bailey dies. But Bailey knows that it's not only cats that have nine lives.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Kung fu prodigy Li Fong moves to New York City with his mother and befriends his classmate, Mia. But Connor Day, a local karate champion, provokes Li and publicly humiliates him. Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio

programme.title: Smallfoot
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy featuring the voices of Channing Tatum and James Corden. Migo lives with his fellow yetis in the Himalayas, where they have no contact with the outside world. When he meets and befriends a human wildlife expert, Migo realises he has some harsh truths to learn about the reason for the yetis' isolation.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez. Count Dracula is the gracious host at his daughter's 118th birthday party, which he's throwing at his own "five stake" resort for monsters. But he's less welcoming of a mortal backpacker who takes a shine to his precious girl.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Animated horror comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Things have settled down at Dracula's hotel now that humans are allowed to stay. However, the Count can't help but worry that his half-human, half-vampire grandson Dennis isn't proving to be a chip off the old vampire block. So while Johnny and Mavis are away, Drac and his monster buddies decide to put Dennis through his paces.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Exhausted from running the hotel, Count Dracula heads off on a sea cruise with the family. Romance beckons in the form of the ship's mysterious captain - but she is hiding a deadly secret that could spell disaster for the monsters.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Emma Thompson and Colin Firth. Victorian England: following their mother's death, the seven Brown children have become completely uncontrollable. Seventeen nannies have come and gone and their poor father is at his wits' end. But then salvation appears in the form of the legendary Nanny McPhee, a stern and comically ugly woman who mysteriously appears on their doorstep armed with a magic stick.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee and the Big Bang
programme.desc: Period fantasy adventure starring Emma Thompson and Maggie Gyllenhaal. With her husband away at war and the potential loss of her farm to worry about, Mrs Green is struggling to keep order among her three children and their evacuee cousins. But then magical Nanny McPhee arrives to dish out her special kind of discipline.

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy fantasy starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty and Eric Idle. A wicked heiress hires Dr Harvey, a specialist on ghosts, to rid the haunted house she has inherited of its unwanted inhabitants. But Casper, the nice nephew of nasty ghosts Stretch, Stinkie and Fatso, strikes up a friendship with the doctor's daughter.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone. Mercenary Barney Ross decides to retire his ageing band of cohorts and replace them with younger models for a mission to capture a ruthless adversary from his past. But when things get sticky, help comes from an unlikely direction.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Monster horror starring Matthew Broderick and Jean Reno. When a Japanese vessel is sunk in the South Pacific and enormous footprints are discovered in Panama, a team of scientists is brought in to investigate. But radiation expert Niko Tatopoulos has his own theory - nuclear bomb tests have mutated a lizard to gigantic proportions and Manhattan is now under threat.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Superheroes
programme.desc: Never fear, your heroes are here! Join us as we soar into the action-packed worlds of our favourite superheroes, from Superman and Wonder Woman to Hulk and Madame Web.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the 1969 British caper movie, starring Mark Wahlberg and Edward Norton. A criminal gang run by Charlie Croker (Wahlberg) and veteran thief John Bridger (Donald Sutherland) pulls off an audacious gold bullion robbery in Venice, only for colleague Steve (Edward Norton) to run off with the loot, leaving Bridger dead. Finally tracking Steve down to LA, Croker enlists the help of Bridger's safecracking daughter Stella (Charlize Theron) to get even in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, Dwayne Johnson and Jason Statham. When it becomes apparent that someone out for revenge is picking off members of his crew one by one, Dominic Toretto decides the gang should get back together. But no sooner have they reassembled than they're co-opted by a shadowy agency figure, who needs the team's special skills to help steal a surveillance device known as God's Eye.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 8
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Vin Diesel, Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham and Charlize Theron. The whole team have dispersed to live quieter lives. But with Dom seemingly seduced into a life of techno terrorism by the mysterious Cipher, it looks like the opportunity to put their feet up will have to wait.

programme.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham and Idris Elba. Bickering agents Luke Hobbs and Deckard Shaw are paired up to track down a deadly supervirus that has been stolen by terrorist Brixton Lore. But Lore is no ordinary villain - he has been implanted with cybernetic technology that gives him superhuman strength.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Rebirth
programme.desc: Profit-hungry pharmaceutical representative Martin Krebs contracts covert operations specialist Zora Bennett to assemble a crack team to infiltrate a forbidden island and collect the DNA of three key dinosaur species. Fantasy adventure, starring Scarlett Johansson, Mahershala Ali and Jonathan Bailey

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Andrew Garfield and Emma Stone. Peter Parker's parents disappeared when he was young, and he has been raised by his uncle and aunt. But he is socially awkward and bullied at high school. When a bite from a genetically modified spider gives Peter extraordinary powers, he is not only able to assert himself at school, but also resolves to use them to fight evil.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Jamie Foxx. Peter Parker just wants to hang out with his girlfriend but is burdened with having to save New York from a new electrically-charged enemy. Also lurking in the shadows is his increasingly embittered and volatile old friend Harry Osborn.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's crime drama, starring Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta and Joe Pesci. In 1950s New York, Irish-Italian schoolboy Henry Hill dreams of becoming a gangster and lands a job parking cars for the Mob. Having earned the respect of the local Mafia boss, he is teamed with hitmen James Conway and Tommy DeVito. But as the years pass, Hill finds his allegiance to the Mob challenged as he descends deeper into organised crime.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic adventure thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw and Richard Dreyfuss. The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Sequel to Steven Spielberg's blockbuster, starring Roy Scheider as police chief Martin Brody, who fears that a great white shark is once again threatening the holiday resort of Amity. But with the summer season under way, Brody has a tough job convincing Amity's business community of the danger.

programme.title: Jaws 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dennis Quaid and Louis Gossett Jr. Sheriff Brody's sons are working at a new marine park, where a captive infant great white shark is being groomed as the centre's latest tourist attraction. However, no one has reckoned on the creature's vengeful mother.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Action comedy thriller starring Martin Lawrence and Will Smith. Two chalk-and-cheese Miami drugs squad detectives - one a wise-cracking, Porsche-driving ladies' man, the other married with a family - are assigned to track down a missing $100-million shipment of heroin.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford and Karen Allen. Indiana Jones's outrageous exploits take him around the world in search of the legendary Ark of the Covenant, a religious artefact of unspeakable power wanted by the Nazis. With the help of an old flame, Indy takes on his enemies in a terrifying and death-defying battle to the finish.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure sequel with Jack Black as the voice of martial arts master Po. In order to stop the plot of evil peacock Lord Shen, Po must embark on a journey to discover the truth about his childhood.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Danny has always played second fiddle to his wise-cracking pal, Bernie. So after his mate starts dating Joan, Danny falls for her friend, Debbie, and following a one-night stand, Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Remake of the 1986 romantic comedy, starring Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall and Joy Bryant

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On the day north London slacker Shaun decides to sort his life out, the dead rise and the city becomes overrun with zombies. Can Shaun and best mate Ed fight off the marauding hordes of the undead and win back Shaun's girlfriend? Or will they just go down the pub?

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. London policeman Nicholas Angel is reassigned to a sleepy rural village, but soon finds that the big city doesn't have a monopoly on crime.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On their much anticipated road trip to America's notorious Area 51, two sci-fi geeks find themselves in the company of a real-life extraterrestrial who needs their help.

programme.title: Dumb and Dumber
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey and Jeff Daniels. When limousine driver Lloyd Christmas gets the sack, he persuades his roommate Harry Dunne to drive him to Aspen in pursuit of an attractive woman passenger who left a briefcase behind. The daft duo embark on a variety of adventures before discovering the briefcase is full of dollar bills.

programme.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
programme.desc: Prequel to the Jim Carrey/Jeff Daniels comedy Dumb and Dumber, starring Eric Christian Olsen and Derek Richardson. Dumbo duo Lloyd and Harry meet in their teens and inadvertently foil a fund-embezzling plot by their high-school principal.

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Comedy caper directed by Steven Soderbergh, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver and Daniel Craig. Two down-on-their-luck brothers decide to rob the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. In order to pull off the job, they need the help of explosives expert Joe Bang - but first they must break him out of prison.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: Two rivals fight for control of a major crime family. Director Barry Levinson's drama based on true events, starring Robert De Niro, Cosmo Jarvis and Debra Messing

programme.title: King Ivory
programme.desc: Tulsa narcotics cop Layne West is locked in a battle with the city's criminal underworld. When his son becomes addicted to fentanyl, West teams up with his partner Ty and FBI agent Beatty to bring down those responsible. Thriller, starring James Badge Dale and Ben Foster

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring John Boyega. During the US summer riots of 1967, a gang of police officers raid Detroit's Algiers Motel and proceed to terrorise its mostly Black residents.

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
programme.desc: Romantic action comedy starring Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on Dan Brown's forerunner to The Da Vinci Code, starring Tom Hanks and Ayelet Zurer. With the election of a new pope imminent, the Illuminati kidnap the four leading contenders and issue a coded message that they will murder the men and blow up the Vatican. Catholic leaders turn to Harvard symbolist Robert Langdon, who must put his uneasy relationship with the church hierarchy aside in an effort to crack the code and save the men's lives.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestseller by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Felicity Jones. Renowned symbologist Dr Robert Langdon wakes up in a Florence hospital with a head injury and no memory of the previous 48 hours. However, he soon finds himself hunted and forced to undertake a globe-trotting race against time to prevent the release of a deadly virus capable of killing half the world's population.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Crime thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, and starring Jason Statham and Ray Liotta. Jake Green leaves prison determined to avenge the murder of his sister-in-law by men working for ruthless casino boss Dorothy Macha, the person also responsible for his incarceration. But after a confrontation at Macha's club, Green becomes a target for the villain's henchmen.

programme.title: Erin Brockovich
programme.desc: Oscar-winning biographical drama starring Julia Roberts. When she loses a lawsuit following a car accident, unemployed single mother Erin Brockovich browbeats her lawyer, Ed Masry, into giving her a job. Soon she discovers that a power company has been dumping toxic waste and poisoning the residents of a small town. Masry's firm takes up the case - making Brockovich the unlikely linchpin in one of corporate America's biggest ever lawsuits.

programme.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
programme.desc: New York bachelor David is due to drive to his friend's wedding, but a wheel clamp on his vehicle derails those plans. He acquires a new drive from the mysterious Car Rental Company managed by two nameless agents, who are oddly familiar with his dating history. At the wedding, David meets fellow singleton Sarah and squanders an opportunity to dance with her. On the way home, the rental car's GPS asks him if he would like to embark on a big bold beautiful journey. When David agrees, the virtual assistant guides him to Sarah and they follow a winding route between physical doors that open into episodes from their respective pasts. Romantic drama, starring Colin Farrell and Margot Robbie

programme.title: Plainclothes
programme.desc: An undercover agent assigned to lure and arrest gay men defies orders when he falls for a target. Writer/director Carmen Emmi's thriller, starring Tom Blyth, Russell Tovey and Maria Dizzia

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Don't Let's Go to the Dogs Tonight
programme.desc: An eight-year-old girl experiences life on her family's Rhodesian farm during the final stages of the Bush War. Drama, written, directed by and starring Embeth Davidtz, with Lexi Ventner and Zikhona Bali

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Will Smith and featuring Jaden Smith. After his wife walks out, downtrodden medical salesman Chris Gardner is left to bring up his five-year-old son alone. The situation worsens when the pair are made homeless, but Gardner refuses to be beaten. Gaining a prestigious though unpaid stockbroker internship, he doggedly chases his dream of a better life.

programme.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey

When David agrees, the virtual assistant guides him to Sarah and they follow a winding route between physical doors that open into episodes from their respective pasts. Romantic drama, starring Colin Farrell and Margot Robbie

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Biographical drama charting the meteoric rise, dramatic fall and remarkable resurgence of British pop icon, Robbie Williams

programme.desc: Oscar-winning biographical drama starring Julia Roberts. Soon she discovers that a power company has been dumping toxic waste and poisoning the residents of a small town. Masry's firm takes up the case - making Brockovich the unlikely linchpin in one of corporate America's biggest ever lawsuits.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story starring Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba and Kevin Costner. Following a career-ending injury, skier Molly Bloom makes ends meet as a waitress. Abandoned by Nato peacekeepers, who believe a rescue mission would threaten the fragile ceasefire, Burnett's only hope is a determined commanding officer who refuses to desert a comrade.

The fly tells them that there are things even smaller than him, and so Duggee teaches them that some things are so small that you can't even see them - atoms. Combined, these make molecules, which in turn join to make cells, the fabric that makes up every living thing.
The Squirrels discover that things can be wide, long, thin or small, and that these attributes make up all sorts of different sizes. To help understand this, they assign a line-up all the way from a small piece of dust to a huge rocket ship.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc:
Love Monster goes about his morning routine of making breakfast, but nothing goes right for him - he stubs his toe, spills his cereal, runs out of milk and his toaster malfunctions. On the radio, Elder Kitten announces that today is Super-Fun Day, a day where Fluffytowners are encouraged to have their most-super-fun-day ever. Love Monster grumbles to himself that Super-Fun Day is not super-fun so far.
He heads out to see Book Cub, and along the way he sees Bad Idea Puppy having super-fun on his skateboard. Love Monster arrives at Book Cub's van and tells her that his super-fun day hasn't even been a little bit fun yet, and she suggests that he practices yoga with her. Love Monster gives it a go but falls over. Not fun. Book Cub gives Love Monster her fun magnet - a device that points Love Monster in the direction of fun. The fun magnet leads Love Monster to the roller disco, where Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny is having super-fun and encourages him to try it. Love Monster joins in and has fun to start with but soon loses control and falls over again.
Next, the fun magnet leads him to Bad Idea Puppy, who is having super-fun racing his box car down a hill and invites Love Monster to join him in a race. Love Monster agrees and it looks like he's beginning to have super-fun, but then his box car falls apart. This wasn't super-fun either! Finally, the fun magnet leads Love Monster to the empty bouncy castle. Love Monster is confused and looks around - this doesn't look like super-fun because no one else is here. Just then, Book Cub, Bad Idea Puppy and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny arrive.
Book Cub asks him how the fun-magnet is working, and Love Monster sighs that it's not going very well. His friends are confused as they all thought Love Monster was having fun with them. Love Monster says he was having fun, but nothing seemed super-fun because he was thinking of all the things that went wrong. That makes him realise that he could have been thinking about all the things that went right - like hanging out with his friends all day! Book Cub suggests that they all go on the bouncy castle together, and Love Monster agrees because every day is super-fun with his friends!

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tron tuilleadh cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin a' chànan, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba 's e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy will support us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work, communication and people skills.
We meet diligent speakers who have embraced the language, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Richie Anderson helps Rich and Jade swap Australia for rural North Yorkshire, with a grown-up daughter and two dogs and two cats in tow. He also visits a local farm shop

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals

The hopefuls then demonstrate their pastry knowledge as they serve up dessert

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Family team Kathryn, Rab, Francis and Jane compete for money by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Edith Bowman takes Colin Murray on a food adventure in her home town of Anstruther. As well as its famous fish and chips, they discover how artisan bread is being made for the community. Briony May Williams bags bargains hunting for yellow stickers in the supermarket, Suzie Lee reveals how Greek-style yoghurt is made in Co Down and Onkar Singh Purewal discovers Swansea's community garden produce

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's Scottish coastal railway journey reaches Invergordon on the Cromarty Firth, the third great inlet on the northeast coast of the Highlands. He arrives on Britain's northernmost railway, the Far North Line, and heads straight onto the water to explore a former oil drilling rig now moored in the firth

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: The crew of the scalloper Golden Promise pushes Force 6 winds to reach newly opening scallops beds ahead of their rivals. With the boat first to the grounds, they are in for a big pay day - but only once they cover the £8,000 fuel expenses to get here. Family owned trawler Adenia hunts for 1,000 tons of mackerel to sell to the lucrative Asian sushi market, and skipper Ivan Toms and son Rhys fish Cornwall's inshore waters in Maxine's Pride, one of the oldest trawlers in UK waters. Can they catch enough to give themselves a wage and put money aside for repairs?

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents a compilation of items presented for the experts' scrutiny around the country. Objects include an Edward VIII coronation souvenir that was hastily converted into an abdication memento, as well as art deco ware and one of Elton John's earliest fan letters

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The team visits De Montfort Hall, Leicestershire, where experts Catherine Southon and Claire Rawle scour the displays for the best goods to take to auction. Presenter Paul Martin finds out how BBC local radio was born in Leicester

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor presents a guide through all the backstage ballroom action with the week's Pro Panel. Also, there's a look at how the couples are getting ready for Blackpool

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul Bob head to Co Durham to fish for a rare species of wild brown trout in the River Tees. They navigate the area through the lens of a six-year-old Bob as he takes Paul on a trip along the landscapes of his youth and reminisces about the fishing trips he used to go on with his. Later, their old friend Reece Shearsmith joins them for dinner, and he has some particularly spooky local tales to tell them about the Tees

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc:
Pain is a fact of life. For many, it is excruciating and inescapable, a truly disruptive force. But amid the continuing fallout of the global opioid crisis, new technologies are being developed every day to limit and potentially even eliminate pain.
Professor Hannah Fry learns about the future of pain management and how revolutionary technologies are being developed to directly control pain signals. She talks to the scientists behind these technologies about how this unprecedented breakthrough works, as well as meeting pain research participants themselves in order to understand the life-changing implications of such research. Along the way, she considers how society views pain and what a pain-free future would truly mean for humanity.

programme.title: Rollercoaster: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programme.desc: Hannah Fry gets the inside story on the UK's newest, tallest and fastest rollercoaster, Thorpe Park's Hyperia, as she uncovers the origins of the modern-day thrill ride. She finds out how dodgy French physics from the 19th century, Nasa rocket scientists and an ambitious cartoonist called Walt delivered the ultimate ride

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Shoemaker Dean Westmoreland and plastics expert Charlotte Abbott team up to restore a pair of motorcycle racing goggles with a rich history, Tim Gunn fixes a 1950s butcher's bike and Will Kirk repairs a toy boat hand-made by a devoted father. Art conservator Lucia Scalisi sets out to revive a mysterious painting found in the attic of a family farmhouse in Wales

programme.title: Murder Case: Fire in the Suburbs
programme.desc: Part one of two. A family home in an affluent suburb of Glasgow is deliberately set on fire and 23-year-old university student Cameron Logan dies as a result of the blaze. Detectives race to determine who targeted the property and why, with the team beginning to meticulously piece together the evidence from the scene and build a picture of the events of that night. With no obvious motive, detectives must follow every lead as they try to understand what really happened inside this family home

programme.title: QI
programme.desc: A selection of the best moments from the T series, hosted by Sandi Toksvig with regular panellist Alan Davies joined by guest contestants

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events, with Victoria Derbyshire

programme.title: Unspun World with John Simpson
programme.desc: The BBC's world affairs editor reflects on the week's major global news stories, talking to local experts from around the world to go behind the headlines

programme.title: New York, New York
programme.desc: Musical drama directed by Martin Scorsese, starring Robert De Niro and Liza Minnelli. In 1945, at a New York VJ Day ball, jazz saxophonist Jimmy Doyle engineers a meeting with singer Francine Evans with whom he auditions for the Palm Club's big band the following day. They are hired as a duo and begin a volatile relationship that develops against a background of changing musical trends.

programme.title: Autumnwatch: Autumn Calm
programme.desc: A welcome return for an audience favourite - Autumnwatch's Mindfulness Moments. This is an opportunity to switch off from the stresses of our busy lives and immerse ourselves in pure nature. No music, no presenter voice-over, just natural sound and glorious pictures to take us to the most stunning places in this most colourful of seasons

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's Scottish coastal railway journey reaches Invergordon on the Cromarty Firth, the third great inlet on the northeast coast of the Highlands. He arrives on Britain's northernmost railway, the Far North Line, and heads straight onto the water to explore a former oil drilling rig now moored in the firth

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: The crew of the scalloper Golden Promise pushes Force 6 winds to reach newly opening scallops beds ahead of their rivals. With the boat first to the grounds, they are in for a big pay day - but only once they cover the £8,000 fuel expenses to get here. Family owned trawler Adenia hunts for 1,000 tons of mackerel to sell to the lucrative Asian sushi market, and skipper Ivan Toms and son Rhys fish Cornwall's inshore waters in Maxine's Pride, one of the oldest trawlers in UK waters. Can they catch enough to give themselves a wage and put money aside for repairs?

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents a compilation of items presented for the experts' scrutiny around the country. Objects include an Edward VIII coronation souvenir that was hastily converted into an abdication memento, as well as art deco ware and one of Elton John's earliest fan letters

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The team visits De Montfort Hall, Leicestershire, where experts Catherine Southon and Claire Rawle scour the displays for the best goods to take to auction. Presenter Paul Martin finds out how BBC local radio was born in Leicester

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor presents a guide through all the backstage ballroom action with the week's Pro Panel. Also, there's a look at how the couples are getting ready for Blackpool

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul Bob head to Co Durham to fish for a rare species of wild brown trout in the River Tees. They navigate the area through the lens of a six-year-old Bob as he takes Paul on a trip along the landscapes of his youth and reminisces about the fishing trips he used to go on with his. Later, their old friend Reece Shearsmith joins them for dinner, and he has some particularly spooky local tales to tell them about the Tees

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc:
Pain is a fact of life. For many, it is excruciating and inescapable, a truly disruptive force. But amid the continuing fallout of the global opioid crisis, new technologies are being developed every day to limit and potentially even eliminate pain.
Professor Hannah Fry learns about the future of pain management and how revolutionary technologies are being developed to directly control pain signals. She talks to the scientists behind these technologies about how this unprecedented breakthrough works, as well as meeting pain research participants themselves in order to understand the life-changing implications of such research. Along the way, she considers how society views pain and what a pain-free future would truly mean for humanity.

programme.title: Rollercoaster: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programme.desc: Hannah Fry gets the inside story on the UK's newest, tallest and fastest rollercoaster, Thorpe Park's Hyperia, as she uncovers the origins of the modern-day thrill ride. She finds out how dodgy French physics from the 19th century, Nasa rocket scientists and an ambitious cartoonist called Walt delivered the ultimate ride

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Shoemaker Dean Westmoreland and plastics expert Charlotte Abbott team up to restore a pair of motorcycle racing goggles with a rich history, Tim Gunn fixes a 1950s butcher's bike and Will Kirk repairs a toy boat hand-made by a devoted father. Art conservator Lucia Scalisi sets out to revive a mysterious painting found in the attic of a family farmhouse in Wales

programme.title: Murder Case: Fire in the Suburbs
programme.desc: Part one of two. A family home in an affluent suburb of Glasgow is deliberately set on fire and 23-year-old university student Cameron Logan dies as a result of the blaze. Detectives race to determine who targeted the property and why, with the team beginning to meticulously piece together the evidence from the scene and build a picture of the events of that night. With no obvious motive, detectives must follow every lead as they try to understand what really happened inside this family home

programme.title: QI
programme.desc: A selection of the best moments from the T series, hosted by Sandi Toksvig with regular panellist Alan Davies joined by guest contestants

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events, with Victoria Derbyshire

programme.title: Unspun World with John Simpson
programme.desc: The BBC's world affairs editor reflects on the week's major global news stories, talking to local experts from around the world to go behind the headlines

programme.title: New York, New York
programme.desc: Musical drama directed by Martin Scorsese, starring Robert De Niro and Liza Minnelli. In 1945, at a New York VJ Day ball, jazz saxophonist Jimmy Doyle engineers a meeting with singer Francine Evans with whom he auditions for the Palm Club's big band the following day. They are hired as a duo and begin a volatile relationship that develops against a background of changing musical trends.

programme.desc: Until six months ago, the Banken family were homeless. programme.title: Doorbell Detectives

programme.title: New York, New York
programme.desc: Musical drama directed by Martin Scorsese, starring Robert De Niro and Liza Minnelli. In 1945, at a New York VJ Day ball, jazz saxophonist Jimmy Doyle engineers a meeting with singer Francine Evans with whom he auditions for the Palm Club's big band the following day. They are hired as a duo and begin a volatile relationship that develops against a background of changing musical trends.

programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: Exploring wellbeing and what it means to live a healthy, balanced life. Presenter Marios Costi shares practical advice on reducing stress, finding calm and making positive changes, while meeting deaf people who are breaking down barriers, building confidence and pursuing their dreams. With Avril Langard-Tang, a senior lecturer at the University of Wolverhampton

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk meets Hollywood legends and interrogates the writer of Die Hard as she starts her quest deep into cinema. Along the way she interviews film-makers, actors and critics, and finally discovers the true meaning of The Wizard of Oz. Diane Morgan stars

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva heads to Domaine Dujac, home of the current most-wanted Burgundy wine. Burgundy's rich soil and savoir faire are parents to many culinary classics. At a local winery, Eva tucks into beef cheeks bathed in Domaine Dujac for a classic boeuf bourguignon lunch

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Two rookie renovators take on projects in County Durham and Derby, while a more seasoned developer has his work cut out at a bungalow in East Sussex. Presented by Martel Maxwell, Jacqui Joseph and Dion Dublin

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: Siobhan, her partner Timmie and their two young children hope to bring new life in Butlerstown, Co Cork, by renovating the old post office to become their forever home

programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: A BBC Children in Need edition celebrating deaf children and families, with inspiring stories, a fun lip-reading challenge and the power of community

programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Friends and family members Frankie, James, Susanne and Jason compete for money by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Colin Murray and Edith Bowman explore St George's Market in Belfast and meet a social media sensation who reveals the secrets of healthy and inexpensive one-pot meals. Farmer Jim Smith discovers how one farm is turning its oats into milk, and food journalist Leyla Kazim is in Norfolk to find out the secrets of producing mustard, while farmer Meinir Howells reveals just why Welsh lamb is so popular

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: The latest stage of Michael Portillo's trek takes him past lochs and castles on the Far North Line to Britain's northernmost railway station at Thurso. From Lairg on the banks of Loch Shin, Michael heads for a secret conservation area in the 18-mile-long loch to track down one of Scotland's most elusive and endangered species, the freshwater pearl mussel

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: The crew of Karen of Ladram hunts hake off Cornwall, but the trip is thrown into jeopardy when a crew member's health deteriorates and their catch is decimated when seals get to the fish first. Elsewhere, a rookie crew works in the Irish Sea, trainee skipper Michael steps up in a storm, and Tydus heads out in search of crabs

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit Lancaster to value more objects and rarities brought in by the public. Items include an expensive pair of clogs, an emotional series of letters written during the Crimean War, an anti-slavery ring and an intricately woven tapestry thought to be worth £10,000. First shown in 2005

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and the team value antiques in Longleat, Wiltshire, where experts Claire Rawle and Michael Baggott pick out a selection of interesting collectibles to be sold at auction, including an amethyst and pearl brooch and an autograph album featuring a set of Beatles' signatures - but their authenticity keeps the experts guessing. The presenter also uncovers the hidden architectural gems of one of Wiltshire's most famous sons, Christopher Wren, during a trip to London

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: The penultimate round of challenges for Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding. Michael Sheen asks the questions

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Weekday fanzine devoted to the ballroom dancing show, featuring updates on the contestants and footage of rehearsals

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Sonali Shah showcases some Somerset properties to a couple who have a budget of £700,000 and want a countryside home where they can upgrade an allotment to their very own back garden veggie patch. Sonali also learns about the potentially perilous Bristol Channel and meets the volunteers who operate two life-saving rescue hovercrafts

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Police investigate the disappearance of a young monk from a monastery on a remote private island in Orkney and the mystery deepens when there appears to be no evidence of how he could have left the island. In Aviemore, a rock festival erupts into violence, while campers in Fort William take a wrong turn and officers are on the hunt for a suspect after a woman is attacked in an Inverness cemetery

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: Marco Pierre White, Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal reunite for the first time in decades, revisiting the rivalries and rows that shaped their careers. Each serves an iconic dish for the others to taste as they reflect on British dining's transformation and whether wounds can heal-or competition defines them

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk interrogates some of the world's foremost filmmakers and critics, discovers an age of screen icons from Marilyn Monroe to Wayne John, and learns how Hollywood movies changed as American social values relaxed. She also gives her verdict on classics like Jaws, Taxi Driver, and Citizen Ken - very much the 'Citizen Kane' of films about people called Ken. Comedy, starring Diane Morgan

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events with Paddy O'Connell

programme.title: Past Lives
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Greta Lee and Teo Yoo. Young South Korean friends Nora and Hae Sung lose touch when Nora's family moves to Canada. Years later, Nora is living in New York and gets in contact with Hae Sung over the internet. Video calls become an important part of their lives, until communication is again lost. Twelve years on, Hae Sung takes a trip to the States and the pair are reunited, but will their childhood connection still be strong?

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Alison Hammond and Noel Fielding present as the semi-finalists take on patisserie week, serving up three precision pastries before judges Nigella Lawson and Paul Hollywood decide who deserves to go through to next week's final

programme.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: Gordon travels to Greenville, Mississippi, to save fine dining establishment Sherman's Restaurant, which has been a presence in the town for 30 years. The chef and his team have just 24 hours to revamp the premises, clean and renovate the kitchen and introduce a new menu featuring update versions of the restaurant's staple dishes, working around the clock to teach the staff how to prepare them

programme.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay is in Los Angeles, where he tries to bring family-owned Mexican restaurant La Serenata back from the brink of disaster. The chef and his team have just 24 hours to update the interior and introduce a more dynamic menu with dishes that give a fresh spin to classic Mexican cuisine. But what will the customers think of the changes?

programme.title: Hitler's DNA: Blueprint of a Dictator
programme.desc: Part two of two. The team discover that Hitler may have had a genetic mutation that causes a medical condition called Kallmann Syndrome, which disrupts the development of sex organs. Turi King and the team make several extraordinary genetic discoveries concerning Hitler's high likelihood of suffering from schizophrenia and bipolar disorder

programme.title: Grand Designs
programme.desc: Kevin McCloud meets entrepreneur Paul Wilkinson and his wife Amy, who are building a giant new home on a 16-acre plot in Lincolnshire. The superstructure will be comprised of five circular buildings made up of interlocking timber cylinders, linked by raised wooden walkways that hang over a fishing lake. The complicated build proves difficult for Paul's local team, and their ambitious schedule of completing the project in a year soon looks out of reach

programme.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
programme.desc: The architect meets a couple who are creating a disappearing bathroom and a man squeezing a camper into a Reliant Robin

Tiree is one of the stormiest places in Europe, but is also one of the best places in Britain to surf and practise the relatively new sport of sand yachting, the racing of go-carts with a sail along the beach

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Wild Cameramen at Work
programme.desc: Five of the best wildlife cameramen in the world reflect on their favourite natural history moments from their global careers and reveal how Scotland has helped them hone their skills. Narrated by David Attenborough, the documentary begins by revealing the hardships and hazards involved when filming wildlife in the world's most extreme environments - the Arctic and Antarctic. Renowned polar cameraman and diver Doug Allan recalls some of his most hair-raising encounters and returns to the place where his underwater career began - the freezing depths of a Highland river

programme.title: Craft Christmas at Beechgrove
programme.desc: Jean Johansson presents a programme helping people get ready for Christmas with advice on festive crafts, gifts and baking, beginning with how to light and decorate the tree. Carole Baxter has tips on the garden jobs to be done right now

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: In a special edition from North Sutherland, Dougie Vipond steps out into a vast expanse of blanket peat bog known as the Flow Country, charting the changes in its land use and its recent designation as a Unesco world heritage site. Arlene Stuart catches up with Joyce Campbell to see how she has made the switch from traditional hill farming to regenerative agriculture, and Leanna Fernandez meets biologists working to protect precious sea trout populations at Loch Hope

programme.title: Hamza's Hidden Wild Isles
programme.desc: Hamza Yassin reveals hidden wildlife gems to be found in winter, travelling from the frozen Highlands of Scotland down to the quiet suburbs of Sussex. He goes in search of a bird that turns white to blend in with the snow and wild boars that have returned to Britain's forests for the first time in 700 years, and climbs a three-metre-tall scaffold tower to get footage of wild tawny owls

programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: The Chief tackles a new crime initiative with the help of rugby hero Gavin Hastings, but makes a fool of himself in front of the watching media. Acting Sgt Ken Beattie steps in to blitz out a bad smell threatening to stink out Cassandra's blossoming romance, and detectives Megan and Andrea act on a hot tip down the pub, and urban cops Jack and Sarah blow the cover of a police pal on the streets

programme.title: The Chief
programme.desc: Actor Dougray Scott (playing himself) is recruited to record the audiobook of Chief Commissioner Cameron Miekelson's autobiography and is soon being coached on his performance. Will a tight deadline and the crime-fighting needs of a nation prevent the Chief achieving lyrical literary perfection? Comedy, starring Jack Docherty

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Discussion on Scotland's biggest news stories, with analysis from journalists, commentators and guests

programme.title: Trick Pony Club
programme.desc: Documentary following Scotland's stunt horse team, whose members travel the UK performing exhilarating stunt shows jousting knights on horseback and appearing as gun-slinging acrobatic cowboys. Lances and swords, trick guns and period costumes are all staples for the team. Based on a farm just outside Jedburgh in the Scottish Borders, they divulge the secret to skilled stunt choreography and show-stopping performances. Some of the younger stunt riders are involved in common riding, an annual event in the towns of the Borders where hundreds of locals gather together for a horseback ride

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
programme.desc: A freelance reporter returns to Chicago for the holidays and is assigned to profile Darlene, a devoted Bears fan attending her 500th game. Darlene plays matchmaker, bringing the reporter together with her grandson Matt, a firefighter, over the festive season. Romantic drama, starring Lyndsy Fonseca

programme.title: Midwinter Break
programme.desc: A long-time couple take a life-changing trip to Amsterdam. Director Polly Findlay's romantic drama, starring Lesley Manville, Ciarán Hinds and Julie Lamberton

programme.title: The Pout-Pout Fish
programme.desc: A pouty fish and an energetic sea dragon embark on an underwater quest to find a legendary fish who can save their homes. Animated adventure, with the voices of Grant Denyer, Nadine Bates and Nick Offerman

programme.title: My Christmas Cowboy
programme.desc: After a humiliating college audition, Meg builds a career producing news in Texas. Former crush Billy, now a disgraced Hollywood host, returns home for Christmas. When Meg's injured father asks Billy to host the ranch's Reindeer Roundup, riding lessons rekindle resentment and affection, helping them discover confidence and possibly love. Romantic drama, starring Amy Acker and Luke Macfarlane

programme.title: Passenger
programme.desc: After witnessing a horrific crash, a young couple are haunted by a demonic presence that won't stop until it claims them. Horror thriller, starring Jacob Scipio, Lou Llobell and Melissa Leo

programme.title: The End of Oak Street
programme.desc: After an American street is ripped from suburbia and transported somewhere unknown, the Platt family fight for survival. Writer/director David Robert Mitchell's fantasy adventure, starring Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor

She is grimly resolved to confront ghosts of the past so she can finally meet the daughter she was forced to give up. Drama, starring Maika Monroe

programme.desc: Ensemble romantic comedy featuring Hugh Grant, Emma Thompson, Alan Rickman, Keira Knightley and Bill Nighy. In London, during the weeks leading up to Christmas, people from various walks of life - among them adult film performers, a washed-up rock star and the British Prime Minister - suffer the emotional highs and lows of being in love.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart and Anna Faris. Chris was once an overweight loser, but is now slim, successful and a compulsive womaniser. Returning to his home town, he becomes determined to win the heart of the girl who was his best friend in high school.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
programme.desc: Comedy starring Chevy Chase and Beverly D'Angelo. The accident-prone Griswold family decides to spend a traditional Christmas at home. But the peace is shattered when the decorations start to go up and the relatives arrive.

programme.title: Surviving Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy starring Ben Affleck, James Gandolfini and Christina Applegate. Wealthy advertising executive Drew Latham faces Christmas alone after quarrelling with his girlfriend, so he decides to revisit his old childhood home, only to find it now occupied by the Valco family. Desperate for company, he pays the Valcos to let him spend the holiday season with them as their son. While dad Tom is happy to take the cash, the rest of the clan don't take too kindly to Drew's presence, especially daughter Alicia.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: SuperKlaus
programme.desc: Santa Claus is excitedly preparing for another busy festive season at the North Pole with his army of helpers, including executive assistant Leo. Action figures of the film character SuperKlaus are especially popular this year, but a blow to the head robs Santa of his memory, and he labours under the illusion that he is SuperKlaus. Can tech-savvy tyke Billie and a robot companion restore Santa's memory before a megalomaniacal businessman takes undeserved ownership of Yuletide? Animated adventure, with the voices of Colm Feore, Harland Williams, Paul Van Dyck and Millie Davis

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy fantasy starring Will Ferrell and James Caan. Raised by Santa's helpers at the North Pole, human infant Buddy matures into a strapping adult and outgrows his cramped surroundings. His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

programme.title: Uncle Buck
programme.desc: Comedy starring John Candy and Macaulay Culkin. Buck Russell is a fun-loving bachelor without a care in the world. He's also the world's greatest slob. So when he has to look after his sharp young nephew and nieces while their parents are away, anything can - and will - happen.

programme.title: A Boy Called Christmas
programme.desc: Seasonal adventure starring Henry Lawfull, Toby Jones and Sally Hawkins, based on the bestseller by Matt Haig. At Christmas, three children are told the story of Nikolas, a young Finnish boy searching for a magical elf kingdom. Along for the ride are a talking mouse and a friendly reindeer, as Nikolas embarks on a quest that will see his name go down in history.

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voice of James McAvoy. Santa's job of getting presents to all the children in just one night is an operation that requires military precision. But when a glitch in the system means that a little girl is not going to get her new bike, it falls to Santa's clumsy son Arthur to make sure she isn't disappointed.

programme.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy starring Jim Carrey. It's Christmas in Whoville and preparations are well under way. Meanwhile, up in his mountain lair, cold-hearted hermit the Grinch sits alone resenting the Whovians' happiness. But then he's befriended by a little girl.

programme.title: Four Christmases
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Reese Witherspoon and Vince Vaughn. The potent mix of Christmas and relations presents a special challenge for Kate and Brad, who are forced to visit all of their four divorced parents on Christmas Day. Along the way they discover things about themselves and each other.

programme.title: Love Actually

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks as the owners of rival New York bookshops. When Joe Fox threatens to put Kathleen Kelly out of business, he shares his misgivings about the impending closure of her store and other personal secrets with an anonymous chat-room partner - and makes a startling discovery that only adds to his dilemma.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
programme.desc: Comedy starring Chevy Chase and Beverly D'Angelo. The accident-prone Griswold family decides to spend a traditional Christmas at home. But the peace is shattered when the decorations start to go up and the relatives arrive.

programme.title: Christmas with the Coopers
programme.desc: Four generations of a family meet up to spend Christmas together - and all bring their own problems to the gathering, with a fake boyfriend, an arrest for shoplifting and the demands of single parenthood putting the festive season in jeopardy. Comedy, starring Diane Keaton, John Goodman, Ed Helms and Amanda Seyfried, narrated by Steve Martin as the family dog

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.title: xXx: The Return of Xander Cage
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson and Donnie Yen. After years in exile, agent Xander Cage is brought back into action when a potentially lethal space weapon falls into the wrong hands.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller starring Jennifer Lawrence. In annual retribution for a failed uprising in the totalitarian state of Panem, each of 12 districts is forced to select a young boy and girl to take part in a televised fight to the death. When her younger sister is chosen, the resourceful Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her place.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: The second part of the futuristic action adventure based on the novels by Suzanne Collins, starring Jennifer Lawrence. A year on from their victory, Katniss and Peeta embark on a winners' tour of the districts. But before they leave, they are issued with a stark warning by President Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Jennifer Lawrence. Having survived two Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen is taken to the underground District 13. There she meets the rebel leader President Alma Coin who asks the inspirational Katniss to become a spearhead in their push against the might of the Capitol.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: Finale to the action adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence. Despite her importance as a figurehead to the rebel cause, Katniss puts her life on the line to join the front lines on an assault on the Capitol. However, President Snow has some nasty surprises waiting for them, while Peeta's brainwashing makes him increasingly unpredictable.

When a Japanese vessel is sunk in the South Pacific and enormous footprints are discovered in Panama, a team of scientists is brought in to investigate. But radiation expert Niko Tatopoulos has his own theory - nuclear bomb tests have mutated a lizard to gigantic proportions and Manhattan is now under threat.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Gal Gadot and Ben Affleck. With an ancient demonic threat looming, Bruce Wayne, aka Batman, enlists the help of Diana Prince (Wonder Woman) to form a new superhero team. After adding Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash to its ranks, the league faces its first challenge: resurrecting Superman.
