programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Fast & Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller in which Vin Diesel and Paul Walker, the stars of the first film in the street-racing franchise, team up again. Criminal Dominic Toretto returns to LA to avenge the murder of one of his friends by a drug kingpin, bringing him face to face with an old rival - FBI agent Brian O'Conner.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Gal Gadot and Ben Affleck. With an ancient demonic threat looming, Bruce Wayne, aka Batman, enlists the help of Diana Prince (Wonder Woman) to form a new superhero team. After adding Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash to its ranks, the league faces its first challenge: resurrecting Superman.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: The Witches
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Anjelica Huston and Mai Zetterling. After the death of his parents, young Luke visits England. His grandmother, Helga, has warned Luke about witches so he's not surprised when he discovers that their seaside hotel is hosting an English witch convention. However, the star guest at the convention is the Grand High Witch, who reveals her dastardly plan to turn the nation's children into rodents.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse: The Movie
programme.desc: When Gabby's prized dollhouse ends up with eccentric cat lady Vera, the youngster embarks on a adventure to reunite the Gabby Cats and retrieve her beloved diorama before it's too late. Comedy adventure, starring Laila Lockhart Kraner and Kristen Wiig

programme.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
programme.desc: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from Monster Family to The Amazing Maurice.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake. Jellystone Park's famous talking bear Yogi and his sidekick Boo Boo find their home under threat from a spendthrift mayor who has plans to sell it off.

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure. SpongeBob the friendly sea sponge sets out from his home town of Bikini Bottom with his starfish friend, Patrick, to reclaim King Neptune's stolen crown.

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Misguided inventor Flint Lockwood creates a machine that can turn water into food. But what initially seems like the answer to his community's economic crisis soon begins to cause some unexpected problems.

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy with the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Flint Lockwood's mutating machine is no longer turning water into food but producing food/animal hybrids, or foodimals, which very quickly overrun his home town.

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: Four misfits are yanked through a strange portal into a cubic realm powered by imagination. To return home, they must learn its rules and journey alongside an unlikely master crafter. Director Jared Hess's blockbusting fantasy adventure based on the hit videogame, starring Jack Black, Jason Momoa, Emma Myers and Jennifer Coolidge

programme.title: Happy Feet
programme.desc: Musical animated adventure featuring the voices of Nicole Kidman, Elijah Wood and Robin Williams. In the freezing Antarctic, Emperor penguins find their soul mate through their own unique "heart song". Unfortunately for young bird Mumble, he can't sing a note, but he can tap dance brilliantly. Social rejection soon follows, leading his "happy feet" to be blamed for a colony-threatening fish famine. Determined to prove his worth, Mumble heads off on a perilous journey to discover the truth about what has happened to the fish stocks.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Musical animated adventure sequel featuring the voice of Elijah Wood. Mumble and his son Erik must rescue their friends and family in the aftermath of a natural disaster.

programme.title: Johnny English
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring Rowan Atkinson, and featuring John Malkovich. When the crown jewels are stolen from under the nose of the authorities, bumbling secret agent Johnny English is assigned to retrieve them and capture the culprits. The unfortunate spy is soon in over his head when he discovers that the theft is part of an evil plan to seize the British throne.

programme.title: Johnny English Reborn
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring Rowan Atkinson. When a plot comes to light to assassinate the Chinese premier, hapless operative Johnny English, currently honing his combat skills in a remote region of Tibet, is hurriedly called back to MI7.

programme.title: Johnny English Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spy comedy starring Rowan Atkinson. Bumbling MI7 agent Johnny English has found a new life as a geography teacher. But when a cyber attack exposes Britain's spooks, he is forced to come out of retirement, and enlists his former sidekick Jeremy to help him flush out the hacker responsible.

programme.title: Goosebumps
programme.desc: Horror comedy based on the popular books by R L Stine, starring Jack Black. When 15-year-old Zach breaks into his neighbour's house to investigate strange noises, he discovers that he lives next door to the author of the Goosebumps series, whose monstrous creations have to be kept in locked manuscripts. But when the monsters get loose, it's up to Zach to help imprison them again.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford, Sean Connery and Denholm Elliott. When archaeologist Henry Jones disappears, his son Indiana joins in the search for him. In a desperate race against time, Indy encounters some old enemies and once again finds himself in pursuit of an ancient religious artefact.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: Sports drama starring Tom Cruise, Robert Duvall and Nicole Kidman. Cocky racing driver Cole Trickle is revved up to take the stock-car circuit by storm, but his aggressive driving style soon lands him in hospital. There he meets Dr Claire Lewicki, who gives the young driver more than racing to think about.

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Kerwin Mathews. Blown off course to the monster-infested island of Colossa, Sinbad and his crew rescue a sorcerer from the clutches of a cyclops. The voyage continues to Baghdad, but the sorcerer has been forced to leave stolen property behind, and hatches a wicked plan to force Sinbad to return to Colossa.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Book Adaptations
programme.desc: From page to screen, the Cinema List celebrates book adaptations. Featuring Wuthering Heights starring Margot Robbie and Bridget Jones's Diary, see these stories on film

programme.title: Shenandoah
programme.desc: Western starring James Stewart and Doug McClure. Loner Charlie Anderson keeps his family out of the Civil War, even though there is fighting a few miles from his Virginia farm. But when his new son-in-law joins the Confederate army and his youngest son is captured by Federal troops, Charlie finds he can no longer ignore the conflict.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Action comedy thriller starring Martin Lawrence and Will Smith. Two chalk-and-cheese Miami drugs squad detectives - one a wise-cracking, Porsche-driving ladies' man, the other married with a family - are assigned to track down a missing $100-million shipment of heroin.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford and Karen Allen. Indiana Jones's outrageous exploits take him around the world in search of the legendary Ark of the Covenant, a religious artefact of unspeakable power wanted by the Nazis. With the help of an old flame, Indy takes on his enemies in a terrifying and death-defying battle to the finish.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure sequel with Jack Black as the voice of martial arts master Po. In order to stop the plot of evil peacock Lord Shen, Po must embark on a journey to discover the truth about his childhood.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford, Sean Connery and Denholm Elliott. When archaeologist Henry Jones disappears, his son Indiana joins in the search for him. In a desperate race against time, Indy encounters some old enemies and once again finds himself in pursuit of an ancient religious artefact.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni and Morgan Freeman. A reporter believes that she has discovered a sex scandal in the US government. As it turns out, "Ele" isn't a mistress, but something used to describe an event so cataclysmic that it could destroy the planet.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: James Cameron's science-fiction action thriller sequel to The Terminator, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Linda Hamilton. Tormented by the imminent threat of a nuclear holocaust from which intelligent machines will emerge to crush the last vestiges of human existence, Sarah Connor has been institutionalised and separated from her son. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. However, the machines of 2029 know it too, and once again they send a cyborg assassin back through time to terminate the potential saviour.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Fantasy horror comedy starring Bruce Campbell and Embeth Davidtz. The second sequel to the original Evil Dead finds Ash back in medieval times and desperate to return to the present. But to do so, it means having to take up arms against an army of familiar old foes.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Crime thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, and starring Jason Statham and Ray Liotta. Jake Green leaves prison determined to avenge the murder of his sister-in-law by men working for ruthless casino boss Dorothy Macha, the person also responsible for his incarceration. But after a confrontation at Macha's club, Green becomes a target for the villain's henchmen.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: One Last Deal
programme.desc: A veteran sports agent scrambles to land one last high-stakes deal for his star client, with both their futures on the line. Drama, starring Danny Dyer and Elliott Rogers

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring John Boyega. During the US summer riots of 1967, a gang of police officers raid Detroit's Algiers Motel and proceed to terrorise its mostly Black residents.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
programme.desc: Romantic action comedy starring Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Crime thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, and starring Jason Statham and Ray Liotta. Jake Green leaves prison determined to avenge the murder of his sister-in-law by men working for ruthless casino boss Dorothy Macha, the person also responsible for his incarceration. But after a confrontation at Macha's club, Green becomes a target for the villain's henchmen.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Hallow Road
programme.desc: Two parents are thrust into a desperate race against time after a late-night call from their daughter reveals she caused a devastating car accident. Director Babak Anvari's psychological thriller, starring Rosamund Pike and Matthew Rhys

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestseller by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Felicity Jones. Renowned symbologist Dr Robert Langdon wakes up in a Florence hospital with a head injury and no memory of the previous 48 hours. However, he soon finds himself hunted and forced to undertake a globe-trotting race against time to prevent the release of a deadly virus capable of killing half the world's population.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller, directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his assistant Dr John Watson think they have seen the back of serial killer Lord Blackwood. But when the evil occultist apparently comes back from the dead, they are once again drawn into a dangerous game.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Comedy caper directed by Steven Soderbergh, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver and Daniel Craig. Two down-on-their-luck brothers decide to rob the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. In order to pull off the job, they need the help of explosives expert Joe Bang - but first they must break him out of prison.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: Grimsby
programme.desc: Spy spoof starring Sacha Baron Cohen and Mark Strong. Nearly 30 years after they were adopted by different families, brothers Norman "Nobby" Butcher and Sebastian meet again. But the reunion proves to be fraught with problems now that one is an international spy and the other has stayed true to his hard-drinking, working-class, football-hooligan roots.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy featuring the music of Abba, and starring Meryl Streep, Colin Firth and Pierce Brosnan. On an idyllic Greek island, young Sophie Sheridan prepares to marry the man of her dreams. But a problem looks set to blight the big day as the bride doesn't know who her father is. So Sophie sends out invitations to three men who might fit the bill, hoping to solve the riddle once her guests arrive.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy sequel starring Lily James, Amanda Seyfried and Jeremy Irvine and featuring the songs of Abba. A now happily married Sophie prepares to reopen her late mother Donna's hotel. Meanwhile flashbacks show a young Donna discovering Greece and falling in love - several times.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Adam Sandler. When his latest girlfriend dumps him because she says he is not a responsible adult, 32-year-old Sonny Koufax tries to win her back by adopting the illegitimate five-year-old son of his friend Kevin, who's on a trip to China.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Comedy starring Kristen Wiig and Rose Byrne. After Lillian announces her engagement, she asks her lifelong pal Annie to be her maid of honour. However, Annie's life is in a mess, and she finds herself losing control over the bachelorette party to Lillian's seemingly perfect new friend Helen.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs. Four teenage boys pledge to lose their virginity before their high-school prom, but their efforts have hilarious and outrageous consequences.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Womanising vet Henry Roth ditches his playboy lifestyle after falling for the charming Lucy. But a car crash has left her with severe short term memory loss, meaning that Henry has to romance her all over again every day in the hope that eventually she'll remember him.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.title: Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale
programme.desc: In the summer of 1930, the Crawleys grapple with the threat of social disgrace when Mary finds herself at the centre of a public scandal. Romantic drama, starring Joely Richardson, Joanne Froggatt and Paul Giamatti

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

However, after discovering the world of high-stakes poker, she builds her own gambling empire, which makes her rich - and attracts a major federal investigation.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody

So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

A 5.5 magnitude earthquake rocks the city, causing structural failures in the basement that expose an old bank vault and a copy of the Naturom Demonto. Horror, starring Alyssa Sutherland

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda and Oliver Platt. After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Sci-fi satire starring Robert Pattinson. Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.title: The 6th Day
programme.desc: Science-fiction action thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. In a world where the regeneration of pets and the genetic modification of food has become commonplace, helicopter pilot Adam Gibson becomes the victim of an illegal human-cloning operation. Now he must fight to regain his life and find the men responsible.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Benedict Cumberbatch. Captain Kirk's disdain for protocol sees him stripped of the command of the Enterprise, but he is given a chance to prove himself after volunteering to find and stop a mysterious operative who's out to destroy Starfleet.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda and Oliver Platt. After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and featuring Sharon Stone. After suffering a series of nightmares about Mars, construction worker Douglas Quaid discovers that the planet may in fact hold the key to his true identity.

programme.title: Bugonia
programme.desc: Satirical thriller starring Emma Stone and Jesse Plemons. Conspiracy theorist Teddy and his impressionable cousin Don kidnap biomedical company CEO Michelle and chain her up in the basement of their rural home. Over the next few days, Teddy proceeds to interrogate and torture Michelle in the hope of forcing a simple confession: that she is an emissary from a hostile extraterrestrial race and can take him to her leader.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Amy Adams and Jeremy Renner. After 12 alien spacecraft land in locations around the world, linguistics professor Louise Banks is called in to try to decipher the visitors' language and open a line of communication. Do they come in peace or is humankind on the brink of war?

programme.title: Weapons
programme.desc: Mystery horror starring Josh Brolin and Julia Garner, with Amy Madigan. A small town is rocked when 17 children from the same school class disappear overnight. Their teacher, Justine, becomes the unofficial prime suspect, with devastated father Archer among those leading the charge against her. But this mass vanishing is only the start of the strange and violent happenings that come to plague the community.

programme.title: Tombstone
programme.desc: Western starring Kurt Russell and Val Kilmer. Arizona 1879: Wyatt Earp arrives in Tombstone to start a business, his career as a lawman behind him. But, with the town in the grip of an organised crime ring, he is soon forced to take up arms.

programme.title: Better Things
programme.desc: Social drama starring Tara Ballard, Liam McIlfatrick and Che Corr. Duane Hopkins' debut feature uses non-actors to tell the stories of a series of young people in a rural Cotswolds community, who escape from the reality of their isolated existence by taking hard drugs.

programme.title: Halls of Montezuma
programme.desc: Second World War action drama starring Richard Widmark. With US forces locked in a battle for supremacy against the Japanese in the South Pacific, a tough marine officer leads a patrol on a dangerous mission to capture enemy soldiers for interrogation.

programme.title: All That Heaven Allows
programme.desc: Melodrama starring Jane Wyman and Rock Hudson. Wealthy widow Cary Scott, after years of shunning company, falls in love with gardener Ron Kirby, who is 15 years her junior. The difference in social status as well as their age shocks her family and friends, and soon their relationship is affected by gossip.

programme.title: Lifeboat
programme.desc: Second World War drama directed by Alfred Hitchcock, starring Tallulah Bankhead and William Bendix. Eight survivors from a torpedoed ship, adrift in a lifeboat, take on board a German U-boat captain whose presence causes escalating tension.

programme.title: Sea Wife
programme.desc: Second World War romantic adventure starring Joan Collins and Richard Burton. After their ship is torpedoed off Singapore, an RAF officer is cast adrift with three other survivors and becomes attracted to the only woman among them.

programme.title: Wild Horse Nine Interview Special
programme.desc: Writer/director Martin McDonagh and cast discuss the Film4-produced political comedy thriller Wild Horse Nine.

programme.title: Twister
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Bill Paxton, Helen Hunt and Cary Elwes. When one of the planet's most deadly natural phenomena blows into town, a feuding team of professional tornado-chasing meteorologists tracks the trail of destruction.

programme.title: Commando
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. Special Forces Colonel John Matrix retires to his mountain home and steadfastly refuses to return to active service. But when his daughter is kidnapped by South American revolutionaries, Matrix must undertake his most important mission - to rescue her.

programme.title: X.
programme.desc: Horror starring Mia Goth, Jenna Ortega and Brittany Snow. The cast and crew of an adult film show up at the remote farm that they have booked for their shoot. But something weird is going on with the farm's elderly owners, and bodies soon start to pile up...

programme.title: Braven

If he misses, reports the plot or is caught by the authorities, the terrorist behind the scheme promises to raise the death toll higher. programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc:
Love Monster and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny are at Love Monster's house, excitedly preparing for Fluffytown's Movie Night. Love Monster has made a huge bag of popcorn to share and is also bringing the new Hero Bunzino movie for everyone to watch. Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny and her cousin Eager Beaver have even dressed up as Hero Bunzino for the occasion! They head out, but when Love Monster tries to carry the huge bag of popcorn out, it gets stuck in his doorway. He gives it a big push, which causes some popcorn to spill out and cover Eager Beaver, who captures the whole thing on her new movie camera.
In his panic to clean the popcorn up, Love Monster accidentally tosses the movie back inside his house and doesn't realise. Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny worries that they might be late for Movie Night, but Love Monster says he knows a short cut. The friends set off and walk through Fluffytown Forest, but they don't get far before Love Monster almost falls into a wide ditch, dangling over the edge. Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny and Eager Beaver help him out and wonder how they are going to get across the ditch. Love Monster looks around and spots some overhanging vines. They can swing across! Love Monster leads the way as he, rather ungracefully, manages to swing himself and the others across the ditch.
Love Monster leads them as they continue on their journey to Movie Night, struggling with the popcorn but overcoming a series of obstacles until they come to a high cliff. How are they going to get the popcorn up the cliff? Love Monster wishes that Hero Bunzino was there as she would know what to do. He looks around and sees a branch overhanging the cliff and has another idea. He's not sure if he's heroic enough to pull it off, but he's going to try. Love Monster throws the rope of the popcorn bag up and over the branch and then grabs it to pull the bag up.
The bag of popcorn catches on the branch at the top, and the friends are able to use it to climb up. They reach the top, but when they try to move on, they realise that the bag is still stuck on the branch. They tug on the other end of it with all their might and it bursts open, showering them with popcorn and sending them rolling down a hill. The trio pop their heads out of the mound of popcorn to see that they've made it to the Movie Night outdoor cinema! Everyone is pleased to see them (and the popcorn), but when Elder Kitten says that it's time for the movie, Love Monster realises that he doesn't have it. He left it at home!
Everybody is disappointed as they think they can no longer have Movie Night, but just then Eager Beaver holds up her camera... maybe they can. Eager Beaver plugs her camera in and everyone marvels as videos of Love Monster's heroics project onto the big screen. Just like Hero Bunzino!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Tha tòrr a' gabhail àite an-diugh nuair a tha Bing agus a' charaidean a-dol dhan choille airson dealbhan-duilleig a tharraing ach chan eil e furasta nuair a tha a' ghaoth ag èirigh.
There's a lot happening when Bing and friends make leaf pictures in the forest, but the wind doesn't make things easy for them.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha einnsean-smàlaidh sa phàirc, tha Sula agus Pando a' faihinn cothrom air suidhe na bhroinn ach tha Bing tàmailteach nuair a tha aig an einnsean-smàlaidh ri falbh ann an cabhaig.
When a fire engine is displayed in the park, Sula and Pando get the opportunity to sit inside it, but Bing is disappointed when it needs to leave in a hurry.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc:
Thig air turas eile sgoinneil le na h-Abadas. 'S e 'put' am facal ùr a tha aca. Cò a thèid air a thòrr an-diugh: Hari, Ela, neo Seren?
Join the Abadas for another 'abadobedee' adventure. This episode's word is 'buoy'. Who will be chosen to find today's exciting new word; Hari, Ela or Seren?

programme.title: Cleasan Àtaidh & Tilidh (The Adventures of Abney & Teal)
programme.desc: It is a peaceful day, but Neep is digging holes all over the Island and won't stop. Abney and Teal try to work out why he is so excited. It must be his birthday

programme.title: 'S E Iasg a Th'Annam (I'm a Fish)
programme.desc: The Garibaldi Fish tells us how he has an image to uphold, the way he finds his mate and how he looks after a nest full of eggs

programme.title: Òrain CBeebies
programme.desc: A selection of songs from Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh and the CBeebies ALBA presenters

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Morag Ann MacNeil reads Chan Fhaic Cearcan san Dorchadas, written and illustrated by Kristyna Litten and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan (Bottersnikes and Gumbles)
programme.desc: When Bonns and Uilidh save Troig from Bògais-shìd’, he is very ungrateful. So much so, that he returns to see the Bògaisean. However, he later learns that friends are helpful

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan (Bottersnikes and Gumbles)
programme.desc: Uilidh wants to prove that he is a hero just like the Un-named Gumbal. How will he get on - is he brave or is he just foolish?

programme.title: Seonaidh (Shaun the Sheep)
programme.desc:
Tha Bitzer air crìoch a chuir air an obair-taighe gu lèir agus a-nis chan eil càil aige ri dhèanamh. The e air a dhòigh nuair a mhothachas e gu bheil an t-sabhal feumach air sgioblachadh - gus an tig e tairsinn air dealbh nach gabh a chrochadh gu dìreach!
Bitzer has completed all his chores and is at a bit of a loss. He's delighted when he discovers the flock's barn needs a good tidy-up, until he comes across a wonky picture that just won't hang straight.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Hilda, Flòraidh and Daibhidh try to earn new Sgùdan Sporrais badges. They go in search of rare, local plants, and this turns into a very interesting adventure

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Uisdean prepares a colourful crab starter using brown and velvet crab meat, while Ruaridh makes an interesting crab linguini and creates hot and cold crab spring rolls

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the first steps of speaking Gaelic. Singer and Gaelic teacher Margaret Macleod Nicholson is the studio guest and Calum Maclean visits Scotland’s newest city and once ancient capital, Dunfermline

programme.title: An Là (News)
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Port An Obain
programme.desc: Oban is the main town of Argyll and Bute. A busy port 365 days a year, with workboats and ferries of all sizes attending to the needs of the local population. It is increasingly popular with tourists, who arrive by train, bus or under sail - a destination offering exceptional seafood and a traditional holiday experience for the many thousands of visitors to enjoy. But it is also a place of work. The sea provides a living for some who reside on beautiful islands located throughout the Argyll area, and their work continues, despite the weather or the season

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Kinga finally holds her triplets together, while Emily undergoes further tests. Diane faces a risk to her sight, Treasa and Ian receive devastating news, and Tom Óg reaches a key milestone

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Torquil Farquhar has just been left stranded on a dummy iceberg in Fraochy Bay as the lifeboat abandons its training sessionand heads off to a real-life emergency. A local crofter is being held hostage by his mutinous sheep

programme.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
programme.desc:
An greimean lòin as fheàrr le Abigail, 's e Buntàta Cruasbach Sàiste. 'Ad cho blast' 's a tha 'ad rin ithe. Tha 'n seòrs' aice-se soirbh a dhèanamh; feumaidh tu fheuchainn.
Abigail's favourite snack lunch is crispy sage potatoes. It's as nice to look at as to eat and her version is easy to make - you must try it!
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Angela and Katie compete against Shonnie and Calum from rival company Sgiobalta. The timing isn't perfect, as it clashes with the anniversary of Katie's reality TV appearance

programme.title: An t-Uisge (Rain Stories)
programme.desc: Rain has influenced our cultures and traditions since time began. Scientists study it, communities pray for it and governments try to control it. But what is rain and why is it more important now than ever? Anne Lundon presents this revealing new series exploring the science and stories behind this life-giving force

programme.title: Dana - Europe's Wild Side
programme.desc: Seeking adventure on a grand scale in Europe, Coinneach Rankin travels to the mountain paradise of Norway. Along with his climbing partner, Calum Gibb, Coinneach makes an ascent of Stetind, a peak with a storied past that has captured the imagination of mountaineers for well over a century

An insurer questions a whiplash claim after a barely visible bump, while a horse rider films an overtake that nearly ends in a head-on crash. A van runs a red light, but tracing the driver brings an unexpected twist

programme.desc: A rookie Derbyshire developer admits he's winging it, while in Bournemouth, Martin Roberts is stunned by the building he's in. Jacqui Joseph is in a Norfolk village called Little Snoring, but there's no time for her to take a nap with a property to see

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Caroline Hawley hosts the latest contest from Exeter, where antiques experts Ben Cooper and Kate Bliss help two teams of contestants pick out three items to sell at auction. Items considered include a Georgian-style silver serving dish and arts and crafts copper candlesticks. Caroline also heads to Box, near Bath, to visit the UK's only tennis ball manufacturer, where she learns about the origins of the tennis ball and how it gets its all-important bounce. Then everyone heads to auction, where Tim Weeks presides in Wiltshire

The team also join forces with an ethical hacker to investigate a man from Cameroon claiming to sell horses on social media

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives

programme.desc: Nicki Chapman helps a retired couple from Northamptonshire find their perfect coastal retreat in Devon. They're dreaming of a single-storey home close to the sea, and one of the properties delivers breathtaking ocean views right from the terrace. Nicki also meets a couple raising a family in a Dartmoor village, who share their love of the outdoors by mapping walks in the National Park for all ages and abilities to enjoy

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea is joined by an Inverness plastering expert to try to preserve art painted by Polish soldiers on the walls of the attic of Nairn Museum during the Second World War. Will Kirk is in Beauly to meet Alan MacPherson, who instructs him in the intricacies of creating shinty sticks to stand up to the rigours of this hard-fought game

The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Caroline Hawley hosts the latest contest from Exeter, where antiques experts Ben Cooper and Kate Bliss help two teams of contestants pick out three items to sell at auction. Items considered include a Georgian-style silver serving dish and arts and crafts copper candlesticks. Caroline also heads to Box, near Bath, to visit the UK's only tennis ball manufacturer, where she learns about the origins of the tennis ball and how it gets its all-important bounce. Then everyone heads to auction, where Tim Weeks presides in Wiltshire

programme.desc: Nicki Chapman helps a retired couple from Northamptonshire find their perfect coastal retreat in Devon. They're dreaming of a single-storey home close to the sea, and one of the properties delivers breathtaking ocean views right from the terrace. Nicki also meets a couple raising a family in a Dartmoor village, who share their love of the outdoors by mapping walks in the National Park for all ages and abilities to enjoy

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea is joined by an Inverness plastering expert to try to preserve art painted by Polish soldiers on the walls of the attic of Nairn Museum during the Second World War. Will Kirk is in Beauly to meet Alan MacPherson, who instructs him in the intricacies of creating shinty sticks to stand up to the rigours of this hard-fought game

programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Lee, Has, Nina, Rob and Amanda race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Vick Hope

programme.desc: Colin Murray and Edith Bowman explore St George's Market in Belfast and meet a social media sensation who reveals the secrets of healthy and inexpensive one-pot meals. programme.desc: The latest stage of Michael Portillo's trek takes him past lochs and castles on the Far North Line to Britain's northernmost railway station at Thurso. programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: The crew of Karen of Ladram hunts hake off Cornwall, but the trip is thrown into jeopardy when a crew member's health deteriorates and their catch is decimated when seals get to the fish first. Elsewhere, a rookie crew works in the Irish Sea, trainee skipper Michael steps up in a storm, and Tydus heads out in search of crabs

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit Lancaster to value more objects and rarities brought in by the public. Items include an expensive pair of clogs, an emotional series of letters written during the Crimean War, an anti-slavery ring and an intricately woven tapestry thought to be worth £10,000. First shown in 2005

programme.title: Flog It!

The presenter also uncovers the hidden architectural gems of one of Wiltshire's most famous sons, Christopher Wren, during a trip to London

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: The two $100,000 winners of the series go head-to-head to win a magical Disney Cruise Line holiday. Plus: people unintentionally do the splits; and a little girl opens a gender reveal box expecting to see her new baby brother inside

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: A scuffle at a downtown pool hall almost sees Will lose the family Mercedes, but thankfully his uncle is on hand to bail him out. Guest starring JD Hall

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Carlton accepts a dangerous challenge from Will to prove that he is just as streetwise as his cousin by staying in a rough Los Angeles neighbourhood

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart falls in love with the daughter of film star Rainier Wolfcastle, but their romance falters and she ends up going out with Milhouse in a bid to make him jealous. With the voices of Reese Witherspoon and chef Wolfgang Puck

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Fleeing a dog that hates him for no reason, Bart meets a faded Western star. With Marge's help, Bart tries to get him off booze and start him on a better life.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer revitalizes Bumblebee Man's career when he becomes his secret stuntman. But how much punishment can a Stunt-Bee take before it starts to sting?

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The family visits Brazil to find a missing orphan Lisa has been sponsoring, leaving Maggie under the watchful eyes of Patty and Selma - but it is not long before Homer is kidnapped and held to ransom by bandits

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: As Adam celebrates his 16th birthday, his parents are too distracted by Barry and Lainey's engagement and Erica's band ambitions to acknowledge their youngest son's big day. However, the situation presents an opportunity for Adam to ask Erica to put him on the high school social map. Meanwhile, Beverly thinks she can scare Barry and Lainey straight with the reality of being adults

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam's girlfriend Jackie returns after spending the summer in New York and seems like a different person. After receiving some bad advice from his loved ones, Adam takes drastic measures to hold on to his relationship. Beverly is not happy with Lainey's domestic skills and decides to teach her future daughter-in-law a thing or two about family catering

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Claire struggles to find the right moment to sack an employee, while Phil catches Luke in a compromising position at home and everyone fails to notice that Alex has moved back for the summer. Elsewhere, Jay refuses to accept that finding a job again might be harder than he thought and Lily gets caught in the middle when Cameron and Mitch decide to spend the summer apart

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: All three families trying to cope with their separate holiday experiences, before everyone tries to make their way back home in time for Father's Day. The Dunphys are wrapping up their trip to New York City, while Cam and Mitchell are caring for Cam's dying grandmother in Missouri, and Jay, Gloria and Manny are attending a wedding in Mexico - but all of their respective trips are thrown into turmoil

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Jay does not want to give the new family moving in across the street the wrong impression and goes out of his way to make sure they know he is the best kind of neighbor, while Manny decides that the best way to an attractive and radical-thinking teenage girl's heart is through his actions. Meanwhile, at the Pritchett house, the entire family is using Alex's recent bout of mono to their advantage. Finally, Cam and Mitchell have always felt they were the most open, non-judgmental and supportive parents. However, when they overhear Lily insulting her new friend, they have to take a quick look in the mirror before they teach her a lesson about acceptance.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Dunphys and Pritchetts go head-to-head when Luke decides his best chance at getting into college is to run for senior class president against Manny. Phil insists on introducing Haley to marketing guru Merv Schechter (guest star Martin Short), while Cam makes a rash decision when he finds out his star football player is moving away

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Principal Skinner introduces a unique incentive to stop pupils being naughty - a ride on a submarine. It seems to do the trick, and before long Springfield Elementary's finest are competing to be the best behaved - including Bart. But has the youngster committed too many crimes against Skinner to wipe the slate clean? Meanwhile, Lisa helps Krusty with his money troubles

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A radiation leak at the nuclear plant causes snow to fall, just in time for Christmas - and when Springfield is inundated with festive holiday-makers, Marge sees a chance to make some extra cash by opening up the family home to boarders. Meanwhile, Lisa decides it's the thought that counts when buying this year's gifts - much to the annoyance of Bart

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer is fed up with the price of movies, so he starts illegally downloading films and opens his own cinema in the back yard. However, when Marge turns him in, he gets busted by a government anti-piracy squad, and finds himself in trouble with a host of Hollywood bigwigs, including writer and director Judd Apatow and actors Leslie Mann, Paul Rudd, Will Arnett and Channing Tatum

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Comic Book Guy hasn't had much luck with the ladies in the past but all that changes when he takes advice from Marvel Comics head honcho Stan Lee, who gives him the courage to ask out a Japanese manga artist - and what woman wouldn't be wowed by a bouquet of flowers delivered in a Hulk hand?

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer and Bart perform street magic in a bid to impress passers-by and raise enough cash to pay a mechanic's bill. Unfortunately, they quickly realise people are suckers for a sob story, and start conning the public for money. Featuring the guest voice of Edward Norton

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Ava Fest is back, and with the help of the teachers, Ava's determined to outdo last year by any means necessary. And after Janine accepts the offer of a full-time position at the district, she just has to check off one last thing to make it official

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Vivian is terrified of turning 40, and chooses to mark the occasion by taking up dancing in a bid to achieve her lifelong dream of becoming a professional performer

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will strikes up a friendship with an overweight girl but is reluctant to take her out in public, fearing he will be teased. Queen Latifah guest stars

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics sit down to watch Squid Game: The Challenge - the real-life version of the Netflix hit - and get hot under the collar with Channel 4's swinging drama The Couple Next Door. Plus, The Toy Hospital, Survivor, Vinnie Jones in the Country, Tony Robinson's Marvellous Machines and Lorraine. From December 2023

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on shows including Squid Game: The Challenge, The Couple Next Door, Strictly Come Dancing, The Graham Norton Show, Planet Earth III, Matt Baker: Travels with Mum & Dad and Jingle All the Way. From December 2023

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: There's discord between contestants Charlotte Ritchie, Jamali Maddix, Lee Mack, Mike Wozniak and Sarah Kendall as rows erupt over facial hair and Jamali's driving skills. As usual, Alex Horne offers the intrepid contenders moral support

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the topical comedy panel show, inviting Scarlett Moffatt, Harriet Kemsley, Wes Nelson and Rosie Jones to discuss and dissect topics in their quest to uncover the nation's most popular talking points. Rob Beckett and Tom Allen are the team captains

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown

programme.desc: Paul Quentel, president of Alfred Angelo, the second largest bridal retailer in the United States, goes undercover to solve any problems as quickly as possible. Posing as a contestant on a reality TV competition, he works among his own staff

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Mike Bloom, president and COO of discount retail chain Family Dollar, intends to double its number of stores within a few years. He decides that to do so he first needs to go incognito within the organisation to monitor where the firm is excelling and where it needs improvement

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Keen to impress with their cooking in Brighton is long-married couple David and Liz, newlyweds James and Paul, and loved-up Martin and Lorena. David and Liz are hoping that their twist on crowd-pleasers and their playful approach to entertaining will clinch the cash prize. Day two sees creative Paul and his husband James pull out all the stops to create a very personal evening. Last to host are love's young dream Martin and Lorena who are determined to outdo the rest by bringing the fiesta with a Spanish-themed evening

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Bournemouth, John and Karen showcase their home grown food. But Sarah-Jane is worried that she'll be eating their 'pets' and pescatarian Zoe is accidentally given meat for her starter.

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Roller-hockey enthusiast Luke Jarvis is given £12,000 to plan his wedding to family-oriented bride-to-be Jaydene Coomber, coming up with a skating-themed ceremony that is all about fun, and a three-day stag party that blows a significant hole in his budget. However, his fiancee is hoping for a much more muted affair, namely a traditional service at the same church where her parent and grandparents got married, and it remains to be seen how she'll react to strapping on roller-skates to glide down the aisle

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Holiday park entertainments manager Mathew Hill plans a pirate-themed ceremony for his wedding to dancer fiancee Jamie-Lee Johnson, who simply wants a traditional day and to be the centre of attention for once. With the best man not fully onboard with the groom's swashbuckling ideas and the weather threatening to play havoc, the chances of a smooth wedding day seem slim

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Dave brings his mentor with him to Rancho Cucamonga, but has little to show for it. Brandi and Jarrod go all in on a hunch, Kenny tries to downsize his strategy, while Ivy shows a skeptical Emily how he pulls a win out of a locker

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The Vegas Ladies discover that one of them has Texas flair, Kenny lucks out looking for lady stuff; and Mary gets the spring back in her step.

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Chicago-based hardware retailer True Value's CEO and president John Hartmann poses as a handyman taking part in a reality show to go incognito among his own workforce to see how he can extend the company's lifespan and improve the experiences of both customers and employees

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Bill Peduto, 60th Mayor of Pittsburgh, who comes from a proud family of Pennsylvania steel workers, goes incognito among his own workforce posing as a reality show contestant from Kentucky. In the 10 months since he was elected, many changes have been made in Pittsburgh and Bill wants to make sure they are effective and to hear directly from the city's employees

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Alfonso Ribeiro presents memorable moments captured on camera, including magic tricks gone wrong and kids saying the funniest - and cheekiest - things

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The King of Montebello cannot wait to see what he can drum up this time around. Rene sniffs out a great locker, stepping over the competition to get it. Kenny does his best to fire up his profits, while Brandi can't see the potential in the units

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Back in Montebello, Brandi and her buddy set the wayback machine and discover a roaring good time. Darrell makes the most of the little he's got, while Kenny fills his piggy bank, while courting an unfamiliar pastime

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: It's time for circus night, which is pretty apt considering the amount of clowning in the crew. Captain Jason has to get involved when a heated argument breaks out in the galley

programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to Wilkinsburg in Pennsylvania, home to Ms Jean's Southern Cuisine, which was opened by retired special-education teacher Jean Gould. programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef visits beachside restaurant Barefoot Bob's in Hull, Massachusetts, owned by husband-and-wife team Marc and Lisa. programme.desc: For the first time in the Park's history, Hartmann's mountain zebras arrive on the savanna at Disney's Animal Kingdom Theme Park! Keeper Meaghan and the team do their best to acclimate the mischievous herd and prepare the other animals to meet their new neighbors, including a curious young zebra, Clementine, and mom-to-be Prima. Meanwhile, babirusa Betty is introduced to bachelor Mentari, with the hope that the plucky pigs hit it off and give the Park its first-ever babirusa piglet. At The Seas with Nemo & Friends at EPCOT, an 1,800-pound rescued manatee, Lou, has a potentially infected tail, so keepers must use a crane to lift him out of the aquarium to transport him for a high-def CT scan.

programme.title: Magic of Disney's Animal Kingdom
programme.desc: Meet the mandrills of the Harambe Wildlife Reserve! This lively bunch has been bickering lately, so animal manager Beth and keepers Erin and Kerri decide to bring in a distraction. They introduce Linus, a hunky new monkey who manages to charm the all-female squad. On the other side of the reserve, animal keeper Nicole has a soft spot for Scooter and Zawadi, a stinky hyena pair with a spotty reputation. She helps them clean up with a spa day that includes tasty treats, a back scratch, and a relaxing bubble bath. Over at Maharajah Jungle Trek, animal keeper Susan helps Sohni, an eight-year-old Sumatran tiger, face a tough challenge - undergoing a voluntary blood test. Cassanova, an Abyssinian ground hornbill and a fan-favorite resident of Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge & Villas, receives a new diet and a feather makeover to strut his stuff again. Later, engineers must perform an overnight operation to inspect an underwater fence within the black rhino habitat.

programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Furniture restorer Will Kirk is tasked with repairing a writing bureau owned by Kathryn Lovell and her dad John from Northamptonshire. The bureau belonged to Kathryn's grandfather, who ran the village post office for decades and was loved by all. However, the wood is now warped and split, the desk panel that folds down has suffered a nasty fracture, and a main hinge is broken.
Liz McMordie and her brother Sam from Northern Ireland are hoping precious metals expert Brenton West can preserve a link to their rich farming heritage. In the 1950s, their father won the world ploughing championships three times, but his trophies are now worn, scratched and chipped. Brenton gets to work recreating some tiny missing parts and gold-plates the silver ploughs.
Leather expert Susie is intrigued by a pair of dancing clogs. Louise Robertson from Oxford owns the clogs, which were handmade by her grandfather over a century ago. Susie nourishes the parched, stiff leather, fills in the many holes left by woodworm and returns the clogs to stand testament to Louise's family's dancing legacy and the craftsman that created them.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo journeys from Piccadilly Circus to Gravesend, visiting an exotic West End store that was popular among Victorian women and hearing how a Russian ballet company took London by storm in 1909. programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo heads from Warwick to Rye in East Sussex. In the orchards of East Malling, Kent, Michael discovers how the Edwardians' serious attitude towards cultivation bears fruit even now. In Folkestone, he hears how the town coped with an influx of more than 100,000 refugees fleeing the German invasion in 1914. In the High Weald, Michael heads for Tenterden Town and the light railway that opened in 1900. His final stop is the medieval Cinque Port of Rye, where he tours the home and garden of author Henry James

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the Britain of the 1930s as he sets out on another adventure. Beginning just outside Newcastle in Jarrow, Michael uncovers the desperation that led 200 men to march 300 miles to Westminster in order to petition the government for work. The first leg of his journey ends Spennymoor, Co Durham, where he meets the son of a miner who became one of the most famous 20th-century artists of the region

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is in Northumbria en route to the Highlands, heading to Kielder Forest to discover what lay behind a national initiative to plant one of the largest manmade woodlands in Europe. Crossing the border to Scotland, Michael arrives in the weaving town of Hawick to visit Lovat Mill, where, in the 1930s, tweed was big business, and also goes to the movies, sitting in the front stalls at the Dominion cinema in Morningside

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Following the route of the old Caledonian Railway Company, Michael Portillo discovers the 'Riviera of the Highlands'. With a daily direct train service to Kings Cross, Gleneagles remains a top destination and is also headquarters for the British School of Falconry. Berry Town, aka Blairgowrie, is Michael's next stop. At the home of the Scottish raspberry industry, which once sent fruit to London daily on board a raspberry special service from Cooper Angus station, Michael learns how to pick this most delicate of berries. The last stop on this leg is the city of Dundee, where he visits publisher DC Thomson

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores how British rule led to armed rebellion in America, and a loyalty in Canada that lasted until the very end of the Empire. On Long Island, Michael visits The Brewster House, a former tavern where British soldiers met and talked freely during the Revolutionary War, unaware that it was run by George Washington's Culper Spy Ring. He also calls in at Fort Niagara, where he learns how the native peoples of North America saw their tribes and families torn apart as they picked sides, shedding blood on behalf of either the crown or the patriots

programme.title: Bill Bailey's Jungle Hero
programme.desc: Part one of two. The comedian heads to Indonesia to follow in the footsteps of Victorian naturalist Alfred Russel Wallace, who devised the theory of evolution through natural selection independently of Charles Darwin. Bill encounters orang-utans, flying frogs and extraordinary bugs on a mission to understand how Wallace came up with his idea, and tries to win him the recognition he deserves

programme.title: Bill Bailey's Jungle Hero
programme.desc: Part two of two. The comedian continues his journey retracing the footsteps of Victorian naturalist Alfred Russel Wallace by heading to Indonesian archipelago the Moluccas, formerly known by the nickname of the Spice Islands. There Bill encounters boggle-eyed tarsiers, monkeys with Mohican hairstyles and spectacular birds of paradise on his mission to understand how Wallace devised the theory of evolution independently of Charles Darwin

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: The story of the Nazi quest to establish an Aryan race, which set out to subjugate the Jewish population with decrees and laws about citizenship and escalated to the use of execution camps and the horrors of the Holocaust. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: Chronicling the events that brought about the demise of the Third Reich, as the Allies arrived at the gates of Berlin and Hitler boarded himself up in his bunker, where it is believed he committed suicide. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: How Japan's early victories over Allied forces during the Second World War convinced its people that their strength and discipline would bring them victory. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: The Allied offensive in the Pacific, where America's two-pronged attack led to heavy casualties on both sides, as the Japanese mounted a ferocious defence. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo reaches London on his rail journey from Warwick to Rye in East Sussex. In Ealing, he is transformed for the silver screen by expert hair and make-up, before travelling to Fulham, where he heads underground to explore London's new super sewer. Then, Michael visits the London School of Economics and Political Science in central London, before finally arriving in Kensington

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo journeys from Piccadilly Circus to Gravesend, visiting an exotic West End store that was popular among Victorian women and hearing how a Russian ballet company took London by storm in 1909. He also discovers the origins of netball and gymslips at North Kent College and meets the pilots of the Port of London Authority, founded in the early 20th century

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo heads from Warwick to Rye in East Sussex. In the orchards of East Malling, Kent, Michael discovers how the Edwardians' serious attitude towards cultivation bears fruit even now. In Folkestone, he hears how the town coped with an influx of more than 100,000 refugees fleeing the German invasion in 1914. In the High Weald, Michael heads for Tenterden Town and the light railway that opened in 1900. His final stop is the medieval Cinque Port of Rye, where he tours the home and garden of author Henry James

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the Britain of the 1930s as he sets out on another adventure. Beginning just outside Newcastle in Jarrow, Michael uncovers the desperation that led 200 men to march 300 miles to Westminster in order to petition the government for work. The first leg of his journey ends Spennymoor, Co Durham, where he meets the son of a miner who became one of the most famous 20th-century artists of the region

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is in Northumbria en route to the Highlands, heading to Kielder Forest to discover what lay behind a national initiative to plant one of the largest manmade woodlands in Europe. Crossing the border to Scotland, Michael arrives in the weaving town of Hawick to visit Lovat Mill, where, in the 1930s, tweed was big business, and also goes to the movies, sitting in the front stalls at the Dominion cinema in Morningside

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Following the route of the old Caledonian Railway Company, Michael Portillo discovers the 'Riviera of the Highlands'. With a daily direct train service to Kings Cross, Gleneagles remains a top destination and is also headquarters for the British School of Falconry. Berry Town, aka Blairgowrie, is Michael's next stop. At the home of the Scottish raspberry industry, which once sent fruit to London daily on board a raspberry special service from Cooper Angus station, Michael learns how to pick this most delicate of berries. The last stop on this leg is the city of Dundee, where he visits publisher DC Thomson

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo completes his rail journey through 1930s Britain, beginning in Norfolk at the headquarters of an international horse welfare organisation. In Peterborough, he visits a tidal defence barrier that helped save the city from flooding, while in Lincolnshire crosses the point at which the Mallard broke the speed record for a steam-powered locomotive in 1938. After a spell in the coastal town of Skegness, Michael's journey ends at RAF Coningsby where he sees some iconic Second World War aircraft, before witnessing a dazzling display featuring the RAF's latest combat aircraft

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's railway journey reaches Greater Manchester, where he celebrates new beginnings for the nation in the years after the Second World War. At Trafford General Hospital, he investigates the birth of the National Health Service. A retired physiotherapist recalls her part in the historic event of July 5, 1948. Coronation Star tells Michael about the first episode of the soap, broadcast live in 1960. And at the city's Science and Industry Museum, the presenter encounters a replica of the Baby, which was created in 1948 - the first machine in the world to run a stored program and the forerunner of all modern computers

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his rail journey along the Upper Mississippi to Red Wing, Minnesota, and the home of Laura Ingalls Wilder, author of Little House on the Prairie. programme.desc: When the body of windsurfer Andrew Bilton washes ashore on Beadnell Bay, Rose and Joe are pulled into a murky case involving the intertwined worlds of funerals, windsurfing and dangerous spiked cigarettes

programme.desc: Three generations of the same family need help from Jules Hudson to find them a new, rural Norfolk home. They have £800,000 available for a four-bedroom house, an annexe for Granny and enough land for a Shetland pony. Jules also needs a keen eye to spot some of the world's rarest - and most camera-shy - species of deer and antelope at a local safari park

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: York Minster is one of the UK's most magnificent cathedrals, boasting the world's largest expanse of medieval stained glass. However, the stonework of this glorious gothic monument is crumbling away on a daily basis. Dominic Chinea and Will Kirk join the new generation of stonemasons being trained to save it, harnessing modern technology while still using centuries-old skills

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which William, Nicky, Abz, Chris and Charlotte race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless

programme.desc: The Radio 2 presenter embarks on a nearly 400-mile cycle across five days and all four UK nations to raise money for Children in Need.
