programme.title: Return to Paradise
programme.desc: The anniversary screening of Dolphin Cove cult horror film Blood Wave goes off with a literal bang when one of its key creatives is killed during the iconic gunshot sequence, Mack and Glenn investigate how the killer fired a gun in front of a packed cinema without the audience realising

programme.title: Have I Got News for You
programme.desc: Kelly Cates hosts, with comedian Maisie Adam and journalist Krishnan Guru-Murthy joining team captains Ian Hislop and Paul Merton as they delve into the news

programme.title: Bill's Included
programme.desc: When Bill's wife walks out on him for the gardener, he's left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students. Bill is thrilled to meet his new housemates - Christian, Zahra, Hettie, and James - but when Christian keeps leaving the fridge door open, he has to come up with a scheme to get it shut without ruining his image as a relaxed, fun landlord. Comedy, starring Rob Brydon

programme.title: BBC News at Ten
programme.desc: A round-up of today's headlines

programme.title: The Graham Norton Show
programme.desc: Together on Graham's sofa are Hollywood legend Robert De Niro and comedy great Ben Stiller, reunited in Focker-in-Law; Oscar winner Michelle Yeoh, talking about her new TV series Bladerunner 2099; and top chef Jamie Oliver, whose latest book is 20-Minute Meals. With music from Take That, performing their current single, Higher

programme.title: Fall
programme.desc: Survival thriller starring Grace Caroline Currey and Virginia Gardner. Lapsed climbing enthusiast Becky is persuaded by best friend Hunter to ascend a super-tall TV mast out in the Mojave Desert. When they reach the antenna mount, though, the tower's ladder collapses, leaving them stranded at the top without any means to call for help.

programme.title: Past Lives
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Greta Lee and Teo Yoo. Young South Korean friends Nora and Hae Sung lose touch when Nora's family moves to Canada. Years later, Nora is living in New York and gets in contact with Hae Sung over the internet. Video calls become an important part of their lives, until communication is again lost. Twelve years on, Hae Sung takes a trip to the States and the pair are reunited, but will their childhood connection still be strong?

programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: A BBC Children in Need edition celebrating deaf children and families, with inspiring stories, a fun lip-reading challenge and the power of community

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: The remaining chefs compete in the quarter-final, beginning with an invention test in which they must use saffron to embellish their dish. The cooks then serve a two-course meal for three of the country's leading food writers and critics, Leyla Kazim, Xanthe Clay and David Ellis

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Irish actor Chris O'Dowd joins Bill Murray and his friend Tom Coyne for a lively round of golf, with enthusiasm occasionally outstripping ability. Away from the fairways, a traditional rambling house takes Bill outside his comfort zone as he explores Ireland's rich storytelling traditions. Later, in a packed Irish pub, the music starts - and staying on the sidelines proves impossible

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A rookie Derbyshire developer admits he's winging it, while in Bournemouth, Martin Roberts is stunned by the building he's in. Jacqui Joseph is in a Norfolk village called Little Snoring, but there's no time for her to take a nap with a property to see

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Briony May Williams helps discerning house hunters from a town in Kent relocate to the quieter countryside of Norfolk and Suffolk. With three dogs and an impressive collection of cars and motorcycles, there's plenty to accommodate. So finding a home that's not too big, not too small, but just right proves quite the challenge. Briony also pulls on her waders in the River Waveney to discover what's being done to keep its waters clean for wild swimmers

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul Bob head to Co Durham to fish for a rare species of wild brown trout in the River Tees. They navigate the area through the lens of a six-year-old Bob as he takes Paul on a trip along the landscapes of his youth and reminisces about the fishing trips he used to go on with his. Later, their old friend Reece Shearsmith joins them for dinner, and he has some particularly spooky local tales to tell them about the Tees

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Through interviews with world-class experts in quantum technologies, Hannah looks at the international quantum arms race between the US and China

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Political Thinking with Nick Robinson
programme.desc: The journalist in conversation with people who influence our political thinking about what has shaped theirs

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Colleagues from Colchester Zoo Lizzie, Kez, Mo and Sue compete for money by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher explores the annual Neath Food and Drink Festival and finds out whether traditional or gourmet Welsh cakes are more popular among the visitors. Food journalist Leyla Kazim reveals the secrets of growing tomatoes on a large or small scale farmer Jim Smith gets stuck into making marmalade and Ryan Hand tries an experiment to find out whether there is such a thing as brain food

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: From Britain's northernmost station at Thurso in Caithness, Michael Portillo heads for the ferry port of Scrabster to cross the Pentland Firth to the Orkney Islands. Passing the Old Man of Hoy, Michael takes in stunning views of the Orkney archipelago and the rugged coastlines of its 70 islands

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: Adam takes a gamble and leaves the English Channel in the hope of finding Dover sole, one of the most expensive fish in British waters, to help cover his rising financial issues. Up in Scotland, Stephen breaks from the rest of the fleet for some solo fishing but heads towards some stormy weather, leaving him with a decision to make

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team look at more rarities, this time from Coughton Court in Warwickshire. Among the finds are a Japanese depiction of dancing skeletons, a design from a leading British graphic artist and a previously lost masterpiece. First shown in 2005

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Charlie Ross and Thomas Plant value antiques at the Fleet Air Arm Museum in Yeovilton, Somerset, while Paul Martin finds out about one of Europe's largest helicopter squadrons

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Michael Sheen asks the questions on Double Points Friday. Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding hope they have what it takes to win the day's challenges, and be the week's overall victor

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Analysis of the couples' progress as they prepare for tomorrow night's show. Including reports from the studio rehearsals and interviews with celebrity fans

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events with Matt Chorley

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Investigating some of nature's biggest mysteries

programme.title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
programme.desc: Monty Don celebrates the rewards of winter gardening, sharing ideas, inspiration and timely jobs to keep gardeners busy now, while reminding viewers that warmer days lie ahead. At Longmeadow, he has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment, where there is always plenty to do during the colder months, including some clever composting.

programme.title: World Championship Boxing
programme.desc: Lauren Price v Michaela Kotaskova. Catrin Heledd presents live coverage of the bout for the IBF, IBO and WBC World Welterweight titles, held at Utilita Arena Cardiff. Home favourite Price won Olympic gold in 2020 and is undefeated in her 10 professional contests, outpointing Stephanie Pineiro last time out. Her Czech opponent has a respectable record of 12 wins, two draws and just one defeat, but it would be a major upset should she take Price's belts this evening

programme.title: The Dead Don't Hurt
programme.desc: Western starring Vicky Krieps and Viggo Mortensen. In 1860s America, French-Canadian Vivienne and Danish immigrant Holger decide to make a life together in the wilds of Nevada. However, the Civil War takes Holger away, leaving Vivienne to deal with the corrupt local landowner and his violent, sadistic son.

programme.title: Crime in Progress
programme.desc: A routine traffic stop turns critical and an officer suddenly loses contact in New Mexico

programme.title: Peterloo
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Rory Kinnear and Maxine Peake. In the late 1810s, the Industrial Revolution creates new challenges for Britain's working class. When a Manchester family get involved in the emerging radical political movement, interest swells around noted orator Henry Hunt, and events build to a protest that turns deadly - and alters the country's history for ever.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off: Second Helpings
programme.desc: Jon Richardson, Judi Love and their guests look back at the highlights of another week in the tent, which saw the contestants tackling patisserie dishes in their fight to win through to the final. The presenters celebrate the standout moments and serve up their take on the episode's biggest talking points and best bakes

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Four cooks from Warwickshire compete for the £1,000 prize. Former Miss Rugby Jade Hollis, film and TV extra Susan Gillis, recruitment boss Lee Bunting and academic Alan James take turns hosting dinner parties. Alan begins with a challenging menu featuring slow-cooked sweet and sour mackerel, and as the week progresses, tension mounts between the women, leaving the men bemused

programme.title: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It
programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer are in Larne in Northern Ireland with Catherine and Nigel Finch, who have been married for seven years, but lately have hit a spot of turbulence due to their dated, 1970s-style bungalow. Nigel quickly fell for their rural location's incredible views, but Catherine has never loved the place and misses having neighbours, so Phil searches for a home that pleases them both, offering room for Nigel's beloved chickens, while giving Catherine more people around her

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: The gang declares war on the staff of rival bar Gary's Old Town Tavern, who have taken the liberty of stealing a prized trophy from Cheers. Ted Danson and George Wendt star

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam and Woody make a bet that they can kiss Rebecca before midnight.

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Carrie reminisces about meeting Doug, recalling how she was originally paired off with Richie, while he was with her friend Lynn. Donny Osmond guest stars, with Kevin James and Leah Remini

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug and Carrie are torn between their new friends and their best friends

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: After being bombarded with subtle hints, Carrie throws a surprise party to celebrate Arthur's 75th birthday, roping in a reluctant Doug to take the old man out for the day. However, when the pair visit Arthur's favourite restaurant for lunch, he slopes off

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Is Ray right to be sceptical when Frank uncharacteristically displays a keen interest in his work?

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra and Ray make their wills, but struggle to pick guardians for the children. They finally manage to decide - but not everyone is happy about the arrangement. Comedy, starring Ray Romano

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra's hippy sister turns up unexpectedly at the house to announce that she has decided to become a nun

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Bubbly co-host Dr Mary joins Frasier to present a Christmas parade, but he is forced to take drastic action when she steals his limelight. Comedy, starring Kelsey Grammer and David Hyde Pierce

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: The Seattle shrink finds out he is going to receive a lifetime achievement award, but a letter of congratulations from his mentor plunges him into an emotional crisis. Comedy, starring Kelsey Grammer

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: The Seattle shrink takes his teenage son Frederick on a camping trip with Martin in a bid to rebuild their relationship. Comedy, starring Kelsey Grammer and John Mahoney

programme.desc: After relying on the American Automobile Association one time too many, Frasier and Niles take a car maintenance class, but soon find themselves in trouble when their lack of mechanical skill prompts them to act like unruly child. programme.desc: In Cornwall, Anouska and Greig transform a basement storeroom into a beautiful guest bedroom. In North Lincolnshire, Lucy and Seb are on a mission to see if their sweeping staircase can be saved, and in Shropshire, Alan and Catherine cook up an al fresco living space

programme.title: Help! We Bought a Village

programme.title: Four in a Bed

However, despite a fusillade of rockets, the ship turned away. Within two hours, 1,500 people were dead. An American investigation at the time accused the SS Californian, even though the freighter was stationary that night. A British inquiry concurred, keen to shift blame from national failures on lifeboat provision and steamship supervision. However, since Titanic's wreck was discovered, the mystery began to unlock, and now, with recently discovered clues, a new suspect has emerged: the SS Mount Temple. This documentary follows a range of experts, using the latest investigative tools, as they examine these new clues and revisit the evidence from 1912 to take a fresh look at the cold case of the 20th century

programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: Finding Your Feet
programme.desc: Romantic comedy drama starring Imelda Staunton, Celia Imrie and Timothy Spall. When snobbish Sandra discovers her lawyer husband has been unfaithful, she moves in with her estranged sister, Bif. But Bif's free-spirited lifestyle is at odds with the comfort and privilege that Sandra is used to.

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: Historical satire starring Steve Buscemi and Simon Russell Beale. In the immediate aftermath of Joseph Stalin's death in 1953, his cabinet jockey for position in the hope of becoming the next Soviet leader. As they argue over everything from funeral arrangements to the fate of the dictator's offspring, the divided government struggles to maintain order.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Satirical comedy starring Ben Stiller as Derek Zoolander, the vain, self-absorbed king of the male-modelling world. But Zoolander's fame and fortune are threatened when he's brainwashed into assassinating an eminent statesman whose proposed new child-labour laws would spell disaster for the fashion industry.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Will Ferrell. Ron Burgundy is the top newsreader at a San Diego TV station in the 1970s. But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Will Ferrell and Steve Carell. After a disastrous move to New York in which he became estranged from his co-anchor wife and was fired from his job, anchorman Ron Burgundy is hired by a ruthless network executive to work the graveyard shift on the world's first 24-hour rolling news channel.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Womanising vet Henry Roth ditches his playboy lifestyle after falling for the charming Lucy. But a car crash has left her with severe short term memory loss, meaning that Henry has to romance her all over again every day in the hope that eventually she'll remember him.

programme.title: American Pie 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Jason Biggs. The randy students return for another summer of sexual misadventures following their first year at college.

programme.title: Hitch
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Smith and Eva Mendes. Alex "Hitch" Hitchens is a professional and deliberately anonymous New York "date doctor" who helps male clients woo the women of their dreams. But his success leads to trouble when tenacious gossip columnist Sara Melas decides to unmask him.

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Fantasy horror comedy starring Bruce Campbell and Embeth Davidtz. The second sequel to the original Evil Dead finds Ash back in medieval times and desperate to return to the present. But to do so, it means having to take up arms against an army of familiar old foes.

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Kerwin Mathews. Blown off course to the monster-infested island of Colossa, Sinbad and his crew rescue a sorcerer from the clutches of a cyclops. The voyage continues to Baghdad, but the sorcerer has been forced to leave stolen property behind, and hatches a wicked plan to force Sinbad to return to Colossa.

programme.title: Shenandoah
programme.desc: Western starring James Stewart and Doug McClure. Loner Charlie Anderson keeps his family out of the Civil War, even though there is fighting a few miles from his Virginia farm. But when his new son-in-law joins the Confederate army and his youngest son is captured by Federal troops, Charlie finds he can no longer ignore the conflict.

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda and Oliver Platt. After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Tommy Lee Jones and Will Smith. When a New York police officer is recruited by a top-secret agency that monitors alien activity he finds himself in a race against time to save the Earth from destruction.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Monster horror starring Matthew Broderick and Jean Reno. When a Japanese vessel is sunk in the South Pacific and enormous footprints are discovered in Panama, a team of scientists is brought in to investigate. But radiation expert Niko Tatopoulos has his own theory - nuclear bomb tests have mutated a lizard to gigantic proportions and Manhattan is now under threat.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni and Morgan Freeman. A reporter believes that she has discovered a sex scandal in the US government. As it turns out, "Ele" isn't a mistress, but something used to describe an event so cataclysmic that it could destroy the planet.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: James Cameron's science-fiction action thriller sequel to The Terminator, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Linda Hamilton. Tormented by the imminent threat of a nuclear holocaust from which intelligent machines will emerge to crush the last vestiges of human existence, Sarah Connor has been institutionalised and separated from her son. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. However, the machines of 2029 know it too, and once again they send a cyborg assassin back through time to terminate the potential saviour.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: Black comedy action horror starring Harvey Keitel, George Clooney, Quentin Tarantino and Juliette Lewis. Fleeing the law, two murderous brothers kidnap a priest and his family, driving the priest's Winnebago south for a rendezvous at a lowlife bar in Mexico. Little do they know that the bar's staff and regulars hide a blood-drenched secret.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: After his son is killed, a father abducts the child responsible, hell-bent on revenge. Writer/Director Evan Ari Kelman's thriller, starring Hamish Linklater, Tramell Tillman and Brittany Snow

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: All the Devils Are Here
programme.desc: Secluded in the middle of Dartmoor, four thieves hide out with nothing to do but count the money and kill time. Thriller, starring Eddie Marsan, Sam Claflin and Burn Gorman

programme.title: Hallow Road
programme.desc: Two parents are thrust into a desperate race against time after a late-night call from their daughter reveals she caused a devastating car accident. Director Babak Anvari's psychological thriller, starring Rosamund Pike and Matthew Rhys

programme.title: King Ivory
programme.desc: Tulsa narcotics cop Layne West is locked in a battle with the city's criminal underworld. When his son becomes addicted to fentanyl, West teams up with his partner Ty and FBI agent Beatty to bring down those responsible. Thriller, starring James Badge Dale and Ben Foster

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Thriller starring Ben Affleck and Charlize Theron. When ex-con Rudy Duncan impersonates a former cellmate who has apparently been killed in prison, it leads him into a dangerous game involving the dead man's beautiful pen friend and her ruthless brother.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller, directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his assistant Dr John Watson think they have seen the back of serial killer Lord Blackwood. But when the evil occultist apparently comes back from the dead, they are once again drawn into a dangerous game.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his trusty assistant Dr Watson are once again drawn into a battle of wits with arch nemesis Professor Moriarty. And this time the evil genius's plan could spell disaster for the whole of Europe.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantino's award-winning, multi-stranded crime drama, starring John Travolta, Samuel L Jackson and Uma Thurman. Downtown LA: lovebirds Honey Bunny and Pumpkin plan to hold up a diner. Washed-up boxer Butch is paid to throw his last fight, but has other ideas. "Fixer" the Wolf has to get hitmen Vincent and Jules out of a sticky situation. And Vincent is nervous when he has to escort his boss's wife for the night - with good reason.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: The Choral
programme.desc: A choral society's male members enlist in the First World War, leaving the demanding Dr Guthrie to recruit teenagers and experience the joy of singing. Writer Alan Bennett's comedy drama, starring Ralph Fiennes, Roger Allam and Mark Addy

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Eleanor the Great
programme.desc: After a devastating loss, sharp-witted, defiant 94-year-old Eleanor Morgenstein tells a story that spirals into a dangerous reality. Director Scarlett Johansson's drama, starring June Squibb, Erin Kellyman and Chiwetel Ejiofor

programme.title: Tommy
programme.desc: Ken Russell's satirical adaptation of the rock opera written by Pete Townshend and the Who, starring Roger Daltrey, Oliver Reed and Ann-Margret. A few months after her husband goes missing during the Second World War, Nora Walker gives birth to a son whom she names Tommy. Later, the boy is rendered deaf, dumb and blind and all efforts to cure Tommy fail. However, his life is transformed when he discovers pinball.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.title: Eleanor the Great

Later, the boy is rendered deaf, dumb and blind and all efforts to cure Tommy fail. However, his life is transformed when he discovers pinball.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Biographical musical drama starring Taron Egerton and Jamie Bell. From the safety of an addiction rehab group, a flamboyantly dressed man recalls the highs and lows of his childhood and transformation from talented young pianist Reggie Dwight into global superstar Elton John.

programme.title: The Choral
programme.desc: A choral society's male members enlist in the First World War, leaving the demanding Dr Guthrie to recruit teenagers and experience the joy of singing. Writer Alan Bennett's comedy drama, starring Ralph Fiennes, Roger Allam and Mark Addy

programme.title: Hamnet
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Jessie Buckley and Paul Mescal. In 16th century Stratford-upon-Avon, Agnes Hathaway and aspiring playwright Will Shakespeare fall in love, marry and have three children. Over the years, Will grows increasingly absent from the family as he pursues his career in London. Eventually, the couple suffers a terrible loss that each processes separately, though Will's latest play offers possible catharsis.

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Drama starring Tom Hanks, Denzel Washington and Jason Robards. Andrew Beckett's career at a prestigious law firm appears to be taking off. But Beckett hasn't revealed to his employers that he is gay or that he is HIV positive. When Beckett is suddenly sacked after falling ill, he contacts lawyer Joe Miller in a bid to sue the company for wrongful dismissal.

programme.title: Weapons
programme.desc: Mystery horror starring Josh Brolin and Julia Garner, with Amy Madigan. A small town is rocked when 17 children from the same school class disappear overnight. Their teacher, Justine, becomes the unofficial prime suspect, with devastated father Archer among those leading the charge against her. But this mass vanishing is only the start of the strange and violent happenings that come to plague the community.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

programme.title: Bone Lake
programme.desc: A couple's holiday is upended when they're forced to share a mansion with a mysterious couple, spiralling into a maze of sex, lies and manipulation. Comedy thriller, starring Alex Roe and Maddie Hasson

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Bugonia
programme.desc: Satirical thriller starring Emma Stone and Jesse Plemons. Conspiracy theorist Teddy and his impressionable cousin Don kidnap biomedical company CEO Michelle and chain her up in the basement of their rural home. Over the next few days, Teddy proceeds to interrogate and torture Michelle in the hope of forcing a simple confession: that she is an emissary from a hostile extraterrestrial race and can take him to her leader.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Amy Adams and Jeremy Renner. After 12 alien spacecraft land in locations around the world, linguistics professor Louise Banks is called in to try to decipher the visitors' language and open a line of communication. Do they come in peace or is humankind on the brink of war?

programme.title: District 9
programme.desc: Sci-fi action drama starring Sharlto Copley. Nearly thirty years after aliens landed near Johannesburg, the extraterrestrial visitors are living in a squalid refugee camp called District 9. With the initial welcoming attitude of the human population long since faded, the order is given for the space visitors to be forcibly evicted. For one man, the operation will be a life-changing experience.

programme.title: Star Trek: Generations
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and featuring William Shatner. When an evil alien threatens to destroy a star system along with millions of lives, Captain Jean-Luc Picard travels into a time vortex to enlist the help of his famous predecessor, James T Kirk.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Patrick Stewart. During a Federation encounter with the Borg, a sphere escapes into the Earth's past via a temporal vortex. Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise take up the challenge to pursue the Federation's most fearsome enemy and stop them from changing the future.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and Jonathan Frakes. The planet Ba'ku holds magical properties that keep the population young and living in harmony. So when an alien race attempts to take over this paradise, it falls to Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise to defend the planet and its people.

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure - the tenth entry in the franchise - starring Patrick Stewart. The crew of the Enterprise are on the verge of splitting up, following the wedding of Riker and Troi, when they are sent to investigate a suspect Romulan treaty. On arrival, they discover that the new leader of Romulus is the spitting image of Captain Picard.

programme.title: X.
programme.desc: Horror starring Mia Goth, Jenna Ortega and Brittany Snow. The cast and crew of an adult film show up at the remote farm that they have booked for their shoot. But something weird is going on with the farm's elderly owners, and bodies soon start to pile up...

programme.title: Infinity Pool
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror starring Alexander Skarsgård and Mia Goth. Struggling writer James and his wife take a break in Li Tolqa, a seaside paradise with strict local laws. After he is lured beyond the limits of the resort by the mysterious Gabi, James accidentally kills a man while driving. When he is arrested, he is given a bizarre choice: face execution or send his own clone to the slaughter in his stead.

programme.title: Hell and High Water
programme.desc: Action spy drama starring Richard Widmark. A scientist who's concerned about the US government's preparedness for nuclear war hires a submarine captain to lead a search for communist weaponry in the north Pacific.

programme.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: War drama starring Ingrid Bergman and Gary Cooper. American adventurer Robert Jordan joins a motley band of guerrillas fighting for the Republic in the Spanish Civil War, but his love affair with the tempestuous Maria imperils his companions.

programme.title: The Caine Mutiny
programme.desc: Courtroom drama based on Herman Wouk's Pulitzer Prize-winning novel, starring Humphrey Bogart as martinet skipper Philip Queeg who's put in charge of the naval minesweeper Caine. But the strain of maintaining discipline among his restless crew begins to affect his ability to command.

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: Epic drama starring Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins and Aidan Quinn. Three brothers, Alfred, Samuel and Tristan, are raised by their ex-cavalry father on a remote ranch near the Montana Rockies. Their lifestyle is irreversibly changed when Samuel brings home his beautiful fiancée, Susannah, and the brothers decide to join the army to fight in the First World War.

programme.desc: Writer/director Martin McDonagh and cast discuss the Film4-produced political comedy thriller Wild Horse Nine.

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Sci-fi action prequel starring Amber Midthunder and Dane DiLiegro. Eighteenth-century Comanche healer Naru wishes to hunt and fight like the men in her tribe. When a mysterious entity that leaves strange tracks begins to attack the local wildlife, Naru has a chance to prove herself - but this predator is unlike anything on Earth...

programme.title: Pearl
programme.desc: Period horror starring Mia Goth. In 1918, Texas farm girl Pearl yearns to be a star of stage and screen, but her strict mother disapproves of such dreams. When Pearl hears about a local audition for a touring dance troupe, her single-minded ambition bubbles over into a rage that proves murderous.

programme.title: Things to Do in Denver When You're Dead
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Andy Garcia. His business in deep trouble, reformed criminal Jimmy "the Saint" Tosnia agrees to come out of retirement to pull off a lucrative one-off job for his ex-boss. He assembles a misfit band of former cronies, but the job goes disastrously wrong and Jimmy and his associates find themselves in a deadly game of hide-and-seek.

programme.desc: After a couple of previous high stakes assignments, security expert Ray Breslin is hired to rescue the kidnapped daughter of a Hong Kong tech mogul from a formidable Latvian prison. programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean (Puffin Rock)

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc:

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc:
Leis mar a chaidh sgrùdadh na sgoile an-uiridh, tha bòrd na sgoile air Leas-Cheannard ùr, Ms Dallas, a thoirt a-steach gus sùil ghèir a chumail air Mgr Mackle. Bidh sinn a' coinneachadh ri tidsearean ùra agus ri feadhainn air a bheil sinn air eòlas a chuir roimhe.
After last year's school inspection, the school board has appointed a new deputy head, Ms Dallas, to keep an eye on Mr Mackle. We meet new teachers alongside some recognisable personalities.

programme.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
programme.desc:

Abigail's bagels are a very special and tasty brunch or lunch, or anytime experience, satisfying to the extreme and just the thing to share with family and friends.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

They have £800,000 available for a four-bedroom house, an annexe for Granny and enough land for a Shetland pony. Jules also needs a keen eye to spot some of the world's rarest - and most camera-shy - species of deer and antelope at a local safari park

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: York Minster is one of the UK's most magnificent cathedrals, boasting the world's largest expanse of medieval stained glass. However, the stonework of this glorious gothic monument is crumbling away on a daily basis. Dominic Chinea and Will Kirk join the new generation of stonemasons being trained to save it, harnessing modern technology while still using centuries-old skills

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which William, Nicky, Abz, Chris and Charlotte race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless

programme.title: Owain Wyn Evans' Four Nations Challenge for Children in Need
programme.desc: The Radio 2 presenter embarks on a nearly 400-mile cycle across five days and all four UK nations to raise money for Children in Need. Starting in Glasgow, Owain passes through Scotland, Northern Ireland and north-west England before finishing in central Cardiff and along the way he meets some inspirational children and their families whose lives have been transformed by projects funded by the charity

programme.title: Return to Paradise

programme.title: Bill's Included
programme.desc: When Bill's wife walks out on him for the gardener, he's left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students. Bill is thrilled to meet his new housemates - Christian, Zahra, Hettie, and James - but when Christian keeps leaving the fridge door open, he has to come up with a scheme to get it shut without ruining his image as a relaxed, fun landlord. Comedy, starring Rob Brydon

programme.desc: Survival thriller starring Grace Caroline Currey and Virginia Gardner. Lapsed climbing enthusiast Becky is persuaded by best friend Hunter to ascend a super-tall TV mast out in the Mojave Desert. programme.title: Past Lives
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Greta Lee and Teo Yoo. Young South Korean friends Nora and Hae Sung lose touch when Nora's family moves to Canada. Years later, Nora is living in New York and gets in contact with Hae Sung over the internet. Video calls become an important part of their lives, until communication is again lost. Twelve years on, Hae Sung takes a trip to the States and the pair are reunited, but will their childhood connection still be strong?

programme.desc: The remaining chefs compete in the quarter-final, beginning with an invention test in which they must use saffron to embellish their dish. The cooks then serve a two-course meal for three of the country's leading food writers and critics, Leyla Kazim, Xanthe Clay and David Ellis

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Irish actor Chris O'Dowd joins Bill Murray and his friend Tom Coyne for a lively round of golf, with enthusiasm occasionally outstripping ability. Away from the fairways, a traditional rambling house takes Bill outside his comfort zone as he explores Ireland's rich storytelling traditions. Later, in a packed Irish pub, the music starts - and staying on the sidelines proves impossible

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A rookie Derbyshire developer admits he's winging it, while in Bournemouth, Martin Roberts is stunned by the building he's in. Jacqui Joseph is in a Norfolk village called Little Snoring, but there's no time for her to take a nap with a property to see

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Briony May Williams helps discerning house hunters from a town in Kent relocate to the quieter countryside of Norfolk and Suffolk. With three dogs and an impressive collection of cars and motorcycles, there's plenty to accommodate. So finding a home that's not too big, not too small, but just right proves quite the challenge. Briony also pulls on her waders in the River Waveney to discover what's being done to keep its waters clean for wild swimmers

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul Bob head to Co Durham to fish for a rare species of wild brown trout in the River Tees. They navigate the area through the lens of a six-year-old Bob as he takes Paul on a trip along the landscapes of his youth and reminisces about the fishing trips he used to go on with his. Later, their old friend Reece Shearsmith joins them for dinner, and he has some particularly spooky local tales to tell them about the Tees

Passing the Old Man of Hoy, Michael takes in stunning views of the Orkney archipelago and the rugged coastlines of its 70 islands

programme.desc: Eric Casaburi, a former undercover boss, invites six other employers who also appeared incognito on the show to talk about their experiences of the programme at a restaurant. However, little do they realise that Eric is going to try to fool them by appearing as a waiter. Featuring Kat Cole, Paul Damico, Andy Wiederhorn, Sheldon Yellen, Anthony Wedo and Jane Grote Abell

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: The first hosts in Bournemouth are confident Nikki and Steve, who've been together for 20 years. Accountant Peter and retired flight attendant Lyn hope that their hosting experience and a surprise can secure them the win. Later, the youngest hosts in the group, Nicki and Emily, serve up a vegan menu

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Married couple David and AJ kick off the competition in Bornemouth, Dorset, with a menu inspired by David's homeland of South Africa. Brazilian-born Vinnie and his partner Alex cook up three South American dishes. Finally, perfectionist Andrea bosses her husband Wayne around the kitchen while preparing her Vietnamese menu. However, Andrea's home-made brandy snaps fail to go to plan

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Groom-to-be Dele is given £12,000 and three weeks to plan the perfect wedding for his fiancee Tracy. After a 15-year engagement, Tracy is seeking nothing less than her dream of a romantic castle as the venue for her big day, but Dele seems more concerned about arranging a ceremony with a dramatic twist - inspired by his favourite soap opera

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Comic book-loving groom Anthony wants to prove he can be a real superhero to bride-to-be Lauren, by organising a comic-inspired wedding in a cave. However, with Lauren hoping for a traditional affair, Anthony has his work cut out to convince her family that his theme will prove successful

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: In West Covina, Rene brings Gunter for moral support, but gets annoyed when the older German refuses to take sides. Darrell stumbles over what may be a diamond in the rough, while Brandi and Jarrod discover a different national pastime

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The buyers head to Thousand Oaks for the next set of auctions. Justin sinks his money into a unit with an interesting pair, Dave pushes Mary to the breaking point, while Kenny finds the time to make a nice profit piece by piece

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Jose Costa, the president of North Carolina-based automotive-care franchise Maaco, goes undercover to join his employees on the frontline, disguised as a food truck owner competing in a reality show. He wants to meet the staff who keep the firm on the road to success and find out whether his franchisees are following guidelines

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Gina Rivera, the president of Phenix Salon Suites in Colorado Springs - a company that rents boutiques to hairdressers, nail technicians and beauty therapists - goes incognito to see first-hand what she needs to improve on and what makes her franchisees successful

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Viewers' home video clips, including birds causing bother, strong winds wreaking havoc, and a boy giving his mum tips on how to flirt

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Back in Montebello, Brandi and her buddy set the wayback machine and discover a roaring good time. Darrell makes the most of the little he's got, while Kenny fills his piggy bank, while courting an unfamiliar pastime

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Ivy brings his son to Moreno Valley, where good things always happen, and leaves with yo-yos of an unexpected kind. Rene and Casey discover that their shoes are more 'air' and less 'Jordan'. Kenny tries to level up his locker, while Lisa learns to look beyond the trash

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: Marina resolves to be less guarded in her love life, then regrets it. Tzarina and Lara are at loggerheads but with no one willing to apologise, they appear to be at a dead end

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay revisits three of the most difficult cases he has taken on since the series began. First, he returns to Cafe Hon in Baltimore, Maryland, where owner Denise Whiting was trapped in a nasty battle with the community and had threatened the locals with lawsuits. Next, the chef goes back to Chiarella's in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. When he first visited owners Tommy and Dina DeFino, the business was struggling so badly that Tommy had completely lost his confidence and wife Dina had lost her patience. On his final stop, Gordon travels to Leone's in Montclair, New Jersey, where Rose Leone was depending on her lazy son Michael to run the restaurant

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to the Olde Hitching Post in Hanson, Massachusetts, where he meets a stubborn owner who doesn't react well to criticism. Tom bought the restaurant for his daughter Andrea, but six years later he's still refusing to let her run it. Can the chef break Tom's iron grip on the business and persuade him to change his outdated approach?

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts as Sean Lock and Kevin Bridges take on guest captain Joe Wilkinson and Victoria Coren Mitchell in the words-and-numbers quiz. Doctor-turned-writer Adam Kay joins wordsmith Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while maths whizz Rachel Riley looks after the numbers

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, with Sean Lock and Roisin Conaty taking on guest captain Alan Carr and Joe Lycett. Susie Dent is joined by Spencer Jones in Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Sarah Kendall has set the early pace in the series, but fellow contestants Charlotte Ritchie, Jamali Maddix, Lee Mack and Mike Wozniak still have plenty of time to win points and emerge victorious. Alex Horne helps coax the contestants as they attempt to complete Greg Davies' tasks

An American investigation at the time accused the SS Californian, even though the freighter was stationary that night. programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick meets his good friend, the actor and comedian Barry Humphries, who fell in love with Cornwall in the 1960s when he escaped London to develop his famous character Dame Edna Everage. Barry talks about his friendship with British poet John Betjeman, and asks Rick to review his home-made fishcakes. Rick also goes fishing for crab, before cooking a simple yet delicious crab omelette. The host then takes a dip in the chilly north Atlantic with an eccentric group of wild water swimmers called the Perranporth Blue Tits

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick journeys inland from the majestic Camel Estuary to one of Britain's finest vineyards, where he joins in harvesting the grapes to discover that the Cornish weather is perfect making some of the best wine in the country. Just off Pentire Point, as the sun sets, Rick rides the gentle swell of the north Atlantic with an old friend, casting his line to hook Britain's fastest fish, before firing up the barbecue to cook his catch with a recipe inspired from a trip to Goa. Rick joins Tim Smit, best known for starting the hugely successful Eden Project, who reveals to Rick his new and ambitious idea in Cornwall

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick explores the Fowey Estuary, one of Cornwall's hidden secrets, joining a friend on a boat trip to learn about the history of the area and getting a unique view of the buildings along the riverbank. He discovers the area's history of piracy, meets a family that make award-winning vodka, and makes a pancake with a wild blackberry compote and Cornish clotted cream

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: On the wild north Atlantic coast, Rick heads out to sea to go fishing for lobsters with his old friend and celebrity chef Nathan Outlaw, before helping to cook up a lobster risotto. Later, at Tresillian House near Newquay, Rick meets with head gardener John Harris to find out more about his Victorian walled garden

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British
programme.desc: Si King and Dave Myers prepare dishes from their favourite cookery books, explaining their value as social documents that reveal a great deal about people and what they ate. The duo meet Ivan Day, who has one of the most extensive collections of recipe books in the UK, and share stories of renowned food writers such as Elizabeth David and Isabella Beeton

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys

programme.title: Battle Honours
programme.desc: The story of the longest-serving infantry division in the US Army, who fought in every major campaign in Western Europe in which American forces were engaged. Their unit badge is simply a '1' - and from it they have become known as 'the Big Red One', or the US 1st Infantry Division

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores how British rule led to armed rebellion in America, and a loyalty in Canada that lasted until the very end of the Empire. On Long Island, Michael visits The Brewster House, a former tavern where British soldiers met and talked freely during the Revolutionary War, unaware that it was run by George Washington's Culper Spy Ring. He also calls in at Fort Niagara, where he learns how the native peoples of North America saw their tribes and families torn apart as they picked sides, shedding blood on behalf of either the crown or the patriots

programme.title: Bill Bailey's Jungle Hero
programme.desc: Part one of two. The comedian heads to Indonesia to follow in the footsteps of Victorian naturalist Alfred Russel Wallace, who devised the theory of evolution through natural selection independently of Charles Darwin. Bill encounters orang-utans, flying frogs and extraordinary bugs on a mission to understand how Wallace came up with his idea, and tries to win him the recognition he deserves

programme.title: Bill Bailey's Jungle Hero

programme.title: How to Catch a Serial Killer
programme.desc:
The investigation into Christopher Halliwell by Detective Steve Fulcher has been one of the biggest crime stories in recent years, captivating the public's attention. Spanning more than a decade, multiple murders, two highly-publicized trials, and one irreparably damaged career, it is a story of the dogged pursuit of a serial killer by a police officer determined to get justice. From the moment the case of a missing 21-year-old girl named Sian O'Callaghan landed on the desk of DCI Fulcher, the hunt was on. Over the following five days came a game of cat-and-mouse of the utmost stakes, characterized by the relentless pursuit of a killer by a seasoned detective with decades on the force.
Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

The journalist also hears the remarkable story of Linda Darby who, after escaping from jail in 1972, spent the next 35 years on the run - before the law finally caught up with her

programme.desc: Henry and Simon visit Jim's vast barn in Leicestershire. Henry takes a risk on an old Ford Prefect, while Simon opts to upcycle three chicken feeders.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo completes his rail journey through 1930s Britain, beginning in Norfolk at the headquarters of an international horse welfare organisation. In Peterborough, he visits a tidal defence barrier that helped save the city from flooding, while in Lincolnshire crosses the point at which the Mallard broke the speed record for a steam-powered locomotive in 1938. After a spell in the coastal town of Skegness, Michael's journey ends at RAF Coningsby where he sees some iconic Second World War aircraft, before witnessing a dazzling display featuring the RAF's latest combat aircraft

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's railway journey reaches Greater Manchester, where he celebrates new beginnings for the nation in the years after the Second World War. At Trafford General Hospital, he investigates the birth of the National Health Service. A retired physiotherapist recalls her part in the historic event of July 5, 1948. Coronation Star tells Michael about the first episode of the soap, broadcast live in 1960. And at the city's Science and Industry Museum, the presenter encounters a replica of the Baby, which was created in 1948 - the first machine in the world to run a stored program and the forerunner of all modern computers

programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with his 1930s Bradshaw's guide, Michael Portillo sets out on another railway adventure as he explores Britain between the world wars. He begins with a tour of the Home Counties and beyond, starting in the city of Oxford, where in 1921 women were awarded degrees for the first time. At Somerville College, Michael finds out about pioneering crystallographer Dorothy Hodgkin, the only British woman to win a Nobel Prize in chemistry

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels by tram to the former cotton town of Oldham on the edge of the Peak District. Here he visits Oldham Coliseum, the town's Victorian repertory theatre, and hears about the lifting of censorship by the Lord Chamberlain's Office in the late 1960s. He then goes hiking before a visit to Sheffield, where he attends a knife-making workshop. He ends this part of his journey admiring the striking post-war sculptures of Barbara Hepworth at the Yorkshire Sculpture Park near Wakefield

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels through Milwaukee, a city on the shore of Lake Michigan, where he learns about the history of the iconic American Harley Davidson motorcycle. When Michael reaches the city of Illinois, he discovers how the modern day skyline of Chicago has replaced a largely wooden city which was destroyed by a great fire many years ago

Lennox Cato faces a puzzle when he appraises a pair of antique doors belonging to the local mosque and jewellery specialist Jon Benjamin gets his hands on the largest aquamarine he has ever seen

With 60 minutes on the clock and two medical-themed challenges to fulfil, both teams race around an antiques fair at Southwell Racecourse, Nottinghamshire. programme.title: The Dead Don't Hurt
programme.desc: Western starring Vicky Krieps and Viggo Mortensen. In 1860s America, French-Canadian Vivienne and Danish immigrant Holger decide to make a life together in the wilds of Nevada. However, the Civil War takes Holger away, leaving Vivienne to deal with the corrupt local landowner and his violent, sadistic son.

programme.title: The Predator in the Police
programme.desc: An investigation into Warren Arter, a former Metropolitan Police detective inspector who rose to lead a team investigating rape and sexual assault. He was entrusted with protecting women at their most vulnerable. Yet evidence and testimony gathered by the BBC suggest he exploited the authority and access his position gave him to groom and sexually abuse some of the very women who had turned to the police for help

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: As their shared enemy finally comes to light, Michael and the Phelans are forced to come together to survive. Meanwhile, a new trauma opens old wounds, pushing Diana towards a decision that will change everything

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Flutter buys a new fishy pet from slippery salesman Mervyn, but the Piripenguins get stuck in its gloopy slime. Can the friends find a solution to their sticky situation?

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Cosima takes over Dad's mission to film a unique underwater plant. But his special camera proves harder to operate than she'd thought, and Big Lizard keeps getting distracted.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy falls in love with a gold watch, but it belongs to the farmer

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Mr Friendlyface is acting very strangely indeed. He refuses to stamp any of Admin Bunny's documents, keeps getting distracted by butterflies, and seems oddly happy! The heroes are extremely suspicious and decide that someone must have swapped him with a doppelganger. Now they must quest to find out where the real Friendlyface is and get him back before the forest descends into total chaos.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay hands on an ancient console and Grizzy is transported into the game

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck and Frog are working at a supermarket alongside Toad and Flamingo, who keep ruining Duck and Frog's hard work to make them look bad. Why are they being so mean?

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons: Rising Hope
programme.desc: Roy, Crocalor and Kilowattrel take on Drayton in a spirited rematch

programme.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: The Winx indulge in a day of fun at the amusement park in Magixia but are suddenly attacked by Vexius. This time, however, they may be able to stop him with the help of unexpected allies...

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: Levi tries to keep the team calm for Social Media Day after Denise announces big changes. Jordan practices her cheer smile, and Melody works on an improved full-out.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Current affairs reports aimed at a younger audience

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: New presenter Leo takes to the skies in an incredible skydive challenge to earn his Blue Peter Badge - and could achieve a world record on his very first show

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall heads to Oman, where he abseils to a verreaux's eagle nest, tracks down wolves and swims alongside a superpod made up of over 100 dolphins

programme.title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
programme.desc: Monty Don celebrates the rewards of winter gardening, sharing ideas, inspiration and timely jobs to keep gardeners busy now, while reminding viewers that warmer days lie ahead. At Longmeadow, he has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment, where there is always plenty to do during the colder months, including some clever composting.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Investigating some of nature's biggest mysteries

programme.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
programme.desc: Anita pays a Christmas visit to Floella Benjamin. Together, they retrace Floella's journey as part of the Windrush generation and reflect on an extraordinary life shaped by faith and the festive season, from stage actor and iconic Play School presenter to businesswoman, child rights campaigner, dame and baroness, even playing a role in King Charles III's coronation

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: Setting out to bring in new livestock and expand the range of produce, the chef plans to bring in some ducks. But things aren't as simple as they seem as Marcus heads out onto the lake to create a new home for them

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya Hussain creates some easy celebration bakes, including a glittering meringue layer cake, a slow-cooked lamb curry fit for a feast, a traditional Eastern European sweet bread known as babka and an American inspired seafood extravaganza. She also meets award-winning macaron maker Naeem Mohamed, who shares his astonishing macaron stack cake

programme.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
programme.desc: Period comedy drama based on Oscar Wilde's play, starring Rupert Everett and Colin Firth. Landowner Jack Worthing has invented a younger brother called "Ernest" so he can escape his sober existence once in a while to visit his best friend Algernon and live the high life in London. Algernon, meanwhile, his curiosity roused by Jack's stories about his ward, Cecily, sets off for Shropshire as "Ernest" to meet the young lady.

programme.title: Strangers on a Train
programme.desc: Classic Hitchcock thriller starring Farley Granger, Ruth Roman and Robert Walker. An obsessive playboy strikes up a conversation with a tennis player he encounters on a train. The playboy, who hates his father, reveals to the sportsman that he knows of his wife's refusal to grant him a divorce and proposes a double murder to solve both their problems.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: In Morecambe, Lancashire, antiques experts Charles Hanson and Catherine Southon find treasures to take to auction including a vintage Rolex watch. Plus, presenter Paul Martin discovers the rags to riches story of the town's most famous son - Eric Morecambe

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Broadcasting legend Bob Harris and queen of motor sports Suzi Perry compete in a battle of antiques, while travelling across south east England. They're joined by Margie Cooper and Raj Bisram, both veteran road trippers and rivals to the core. Bob falls for a pair of champagne flutes in a love heart stand, while Suzy steps back in time when she discovers a Japanese glass fishing float

programme.title: The Eagle Has Landed
programme.desc: Second World War adventure starring Michael Caine, Donald Sutherland and Robert Duvall. In November 1943, the military authorities in Berlin receive a simple message, "The Eagle Has Landed". It is the start of a daring attempt by a small force of crack German paratroopers to kidnap the British prime minister, Winston Churchill.

programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 3
programme.desc: A collection of 40 rarely seen musical moments from the BBC archives, including Roachford on The Roland Rat Show, David Bowie on Friday Night with Jonathan Ross, and Mary J Blige appearing on Davina McCall's chat show Davina. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team breathe new life into three cherished heirlooms, reviving wonderful memories along with the items.
First through the barn doors are Emma Brookes and her mum Rosemary, with an incredible tale of wartime resistance. They have brought in Rosemary's father's homemade radio, which he used during the Nazi occupation of Jersey during the Second World War. In an attempt to control the flow of information, the Nazis confiscated all of the radios on the island, and anyone caught using one was in serious trouble. Undeterred, Rosemary's father hid his contraption under the floorboards, removing it each day to listen to the BBC news. He would then post a news bulletin on the noticeboard at his club. It was his way of defying the Germans and doing his bit for the war effort. The radio is made from an old polish tin, curtain hooks and other bits and pieces he had to hand. Returning it to working order promises to be a tough assignment for electronics expert Mark Stuckey.
Next to arrive is Joanna Carpenter, with a set of dinner gongs that came from her gran's farmhouse. Joanna remembers playing with them as a child at dinner time and has fond memories of spending time with her grandmother, watching her feeding and milking the cows, making butter and playing the piano. Joanna's grandmother left her the gongs when she died, but sadly they no longer sound as they once did. Musical instrument expert Pete Woods needs to step up to the plate to revive these charming items.
The day's final visitor is Chloe Foster from Hampshire, with a musical carousel given to her by her mum. Chloe has cerebral palsy and was in and out of hospital as a child. Her mum bought the carousel to help keep Chloe occupied during long hospital appointments. Chloe would play it over and over, but it's been about five years since the toy last worked, and one of the horses has completely broken off. Now Chloe is an adult, she is contemplating moving out of the family home and getting her own place, and she would like to be able to put the working carousel out on display.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The team restores a silver saxophone, a stained-glass window panel depicting the Blackpool Tower and a music box shaped like a grand piano. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop

Horologist Steve Fletcher gets his hands on the largest timepiece he has ever attempted to restore in the barn, a one-of-a-kind clock built by the owner's father for a display at the World Trade Centre in Dallas. The other items are an Austin J40 toy pedal car, a china dog complete with its own wooden kennel and a lucky cap belonging to an avid Rotherham United fan

programme.title: The Repair Shop

She also meets award-winning macaron maker Naeem Mohamed, who shares his astonishing macaron stack cake

programme.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
programme.desc: Period comedy drama based on Oscar Wilde's play, starring Rupert Everett and Colin Firth. Landowner Jack Worthing has invented a younger brother called "Ernest" so he can escape his sober existence once in a while to visit his best friend Algernon and live the high life in London. Algernon, meanwhile, his curiosity roused by Jack's stories about his ward, Cecily, sets off for Shropshire as "Ernest" to meet the young lady.

programme.title: Strangers on a Train
programme.desc: Classic Hitchcock thriller starring Farley Granger, Ruth Roman and Robert Walker. An obsessive playboy strikes up a conversation with a tennis player he encounters on a train. The playboy, who hates his father, reveals to the sportsman that he knows of his wife's refusal to grant him a divorce and proposes a double murder to solve both their problems.

programme.title: Flog It!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

Bob falls for a pair of champagne flutes in a love heart stand, while Suzy steps back in time when she discovers a Japanese glass fishing float

It is the start of a daring attempt by a small force of crack German paratroopers to kidnap the British prime minister, Winston Churchill.

programme.title: Pearl
programme.desc: Period horror starring Mia Goth. In 1918, Texas farm girl Pearl yearns to be a star of stage and screen, but her strict mother disapproves of such dreams. When Pearl hears about a local audition for a touring dance troupe, her single-minded ambition bubbles over into a rage that proves murderous.

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Psychological horror starring Jessie Buckley and Rory Kinnear. Following a personal tragedy, Londoner Harper drives out to the Hereford countryside for a spot of rest and recovery. However, Harper soon realises that everyone in her orbit is a man, each with the same face, and while some of these figures are harmless, others might be very dangerous indeed.

programme.title: Tad the Lost Explorer and the Emerald Tablet

programme.title: Jamie: Together at Christmas

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Christmas
programme.desc: The cook and food writer celebrates well-loved festive dishes, cooking a sea bass starter, a roast duck feast and a party trifle. In addition to preparing dishes inspired by memories of his family, he gives a makeover to his father's annual contribution to Christmas dinner - a casserole. He also creates a winter slaw inspired by the Slather holiday cheeseboard, and accepts an invitation to venison supper in a Scottish castle, where he invents a new cocktail to toast the special occasion

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Dolls Amy and David are the treasured possessions of 36-year-old Special Olympics gold medallist Jess Hiles, first given to her when she was five. Now, with missing limbs and tired bodies they need rejuvenating, so Amanda Middleditch, Julie Tatchell and Dominic Chinea are tasked to see what they can do. A beaten-up 1950s drum kit with magical memories, a painted German toy box, and the oldest ever item to enter the barn also receive some much-needed attention. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team breathe new life into three cherished heirlooms, reviving wonderful memories along with the items.
First through the barn doors are Emma Brookes and her mum Rosemary, with an incredible tale of wartime resistance. They have brought in Rosemary's father's homemade radio, which he used during the Nazi occupation of Jersey during the Second World War. In an attempt to control the flow of information, the Nazis confiscated all of the radios on the island, and anyone caught using one was in serious trouble. Undeterred, Rosemary's father hid his contraption under the floorboards, removing it each day to listen to the BBC news. He would then post a news bulletin on the noticeboard at his club. It was his way of defying the Germans and doing his bit for the war effort. The radio is made from an old polish tin, curtain hooks and other bits and pieces he had to hand. Returning it to working order promises to be a tough assignment for electronics expert Mark Stuckey.
Next to arrive is Joanna Carpenter, with a set of dinner gongs that came from her gran's farmhouse. Joanna remembers playing with them as a child at dinner time and has fond memories of spending time with her grandmother, watching her feeding and milking the cows, making butter and playing the piano. Joanna's grandmother left her the gongs when she died, but sadly they no longer sound as they once did. Musical instrument expert Pete Woods needs to step up to the plate to revive these charming items.
The day's final visitor is Chloe Foster from Hampshire, with a musical carousel given to her by her mum. Chloe has cerebral palsy and was in and out of hospital as a child. Her mum bought the carousel to help keep Chloe occupied during long hospital appointments. Chloe would play it over and over, but it's been about five years since the toy last worked, and one of the horses has completely broken off. Now Chloe is an adult, she is contemplating moving out of the family home and getting her own place, and she would like to be able to put the working carousel out on display.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The team restores a silver saxophone, a stained-glass window panel depicting the Blackpool Tower and a music box shaped like a grand piano. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Jay Blades and the experts return to hear the stories of more treasured items before bringing them back to life for their owners. Horologist Steve Fletcher gets his hands on the largest timepiece he has ever attempted to restore in the barn, a one-of-a-kind clock built by the owner's father for a display at the World Trade Centre in Dallas. The other items are an Austin J40 toy pedal car, a china dog complete with its own wooden kennel and a lucky cap belonging to an avid Rotherham United fan

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Bookbinder Chris Shaw needs all his skills when he is presented with a Jewish prayer book that originally belonged to the owner's Austrian grandparents, and was kept by them throughout their time at Theresienstadt concentration camp in the Czech Republic. Mark Stuckey tries to get a sound from an ageing and very damaged radio, and also teams up with upholsterer Sonnaz Nooranvary to work on a 1970s egg-shaped chair with enclosed speakers. Plus, owner Ramzi Al-Nayazi brings in a treasured horse racing game from his childhood in Iraq

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Brenton West and Will Kirk set to work on Olympic diver Jack Laugher's gold and silver medals, along with their wooden cases, which have taken a battering over the years, while Steve Fletcher turns his attention to a precious musical jewellery box that was bought by Barry for his wife Bernadette while he was in Malaysia with the British Army more than 50 years ago. Amanda Middleditch and Julie Tatchell are next to be called into action, this time against a mythical monster in need of some TLC, and metal worker Dominic Chinea is handed a complicated fix on a simple tool

programme.title: The Repair Shop Jubilee Special
programme.desc: Jay Blades and the team mark the year of the Queen's Platinum Jubilee by bringing four treasured heirlooms, each with a royal connection, back to life. Amongst the items is an unfinished Pearly Suit belonging to a woman's late father, who was a Pearly King, and a hand-painted commemorative plate made to celebrate the Golden Jubilee of Queen Victoria in 1887
