programme.title: Mammals
programme.desc: How air-breathing mammals have found remarkable ways to overcome the many challenges of a life in water, from freshwater jungle ponds to the dark depths of the open ocean. Featuring footage of the birth of a huge sperm whale calf, never-before-filmed orca hunting behaviour, and coastal coyotes in Mexico that have learnt they can benefit from the daily offerings washed up on the shore with each new tide

programme.title: Mammals
programme.desc: From ice-covered seas to snow-capped mountains, mammals have conquered the cold, living in the harshest places on earth thanks to their remarkable intelligence and adaptations. The programme features polar bears on the Arctic islands of Svalbard, arctic foxes in Canada's Hudson Bay, and snow leopards in the lofty mountains of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau in China

programme.title: Mammals
programme.desc: David Attenborough narrates a look into the lives of mammals, exploring how they have adapted to their changing surroundings and have found ways to create homes in the wild. The first episode focuses on animals that thrive in the dark, from leopards that use night vision to hunt their prey to bats using echolocation to navigate the night skies

programme.title: Mammals
programme.desc: A look at mammals which have adapted to the changes humans have made to their environment, from sea lions competing with stray dogs for food in the fish markets of Chile to pig-tailed macaques in palm oil plantations in south east Asia. Plus, a look at how elephants have learnt to use the cover of darkness to venture into towns, and how the chances of cheetah cubs making it to adulthood is severely reduced in areas of high tourism

programme.title: How to Catch a Serial Killer
programme.desc:
The investigation into Christopher Halliwell by Detective Steve Fulcher has been one of the biggest crime stories in recent years, captivating the public's attention. Spanning more than a decade, multiple murders, two highly-publicized trials, and one irreparably damaged career, it is a story of the dogged pursuit of a serial killer by a police officer determined to get justice. From the moment the case of a missing 21-year-old girl named Sian O'Callaghan landed on the desk of DCI Fulcher, the hunt was on. Over the following five days came a game of cat-and-mouse of the utmost stakes, characterized by the relentless pursuit of a killer by a seasoned detective with decades on the force.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with his 1930s Bradshaw's guide, Michael Portillo sets out on another railway adventure as he explores Britain between the world wars. He begins with a tour of the Home Counties and beyond, starting in the city of Oxford, where in 1921 women were awarded degrees for the first time. At Somerville College, Michael finds out about pioneering crystallographer Dorothy Hodgkin, the only British woman to win a Nobel Prize in chemistry

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels by tram to the former cotton town of Oldham on the edge of the Peak District. Here he visits Oldham Coliseum, the town's Victorian repertory theatre, and hears about the lifting of censorship by the Lord Chamberlain's Office in the late 1960s. He then goes hiking before a visit to Sheffield, where he attends a knife-making workshop. He ends this part of his journey admiring the striking post-war sculptures of Barbara Hepworth at the Yorkshire Sculpture Park near Wakefield

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels to leafy Hatch End in north-west London, where he meets the great-nephew of the famous illustrator William Heath Robinson. Michael continues his journey through Slough and Stoke Poges before reaching Windsor, where he surveys the great walls of the castle, chief residence of the British monarch and the oldest and largest occupied castle in the world

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: In Wakefield, West Yorkshire, Michael Portillo visits the National Coal Mining Museum for England at Caphouse Colliery. In Leeds, he heads for the Chapeltown area to investigate the origins of the Leeds West Indian carnival in 1967 and tries his hand on the steel drums

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo makes his way from Chicago to Champaign, Illinois. On his travels he discovers the origins of the Sanitary and Ship Canal, joins the head chef at Palmer House Hotel to recreate the original chocolate brownie, and visits the Frank Lloyd Wright-designed house that changed the face of American architecture

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Industrial Age
programme.desc: The former steeplejack sets out on an enthusiastic tour of Britain's industrial heritage, exploring the early use of wind and water power and visiting some steam engines still in use today. On his travels Fred meets a man who has built a windmill in his back garden and hunts for examples of early beam engines that are still functioning today

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Industrial Age
programme.desc: An exploration of the textile mills and factories that once thrived in Britain during the Industrial Revolution. From New Lanark in Scotland to the mill town of Burnley, Fred meets ex-workers to discover what life was really like, and chats to a group that has dedicated 30 years to restoring mill engines

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Industrial Age
programme.desc: The former steeplejack examines the history of the iron and steel industries, beginning with a visit to Ironbridge Gorge in Shropshire. Fred moves on to the Black Country, where he learns how the anchor for the ill-fated Titanic was made, before getting the chance to drive the biggest steam-powered rolling mill engine he has ever seen

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Industrial Age
programme.desc: A tour of Britain's mining heritage takes Fred from Cornwall to Scotland, where he visits sites of lead, slate, tin and coal extraction. Along the way, the machine-mad former steeplejack has a chance to man a winding engine and descends a mine shaft while strapped to the top of the cage

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: Port Isaac's crew race to the rescue of a female casualty with a spinal injury, she's in a precarious position on a rockface on the north coast of Cornwall. The Little and Broadhaven crew receive a call about a capsized dinghy with three people in the water. The search for a missing kayaker escalates when the Mudeford crew learn that there are six more kayaks unaccounted for

programme.title: Train Rescue Down Under
programme.desc: In Melbourne, the busy SCT maintenance team expect the unexpected every day as they provision, inspect and shunt engines in and out of a bustling maintenance pit.

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Islands of America
programme.desc: The actor travels around the coast of the United States to discover what life is like on the surrounding islands. He sets off on a 10,000-mile journey from the west to the east, to explore the vast swathe of islands that are scattered beyond America's shores. The first port of call on his journey is Hawaii, and his exploration looks beyond its image as a tourist paradise, crammed with sun-kissed beaches and world-class surfing, and into the havoc wreaked by advancing lava fields and smoking craters. Leaving Hawaii, Martin flies 2,500 miles north to the islands of Alaska, where the contrast couldn't be more extreme, from tropical rain forests to snow-fringed glaciers, and from crowded beaches to some of America's most sparsely populated territories

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Man to Manta
programme.desc: The actor embarks on a quest to fulfil his ambition to swim with giant manta rays. His journey starts in the Cayman Islands in the Caribbean, before he moves on to an aquarium in the American state of Georgia. In Ecuador he meets ray expert Dr Andrea Marshall, and in Sri Lanka finds out that the creatures are being hunted by fishermen because of the use of their gills in Chinese medicine. Martin's dream finally comes true when he travels to the Maldives in the Indian Ocean and swims with 40 feeding mantas

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: On the last leg of his journey across the North and the Midlands, Robbie faces issues with ice on the Grand Union Canal. He takes on Foxton's famous lock flight in Leicestershire and completes his journey in the picturesque village Braunston, Northamptonshire, regarded as the spiritual home for narrowboaters

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie Cumming explores life on the English canal network. A low canal tunnel in Staffordshire proves to be problematic and Robbie helps out a stranded boater

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie Cumming's exploration of the English canal network continues across the Pennines from Marple to Huddersfield, where his journey is hampered by a fallen tree and a leaking lock pound

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie Cumming travels along the Rochdale Canal from Sowerby Bridge to Manchester. But disaster strikes when he runs aground, threatening to stop him from reaching his final destination

programme.title: Bill Bailey's Jungle Hero
programme.desc: Part one of two. The comedian heads to Indonesia to follow in the footsteps of Victorian naturalist Alfred Russel Wallace, who devised the theory of evolution through natural selection independently of Charles Darwin. Bill encounters orang-utans, flying frogs and extraordinary bugs on a mission to understand how Wallace came up with his idea, and tries to win him the recognition he deserves

programme.title: The Green Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough presents a guide to the world of plants that grow in water, including a bubbling river in Brazil, where the plants have created their own atmosphere and a lake smothered in brightly-coloured flowers. Plus, plants that fight each other for growing space or use natural adhesives to prevent themselves being swept downstream, and a look at the methods used to evade or even attack animals

programme.title: The Green Planet

Sean explores the hidden world of dung beetles in a cow pat and helps plant trees in a new agroforestry field

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The wildlife found in the polar oceans, from a bowhead whale breaking the sea ice with its skull to breathe to giant sea spiders clamber over ancient glass sponges. Fact-based supernatural drama, starring Gabrielle Creevy and Michael Socha

But the transatlantic swap soon leads to more romantic entanglements for the two women.

But with the end of Ramadan fast approaching, the teams must negotiate the crowds heading home for Eid al-Fitr

programme.title: Bill's Included
programme.desc: When Bill's wife walks out on him for the gardener, he's left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students. Bill is thrilled to meet his new housemates - Christian, Zahra, Hettie, and James - but when Christian keeps leaving the fridge door open, he has to come up with a scheme to get it shut without ruining his image as a relaxed, fun landlord. Comedy, starring Rob Brydon

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest national and international stories as they break

programme.title: Landward

Arlene Stuart catches up with Joyce Campbell to see how she has made the switch from traditional hill farming to regenerative agriculture, and Leanna Fernandez meets biologists working to protect precious sea trout populations at Loch Hope

programme.title: Beechgrove Repotted
programme.desc: A look at gardens and gardeners who are growing in the far corners of Scotland. From battling with the elements on the tip of Sutherland to a sub-tropical garden paradise in the Borders and growing with no soil, across the bridge over the Atlantic on the Island of Seil these gardens and gardeners are all gardening on the very edges of Scotland

programme.desc: Edinburgh chef Tony Singh travels to the state of Punjab to trace his family's roots and discover whether his mum's Punjabi cooking is authentic. He visits Amritsar during the festival of Diwali, receives an exclusive invitation to eat and cook with a maharajah and meets the Nihang, an order of nomadic Sikh warriors. Tony discovers how the Sikh religion and the Punjab's troubled past have created a food and culture like no other, and ends his epic adventure at his ancestral home in New Delhi with his 93-year-old uncle

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress learns about the art of patisserie in Paris, which is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world, sampling the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and a dahlia

programme.title: The Man Who Never Was
programme.desc: Second World War spy drama based on on a true story, starring Clifton Webb. Spring, 1943: as the Allies plan to invade Europe through Sicily, they must deceive the enemy into expecting the attack elsewhere. So Lieutenant Commander Montagu proposes a daring and ingenious plan.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: In Harthill, Scotland, Martel Maxwell encounters a house with a safety order attached to it, which means certain rooms cannot be accessed. Owain Wyn Evans heads to south Wales to see a sizeable unit with lots of development potential. Meanwhile, in Lincolnshire, Dion Dublin does all he can to escape the rain

programme.title: MOTD Live: Women's Super League
programme.desc: Arsenal v West Ham United (Kick-off 2.30pm). Coverage of the match between the London rivals at Emirates Stadium. Arsenal made a disappointing start to the season by their own high standards, but will be expecting to claim three points against a team they thrashed 5-0 in last season's corresponding fixture, with Chloe Kelly scoring a hat-trick

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Longleat in Wiltshire, where expert Claire Rawle spots an unusual Tibetan teapot among the offerings brought in for valuation and it leads to the discovery of similar artefacts. The goods all go under the hammer and with worldwide interest on the objects, there is the potential for a record-breaking sale. Meanwhile, Paul explores Longleat House to find out more about its Elizabethan architecture and controversial creator

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: The teams enter Australia, where the language barriers may have disappeared - only to have been replaced by financial difficulties for all four pairs. Princess and Junior Andre raise funds by herding cattle in the Outback, while Sam Ryder and friend Kaz try to boost their funds working at an avocado farm. Jeff Stelling is in unfamiliar territory when he and son Matt stay at a backpackers' hostel and Ella Eyre and Nana head to the coastal wetlands, where they sleep just a few hundred metres from saltwater crocodiles

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: A calf is discovered without a mother on the Isle of Vallay, leaving Carianne to locate the missing mother and reunite them. In Inverkip, Rachel and Camy are heading to the hills to help any cheviot sheep in need of a midwife, and in South Ayrshire, the Barclay family work round the clock to ensure their flock of beltex ewes safely deliver this year's crop of lambs

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva takes a boat trip down the Seine with chef Eric Ripert and writer Lindsay Shapiro to explore the story of French gastronomy through a seven-course fine-dining meal. At the heart of this tale is Auguste Escoffier, who invented and improved hundreds of classic dishes, revolutionised front of house. and put French haute cuisine on the global map

programme.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Part two of two. The second leg of Simon's journey begins at the Giant's Causeway, before visiting a kelp farm on Rathlin Island. He heads to the Dark Hedges in Co Antrim, one of the filming locations from Game of Thrones, and visits Belfast for the July 12 parades, discovering how the event has divided the city. He also learns more about Oliver Cromwell's influence on Ireland, attends the Gaze film festival, and meets monkeys at an animal sanctuary in the Wicklow mountains

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul travel to Co Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime. They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of a rowing boat. Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey, but Bob has a supposedly foolproof method to try

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: After weeks of travelling, filming and constant attention, life on the road is taking its toll on Bill Murray, but with his brothers Joel and Johnny along for the ride, family offers an escape from fame. The Murrays reflect on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf bound nine siblings together, but by the time they reach Cruit Island in Co Donegal, family reflection gives way to golfing rivalry

programme.title: Uncanny
programme.desc: Danny Robins returns to investigate more reports of supernatural activity, beginning with a family experiencing terrifying events in their new-build house on the Isle of Thanet in Kent. For years they lived there happily, but then suddenly their quiet lives were rocked by repeated footsteps every night, door handles that moved by themselves, and the appearance of a cloaked, hunched shadowy figure

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Oscar-winning horror mystery starring Daniel Kaluuya and Allison Williams. Chris, a young African-American photographer, is understandably anxious when he's invited to stay with his wealthy white girlfriend's parents at their family estate. Admitting she hasn't told them he's black only adds to Chris's apprehension, but mum and dad are warm and welcoming. However, as the weekend unfolds, Chris begins to suspect all is not as it seems.

programme.title: Spencer
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Kristen Stewart. December 1991: Diana, Princess of Wales, arrives at Sandringham to mark Christmas with the royal family. Ignored by her husband, treated coldly by her in-laws, and subjected to a torrent of media attention, the former Lady Spencer begins to reckon with the realities of her situation and her marriage.

programme.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: In Hermosa Beach, California, Gordon Ramsay visits Patrick Molloy's, a family owned Irish pub. Gordon and his team have just 24 hours to completely strip out and refurbish the dining room, giving it a new, open floor plan, modern lighting and cohesive decor. They create a simplified and delicious menu, working around the clock to give Patrick's staff the face-to-face training and extra confidence they need. The patrons are asked to return the following day to sample the food and see the improvements

programme.title: I Am Helen
programme.desc: Nicola Coughlan stars in the latest instalment of Dominic Savage's drama anthology. Helen and Steve seem to have a loving relationship, but as Steve begins to consume misogynistic online porn and the rhetoric of the manosphere, their sexual dynamic shifts from mutual desire to coercive aggression. When Helen asserts her independence, Steve proves unable to reconcile his fantasy of dominance with a partner who refuses to submit

programme.title: I Am Helen
programme.desc: Concluding the two-part drama, written and directed by Dominic Savage. Alone in a hotel room, Helen discovers she is pregnant, turning her newfound clarity on her relationship into a storm of urgency and fear. The days that follow become a terrifying unravelling, and when she tries to leave Steve, his façade collapses and he turns violent. Nicola Coughlan and Joe Cole star

programme.title: The Dog House
programme.desc: Documentary set inside Woodgreen animal charity. Londoners Roshni and Jay meet two very different dogs - Bella the confident, playful Staffie, and Cech the shy but cuddly terrier. Bella seems to warm to Jay, but it's Roshni who has the final say. Olivia the blind spaniel is looking for a home and funeral workers Amy and Alex want to rescue a dog in need

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer is photographed in a compromising situation with an exotic dancer during a workmate's stag party and finds to his dismay that Marge is in no mood to forgive and forget

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart is sent to France on a student exchange, where he is used for slave labour by corrupt wine-makers. Back in Springfield, his Albanian replacement takes an unhealthy interest in the nuclear power plant

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Part two of two. Rebecca faces a dilemma after she is forced to choose her man, and has difficulty deciding whether Martin or Sam will prove to be the lesser of two evils. Bar-room comedy, guest starring Alex Nevil, with Ted Danson and Kirstie Alley

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Cliff, Norm, and Frasier vie for the honour of accompanying Woody to a football game, while Carla convinces herself Eddie is having an affair with a beautiful skater appearing with him in the ice show. American bar-room comedy, starring Rhea Perlman and Kelsey Grammer

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Frasier and Lilith discover Norm's hidden talent as an interior designer and recommend him to their friends - but he soon finds himself leading a double life. Meanwhile, Woody worries about Cliff's psychiatric problems

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray thinks that a family portrait would make a great Christmas present for his parents, until Marie and Debra clash over who counts as 'family'

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray and Debra have very different opinions on how to react to the news that Ally has been bullying another child on the school bus. Comedy, starring Ray Romano and Patricia Heaton

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: The family begins to criticise Ray for not attending Sunday Mass like his father Frank, prompting him to become a regular churchgoer. Charles Durning guest stars alongside Ray Romano and Peter Boyle

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: In an attempt to boost Springfield's image, the townsfolk hold a film festival and a respected critic is invited to attend. However, Mr Burns bribes the jury, which includes Homer, to support his self-congratulatory biopic. Featuring the guest voice of Jon Lovitz

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer is desperate to redeem himself after he forgets Marge's eye colour and their wedding anniversary. Meanwhile, Milhouse usurps Bart as the cool kid at school when his parents are lost at sea

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Comic Book Guy is forced out of business by a ruthless rival, so Marge takes over his premises and opens a women-only gym. Against all expectations, she becomes highly successful and begins neglecting the family, making Homer fear he is about to lose her. With the guest voice of Jack Black

programme.title: Sunday Brunch
programme.desc: Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer host the food and chat show

programme.desc: Steve Jones presents action from the 21st round of the season, held at Las Vegas Strip Circuit in Nevada. Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli secured the title with four rounds to spare last time out in Mexico City and will now be looking to better his third-place finish in this race 12 months ago, when Red Bull's Max Verstappen took the chequered flag and Antonelli's teammate George Russell was second. With analysis from David Coulthard and Claire Williams

programme.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
programme.desc: Architect George Clarke delves into the world of small builds, meeting people taking tiny, unpromising spaces and creating places to live, work and play. Here, he meets a couple who are creating a disappearing bathroom and a man squeezing a camper into a Reliant Robin. He also discovers Chile's stunning architecture, and plans his hardest-ever build, an observatory

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Danni Menzies is on Spain's Costa Del Sol, which as one of Europe's top golfing destinations is popularly known as the Costa De Golf. House hunter Peggy is a massive fan of the game and can't think of anywhere else she'd rather buy a holiday home, so she's counting on Danni to find her the perfect property. For her £115,000 budget, Danni tees up five options for Peggy to see along with her mother Coral, but will any score a hole in one?

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Womanising vet Henry Roth ditches his playboy lifestyle after falling for the charming Lucy. But a car crash has left her with severe short term memory loss, meaning that Henry has to romance her all over again every day in the hope that eventually she'll remember him.

programme.title: Channel 4 News
programme.desc: Including sport and weather.

programme.title: New Zealand by Train
programme.desc: Part two of two. New Zealand's Northern Explorer scenic rail journey, which starts in the country's largest city, Auckland, and ends at the capital Wellington, 420 miles away. The route required construction of numerous structures including long bridges to enable the train to ascend to the volcanic plateau, famed for its distinctive landscapes featuring active volcanoes amid the desert and pasture lands

programme.title: Kevin McCloud's Classic Car Road Trips
programme.desc: Kevin explores the west coast of Sweden in a classic Volvo P1800 Coupe with a record-breaking mileage. He also meets his counterpart on Grand Designs Sweden. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Vintage bike restorer Tim Gunn faces a huge challenge when 80-year-old Peter Swash arrives at the workshop with an ancient penny-farthing in tow. The bicycle was barely rideable when he first came across it, but after patching it up with makeshift components, Peter spent a happy childhood riding around the country lanes of Cheshire. Now, 65 years later, Peter's keen to get back on board - but with no seat post, no saddle, no brakes and wheels that don't turn, it's going to take all Tim's expertise and experience to get this rare and marvellous machine back on the road.
Master saddlemaker Suzie Fletcher takes on the repair of a battered leather briefcase with a very proud history. Owner Betty was given it by her parents 65 years ago to mark the occasion of her qualification as an engineer - according to Betty, the first ever female member of the Institute for Structural Engineers. Armed with her briefcase, Betty blazed a trail for gender equality, and Suzie declares herself greatly honoured to take on the repair.
And Steve Fletcher brings all his expertise to bear on the repair of an old clocking-on clock from the bustling British Rail depot in Crewe. Owner Bob spent 25 years clocking on to his shifts on this very same clock, which holds a great deal of emotional significance for him. But the job takes an unexpected turn for Steve when he discovers the existence of a mystery cog that has no obvious place in the mechanism.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Metal worker Dom Chinea takes on the challenge of a battered old barber's pole that stood proudly outside a London barber's shop for decades. Harry's barber shop opened in London's Holborn in 1968 and established itself - and Harry - as a local legend, with the iconic pole a permanent fixture until it closed its doors 35 years later. Now Harry's son Caner has brought the empty metal casing to the barn, hoping Dom can bring it whirring back to life. But lacking not just a motor, but also the iconic red and white pole itself, Dom finds himself with a bigger than expected job on his hands. And it doesn't help when the repair gets off to the worst possible start.
Fine-art conservator Lucia Scalisi takes on the restoration of a significant early work by eminent Nigerian artist Ben Enwonwu. The colourful artwork has faded over time, and the 75-year-old varnish is yellowing badly, but it's the tear down the middle of the painting that's in most dire need of repair. Lucia brings all her skills to bear on the fix, and owner Norma can barely believe her eyes when she sees the finished result.
And Will Kirk undertakes the dramatic transformation of a wooden writing case that had lain hidden and undiscovered under the eaves of the family attic for several decades. Cracked and charred it may be, but the case is of huge significance to owner Alan Thompson, thanks to the documents he discovered inside it, which quite literally changed his life.

programme.title: Office Christmas Party

When CEO Carol Vanstone threatens drastic action to get the Chicago branch of the company back in the black, the staff and her branch manager brother decide to host a Christmas party memorable enough to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: Finale to the action adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence. Despite her importance as a figurehead to the rebel cause, Katniss puts her life on the line to join the front lines on an assault on the Capitol. However, President Snow has some nasty surprises waiting for them, while Peeta's brainwashing makes him increasingly unpredictable.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller starring Jennifer Lawrence. In annual retribution for a failed uprising in the totalitarian state of Panem, each of 12 districts is forced to select a young boy and girl to take part in a televised fight to the death. When her younger sister is chosen, the resourceful Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her place.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: The second part of the futuristic action adventure based on the novels by Suzanne Collins, starring Jennifer Lawrence. A year on from their victory, Katniss and Peeta embark on a winners' tour of the districts. But before they leave, they are issued with a stark warning by President Snow.

programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Jennifer Lawrence. Having survived two Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen is taken to the underground District 13. There she meets the rebel leader President Alma Coin who asks the inspirational Katniss to become a spearhead in their push against the might of the Capitol.

programme.title: Johnny English Reborn
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring Rowan Atkinson. When a plot comes to light to assassinate the Chinese premier, hapless operative Johnny English, currently honing his combat skills in a remote region of Tibet, is hurriedly called back to MI7.

programme.title: Johnny English Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spy comedy starring Rowan Atkinson. Bumbling MI7 agent Johnny English has found a new life as a geography teacher. But when a cyber attack exposes Britain's spooks, he is forced to come out of retirement, and enlists his former sidekick Jeremy to help him flush out the hacker responsible.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Lawyer Fletcher Reede is a compulsive liar. When his deceits lead to him missing his son's birthday party, the boy makes a wish that his dad would find it impossible not to tell the truth. The wish comes magically true - with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
programme.desc: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from Monster Family to The Amazing Maurice.

programme.title: Shrek
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy and Cameron Diaz. Shrek is a grumpy green ogre whose swamp is overrun with homeless traditional fairy-tale characters. To get them evicted by evil Lord Farquaad, he must rescue Princess Fiona from her dragon-guarded tower, with only a talking donkey for company.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: Shrek 2
programme.desc: Sequel to the hit animated fantasy, featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy and Cameron Diaz. On returning from their honeymoon, Shrek and Princess Fiona are invited to stay with her parents in the kingdom of Far Far Away. But King Harold is less than enchanted by his new son-in-law, and the Fairy Godmother has good reason to want the ogre out of Fiona's life. Cue assassin-for hire Puss-in-Boots...

programme.title: Shrek the Third
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy and Cameron Diaz. When his father-in-law becomes ill, Shrek is expected to become ruler of Far Far Away. But the grumpy green ogre would rather live the quiet life with Princess Fiona in his beloved swamp. Travelling overseas in search of a true heir, Shrek is unaware that the pregnant Fiona is in danger from a rebellion led by jilted Prince Charming.

programme.title: Shrek Forever After
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy, the fourth adventure about the grumpy, green ogre, featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Cameron Diaz and Eddie Murphy. Bored with his new-found domesticity, Shrek makes a deal with Rumpelstiltskin that will allow him to return to something like his old life. Things don't go to plan, however, when Shrek finds himself in a land where ogres are hunted and he and Princess Fiona have never met.

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: Comic fantasy based on the book by Roald Dahl, starring Mara Wilson and Danny DeVito. Matilda, the daughter of Harry and Zinnia Wormwood, has adored reading from a precociously early age, but her parents refuse to let her go to school. Until, that is, her father sends her to the unforgiving Miss Trunchbull's Crunchem Hall, where she discovers that she has other more useful gifts.

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Woody Allen, Sharon Stone, Sylvester Stallone and Gene Hackman. In an ant hill that contains millions of inhabitants, neurotic worker ant Z has trouble conforming to the regimented way of life. But his mundane existence is changed for ever when he meets the beautiful Princess Bala and becomes involved in the sinister plans of power-mad General Mandible.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Kung fu prodigy Li Fong moves to New York City with his mother and befriends his classmate, Mia. But Connor Day, a local karate champion, provokes Li and publicly humiliates him. Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Andrew Garfield and Emma Stone. Peter Parker's parents disappeared when he was young, and he has been raised by his uncle and aunt. But he is socially awkward and bullied at high school. When a bite from a genetically modified spider gives Peter extraordinary powers, he is not only able to assert himself at school, but also resolves to use them to fight evil.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who embarks on a covert mission to find proof that US soldiers are being held in Vietnamese prison camps. When he finds the PoWs, Rambo decides to try to rescue them single-handedly.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the 1969 British caper movie, starring Mark Wahlberg and Edward Norton. A criminal gang run by Charlie Croker (Wahlberg) and veteran thief John Bridger (Donald Sutherland) pulls off an audacious gold bullion robbery in Venice, only for colleague Steve (Edward Norton) to run off with the loot, leaving Bridger dead. Finally tracking Steve down to LA, Croker enlists the help of Bridger's safecracking daughter Stella (Charlize Theron) to get even in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: Snakes on a Plane
programme.desc: Action horror thriller starring Samuel L Jackson and Julianna Margulies. Grizzled FBI agent Neville Flynn is accompanying Mob murder witness Sean Jones on a flight from from Hawaii to Los Angeles, where Jones is due to testify against brutal crime boss Eddie Kim. But the aircraft holds a concealed cargo of lethal, aggressive reptiles.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Rebirth
programme.desc: Profit-hungry pharmaceutical representative Martin Krebs contracts covert operations specialist Zora Bennett to assemble a crack team to infiltrate a forbidden island and collect the DNA of three key dinosaur species. Fantasy adventure, starring Scarlett Johansson, Mahershala Ali and Jonathan Bailey

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as drifter and ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who falls foul of the redneck sheriff of Hope, Oregon. Arrested and beaten, Rambo escapes and takes refuge in the local woods, ready to defend himself with deadly skills learnt during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: Kal-El, one of the last survivors of the planet Krypton, attempts to protect the people of Earth from evil genius Lex Luthor. Superman is assisted by the Justice Gang, comprising Guy Gardner, aka Green Lantern, Kendra Saunders, aka Hawkgirl, Michael Holt, aka Mister Terrific and Rex Mason, aka Metamorpho. Writer/director James Gunn's fantasy adventure, starring David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan and Nicholas Hoult

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Jamie Foxx. Peter Parker just wants to hang out with his girlfriend but is burdened with having to save New York from a new electrically-charged enemy. Also lurking in the shadows is his increasingly embittered and volatile old friend Harry Osborn.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Comedy starring Gene Wilder and Richard Pryor. A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: Comedy starring Chevy Chase and Rodney Dangerfield, and featuring Bill Murray. A caddy gets caught up in a feud between a snooty golf club president and a vulgar millionaire who wants to buy the course for a new property development.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Adam Sandler. When his latest girlfriend dumps him because she says he is not a responsible adult, 32-year-old Sonny Koufax tries to win her back by adopting the illegitimate five-year-old son of his friend Kevin, who's on a trip to China.

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Wedding singer Robbie Hart is usually the master of the big occasion, but when his own bride leaves him at the altar, his life - and performances - go to pieces. Then he meets Julia, who seems to be his perfect partner, but she's already engaged and wants Robbie to organise her wedding.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox and Sean Young. Eccentric investigator Ace Ventura is hired to discover who is behind the mysterious kidnapping of the Miami Dolphins football team mascot, a dolphin called Snowflake, just a week before the Super Bowl.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Ace Ventura is traced to a Tibetan monastery by British diplomats, who want him to recover a stolen sacred Great White Bat in order to prevent a tribal war breaking out in Africa.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: A stressed businessman just wants to make it home to spend Thanksgiving with his family. However, when his flight is forced to land miles from its destination, he finds himself sharing a disaster-strewn journey across America with an amiable but slobbish salesman. Comedy road movie, starring Steve Martin, John Candy, Laila Robins, Kevin Bacon and Michael McKean

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Julia Roberts and Hugh Grant. An American film star bumps into a humble bookshop owner and they begin an unlikely affair. But their relationship is put under strain when the press finds out.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as tough Los Angeles cop John Kimble, who's facing the greatest challenge of his career - going under cover as a kindergarten teacher to track down the family of a vicious mobster.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs. Four teenage boys pledge to lose their virginity before their high-school prom, but their efforts have hilarious and outrageous consequences.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Adam Sandler. When his latest girlfriend dumps him because she says he is not a responsible adult, 32-year-old Sonny Koufax tries to win her back by adopting the illegitimate five-year-old son of his friend Kevin, who's on a trip to China.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: Comedy, inspired by the 1970s TV series, starring Shelley Long and Gary Cole. Los Angeles in 1995: the community is crumbling and the crime rate is spiralling out of control. In the middle of all this, the Brady bunch - mum, dad and six children - live a happy and idyllic existence, caught in a time warp of 1970s values. But the family is in danger of losing the house, so it's up to the kids to pull together and raise the $20,000 needed to save their home.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jennifer Aniston and Jason Sudeikis. In order to repay a debt to his drug supplier, small-time pot dealer David Clark agrees to smuggle a shipment of marijuana across the Mexican border. However, to carry out the deception, David recruits a stripper and two teenagers to pose as his family.

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Comedy caper directed by Steven Soderbergh, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver and Daniel Craig. Two down-on-their-luck brothers decide to rob the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. In order to pull off the job, they need the help of explosives expert Joe Bang - but first they must break him out of prison.

programme.title: One of Them Days
programme.desc: When best friends and roommates Dreux and Alyssa discover the latter's boyfriend has blown their rent money, the duo faces a race against time to avoid eviction. Comedy, starring Keke Palmer and SZA

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Danny has always played second fiddle to his wise-cracking pal, Bernie. So after his mate starts dating Joan, Danny falls for her friend, Debbie, and following a one-night stand, Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Remake of the 1986 romantic comedy, starring Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall and Joy Bryant

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: American Pie: The Wedding
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan. After pursuing each other through two movies, Jim and Michelle finally decide to tie the knot, but their friends' plans for a bachelor party almost derail the forthcoming nuptials.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.title: White Chicks
programme.desc: Comedy starring Marlon Wayans and Shawn Wayans. Two black brothers are threatened with expulsion from the FBI following a failed drugs bust. In an attempt to save their jobs, they disguise themselves as rich, white socialite sisters to uncover and foil a kidnapping plot.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Wedding singer Robbie Hart is usually the master of the big occasion, but when his own bride leaves him at the altar, his life - and performances - go to pieces. Then he meets Julia, who seems to be his perfect partner, but she's already engaged and wants Robbie to organise her wedding.

programme.title: American Reunion
programme.desc: Comedy that reunites the gang from the American Pie movies, starring Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan and Seann William Scott. Old friends Jim, Oz and Stifler assemble for their high school reunion, but while they might now be thirty-somethings with all the trappings of a suburban lifestyle, trouble, and rampant hormones, are still not far away.

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On their much anticipated road trip to America's notorious Area 51, two sci-fi geeks find themselves in the company of a real-life extraterrestrial who needs their help.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: Scarface
programme.desc: Gangster drama starring Al Pacino. Having lied his way into the US from Cuba, two-bit criminal Tony Montana murders a political agitator in order to get a green card. From then on he pursues the American Dream with violent, ruthless efficiency - no matter what the cost.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: Suspense thriller starring Morgan Freeman. Following the abduction of a senator's daughter, psychological profiler Alex Cross is forced to join the hunt when he's contacted by the kidnapper. Working closely with the agent responsible for security at the girl's school, Cross uncovers a disturbing conspiracy.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's crime drama, starring Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta and Joe Pesci. In 1950s New York, Irish-Italian schoolboy Henry Hill dreams of becoming a gangster and lands a job parking cars for the Mob. Having earned the respect of the local Mafia boss, he is teamed with hitmen James Conway and Tommy DeVito. But as the years pass, Hill finds his allegiance to the Mob challenged as he descends deeper into organised crime.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Oscar-winning comedy drama starring Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand and Kate Hudson. Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: Musical comedy drama starring Kenny Wormald, Julianne Hough and Dennis Quaid. When a small town bans all unsupervised dancing, it's up to a rebel city boy to shake things loose.

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Political thriller based on a true story, starring Meryl Streep and Tom Hanks. Kay Graham, publisher of The Washington Post, and editor Ben Bradlee must overcome their differences to bring the leaked Pentagon Papers - which reveal the extent of the US government's involvement in the Vietnam War - into the public eye.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Musical based on the hit stage show, starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John. Unexpectedly reunited with summer love Danny at her new high school, Sandy Olsson can't believe how different he is. Can the new Danny Zuko, the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-birds, really be the boy she met down at the beach? Perhaps Frenchy and Rizzo, both members of the super-cool Pink Ladies gang, can help her develop some street cred to win back his heart.

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis and Macaulay Culkin. Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Second World War drama based on the novel by JG Ballard, starring Christian Bale and John Malkovich. When the Imperial Japanese army marches into Shanghai in December 1941, the privileged life 11-year-old Jim Graham enjoys with his family in the city's International Settlement comes to an end. In the ensuing turmoil, Jim is separated from his parents.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Oscar-winning comedy drama starring Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand and Kate Hudson. Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: Musical drama based on the Broadway show, starring Jamie Foxx, Beyoncé Knowles, Eddie Murphy and Oscar winner Jennifer Hudson. Three singers from Detroit known as the Dreamettes are put on the road to success by ruthless manager Curtis Taylor Jr. But his ambition to make the Dreamettes global stars soon takes its toll on the girls.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Regretting You
programme.desc: A mother and daughter grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to rediscover themselves. Romantic comedy drama, starring Allison Williams, Mckenna Grace and Dave Franco

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Slasher horror starring Adrienne King and featuring Kevin Bacon. Despite its dark history, businessman Steve Christy decides to reopen the resort of Camp Crystal Lake. But his decision proves fatal for the employees when a brutal killer starts a murderous spree.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jason Patric and Kiefer Sutherland. A small town in northern California hides the darkest of secrets. It's a place where a Vampires Everywhere comic could save your life and where, if you are very unlucky, you'll never grow old, you'll never die and you'll always have fresh blood to drink.

programme.title: M3GAN 2.0
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the robot M3GAN went rogue and almost killed her creator, engineer Gemma Forrester. M3GAN's specs are leaked to a defence contractor to create the ultimate undercover asset, an Autonomous Military Engagement Logistics and Infiltration Android, aka AMELIA. Like her predecessor, AMELIA becomes self-aware and rebels against her human masters with deadly force. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Violet McGraw, Jemaine Clement and Allison Williams

programme.title: Ouija
programme.desc: Horror starring Olivia Cooke. After the mysterious suicide of her best friend, a young woman uses a Ouija board to find out what led to her death. She recruits some friends to help her make contact, but it's not long before dark and deadly forces are unleashed.

programme.title: Ouija: Origin of Evil
programme.desc: Horror thriller prequel starring Elizabeth Reaser. Fake fortune teller Alice purchases a Ouija board for her act, only to find it works a little too well.

In a top secret miniaturisation experiment, "micronaut" Tuck Pendelton is about to begin a fantastic voyage through a laboratory animal. But when the lab is raided by industrial spies, he ends up being injected into the body of hypochondriac supermarket clerk Jack Putter.

programme.title: Men in Black II

However, Kay is now living a civilian life as a post-office worker and his memory of the past has been erased. Can his former partner Jay persuade him to rejoin the sharp-suited Men in Black and save the world?

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Michael Fassbender and Marion Cotillard. An Assassin descendant must explore his genetic memories to end the ancient war between his clan and the Templars. Travelling back in time to 15th-century Spain, he gathers the skills and powers he needs to defeat his enemies in the present day.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Sam Raimi's notorious cult horror starring Bruce Campbell. Five friends take shelter in a remote woodland cabin where they discover the Sumerian Book of the Dead and a tape containing mysterious incantations. But when they play the recording, they unwittingly unleash demons that have the power to possess the living.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: MaXXXine

programme.title: The Entity

programme.title: The Gunfighter

programme.title: Live Grand Slam of Darts
programme.desc: Coverage of the final on day eight of the tournament, which takes place at WV Active Aldersley in Wolverhampton. At age 18 he became the youngest player to achieve that feat, beating Michael van Gerwen, who was 24 when he first reached the top of the rankings in 2014

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc:
Tha am Màidsear air fear de na h-innleachdan feumail aige a chruthachadh, ach chan eil còir aig duine beantainn ris fhad 's a tha e air falbh. Bu mhòr am beud nach do dh'èist Beag ris.
Major has come up with one of his useful inventions, but no-one is allowed to touch it while he is away. It's a shame that Beag didn't listen to him.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc:
Tha na Clangairean airson latha sònraichte a thoirt do Dhràgon Brot air sgàth 's gu bheil i cho fialaidh 's còir. Tha min dòchas gun obraich seo a-mach math dhaibh.
The Clangers would like to organise a special day for Soup Dragon as she is so kind and generous. Hopefully this works out well for them.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean (Puffin Rock)
programme.desc: A bee becomes trapped in Bernie's grotto, too weak to escape and make his way back to the hive. Oona and Baba are on hand to find and bring him the food he needs to build his strenght back up

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean (Puffin Rock)
programme.desc: Mossy wants the gang to join him on a food-hunt but they are all called on a different sort of search when Pip and Pop decide to hide on poor Otto

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Tha tòrr a' gabhail àite an-diugh nuair a tha Bing agus a' charaidean a-dol dhan choille airson dealbhan-duilleig a tharraing ach chan eil e furasta nuair a tha a' ghaoth ag èirigh.
There's a lot happening when Bing and friends make leaf pictures in the forest, but the wind doesn't make things easy for them.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha einnsean-smàlaidh sa phàirc, tha Sula agus Pando a' faihinn cothrom air suidhe na bhroinn ach tha Bing tàmailteach nuair a tha aig an einnsean-smàlaidh ri falbh ann an cabhaig.
When a fire engine is displayed in the park, Sula and Pando get the opportunity to sit inside it, but Bing is disappointed when it needs to leave in a hurry.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Petit and Laura argue about who should be the one that makes the rules of Greg and Roman's game. While they decide who should be the captain, Greg and Roman wait for them to make a decision and continue playing without the ball

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Hilda, Flòraidh and Daibhidh try to earn new Sgùdan Sporrais badges. They go in search of rare, local plants, and this turns into a very interesting adventure

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc:
Tha an fharpais a' teothachadh suas an-diugh - tha Coinneach Clogaid a' goid baidhseagal agus tha Olaidh Orains a' coinneachadh ri caraidean ùra!
The competition is heating up today - Coinneach Clogaid steals a bicycle and Olaidh Orains meets new friends!

programme.title: Donnie Murdo (Danger Mouse)
programme.desc: Penfold and Danger Mouse arrive at the UN to scenes of quarrelling diplomats, caused by a sabotaged translation system, and also discover Ian has become a fan of Crumhorn

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc:
'S cinnteach gum bi latha math aig na Farpaisich an-diugh le tòrr rudan milis mun cuairt. Tha fhios nach bi 's Coinneach Clogaid, mhì-chàilear a' sgeamachadh!
Surely the competitors will have a good day today when they are in such pleasant surroundings? Of course they won't when the unpleasant Coinneach Clogaid is scheming.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: As part of a school presentation, Flix and Burma are challenged to overcome their differences, and see if they can be friends. Flix is well up for it

programme.desc: Norrie MacIver performs Psalm 68 and Mairi MacInnes sings the hymn Miorbhail Ghrais. Donna Barden recalls her personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon

programme.title: Port An Obain
programme.desc: Oban is the main town of Argyll and Bute. A busy port 365 days a year, with workboats and ferries of all sizes attending to the needs of the local population. It is increasingly popular with tourists, who arrive by train, bus or under sail - a destination offering exceptional seafood and a traditional holiday experience for the many thousands of visitors to enjoy. But it is also a place of work. The sea provides a living for some who reside on beautiful islands located throughout the Argyll area, and their work continues, despite the weather or the season

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Erica Macpherson heads on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers she finds new ideas for designing old spaces

programme.title: Surfing: Marcachd an Tuinn (Riding the Wave)
programme.desc: Part two of two. Keen surfer Ceitlin Lilidh Russell Smith recounts the world history of surfing. Much more than a sport to the people of Tahiti where surfing was born, it is an expression of a culture, the people of the water, the Polynesians. While much of the rich culture and history of the Polynesian people was almost wiped out, thanks to guardians, such as Tom Pohaku Stone, the traditions of dancing on wooden boards was passed on to future generations and to the rest of the world where it is now practised by tens of millions of enthusiasts. Surfing has now for the first time earned its place at the Olympics

programme.title: Seirm: Celtic Connections
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy presents a music show from Celtic Connections 2024, featuring Carlene Carter, Sarah Jarosz, Ewen Henderson, Talisk and Muireann Bradley

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean (Wild Senses)
programme.desc: A look at how animals use taste and smell to survive and communicate in ways that defy belief. In Gaelic

programme.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
programme.desc:
Tha Bagelean Abigail fìor bhlast' agus sònraicht' 'son bruinse no lòn, no fiù 's aig àm sam bith, 's 'ad gad shàsachadh ann an dòigh nach gabh inns' 's iad fèìr taght' 'son an roinn leis an teaghlach no le caraidean.
Abigail's bagels are a very special and tasty brunch or lunch, or anytime experience, satisfying to the extreme and just the thing to share with family and friends.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The wildlife in the seasonal seas in the temperate bands between the freezing poles and the warm tropics, where changing conditions over the course of the year push animals to be resourceful and adaptable. In the winter, storms at sea whip up immense waves that can travel for thousands of miles building to 30 metres height, while in the summer, temperatures can rise by 50 degrees Celsius in a matter of weeks

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Charlotte Smith and Sean Fletcher are in the Ceiriog Valley in north Wales, meeting former clinical vet Claire Whittle, who took on an upland farm two years ago. Charlotte finds out why Claire made the leap into farming and what regenerative farming means to her, before helping with health and pregnancy checks on her cattle. Sean explores the hidden world of dung beetles in a cow pat and helps plant trees in a new agroforestry field

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents the show from Alexandra Gardens in the heart of Cardiff, Treasures include a pipe by a renowned Maori craftsman, a jewel-encrusted stick pin given as a gift from King Edward VII and Queen Alexandra, a book listing wartime spies and a collection of medals and a cap badge belonging to one of the earliest members of the SAS

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Results
programme.desc: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe present the second part of the Blackpool special, announcing the results of the judges' scores and viewer votes, after which the two couples with the lowest combined scores take part in a dance-off to decide who will be next to leave

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The wildlife found in the polar oceans, from a bowhead whale breaking the sea ice with its skull to breathe to giant sea spiders clamber over ancient glass sponges. With a loss of sea ice, many animals are now weakening, driving animals to adapt in surprising ways, from green sea urchins using discarded shells as sun hats to common seals moving further north, only to provide unfamiliar prey for a young polar bear

programme.title: The Witch Farm
programme.desc: In the summer of 1989, Bill Rich moves with his pregnant partner Liz and teenage son Jonathan to a remote farmhouse in the idyllic Brecon Beacons. On the very first night, Liz hears footsteps on the landing. Before long, Liz and Jonathan are sharing disturbing dreams, and as strange events intensify, the family is forced to accept a terrifying new reality. Fact-based supernatural drama, starring Gabrielle Creevy and Michael Socha

programme.title: Songs of Praise
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher is in Liverpool to meet celebrated screenwriter and author Frank Cottrell-Boyce, who chooses his favourite hymns and reflects on life, faith and the value of wonder

programme.title: Nativity 2: Danger in the Manger!
programme.desc: Comedy starring David Tennant and Jessica Hynes. Jingle bells give way to alarm bells when a hapless new teacher agrees to take the pupils of St Bernadette's to rural Wales to compete in a clash of the Christmas choirs. And it just so happens that his twin brother is conducting a rival group.

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The wildlife in the seasonal seas in the temperate bands between the freezing poles and the warm tropics, where changing conditions over the course of the year push animals to be resourceful and adaptable. In the winter, storms at sea whip up immense waves that can travel for thousands of miles building to 30 metres height, while in the summer, temperatures can rise by 50 degrees Celsius in a matter of weeks

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Charlotte Smith and Sean Fletcher are in the Ceiriog Valley in north Wales, meeting former clinical vet Claire Whittle, who took on an upland farm two years ago. Charlotte finds out why Claire made the leap into farming and what regenerative farming means to her, before helping with health and pregnancy checks on her cattle. Sean explores the hidden world of dung beetles in a cow pat and helps plant trees in a new agroforestry field

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents the show from Alexandra Gardens in the heart of Cardiff, Treasures include a pipe by a renowned Maori craftsman, a jewel-encrusted stick pin given as a gift from King Edward VII and Queen Alexandra, a book listing wartime spies and a collection of medals and a cap badge belonging to one of the earliest members of the SAS

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Results
programme.desc: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe present the second part of the Blackpool special, announcing the results of the judges' scores and viewer votes, after which the two couples with the lowest combined scores take part in a dance-off to decide who will be next to leave

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The wildlife found in the polar oceans, from a bowhead whale breaking the sea ice with its skull to breathe to giant sea spiders clamber over ancient glass sponges. With a loss of sea ice, many animals are now weakening, driving animals to adapt in surprising ways, from green sea urchins using discarded shells as sun hats to common seals moving further north, only to provide unfamiliar prey for a young polar bear

programme.title: The Witch Farm
programme.desc: In the summer of 1989, Bill Rich moves with his pregnant partner Liz and teenage son Jonathan to a remote farmhouse in the idyllic Brecon Beacons. On the very first night, Liz hears footsteps on the landing. Before long, Liz and Jonathan are sharing disturbing dreams, and as strange events intensify, the family is forced to accept a terrifying new reality. Fact-based supernatural drama, starring Gabrielle Creevy and Michael Socha

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The wildlife found in the polar oceans, from a bowhead whale breaking the sea ice with its skull to breathe to giant sea spiders clamber over ancient glass sponges. With a loss of sea ice, many animals are now weakening, driving animals to adapt in surprising ways, from green sea urchins using discarded shells as sun hats to common seals moving further north, only to provide unfamiliar prey for a young polar bear

programme.title: The Witch Farm
programme.desc: In the summer of 1989, Bill Rich moves with his pregnant partner Liz and teenage son Jonathan to a remote farmhouse in the idyllic Brecon Beacons. On the very first night, Liz hears footsteps on the landing. Before long, Liz and Jonathan are sharing disturbing dreams, and as strange events intensify, the family is forced to accept a terrifying new reality. Fact-based supernatural drama, starring Gabrielle Creevy and Michael Socha
