programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 2
programme.desc: Another deep dive into the BBC's music archive, pointing the musical compass away from Top of the Pops on a quest to uncover 40 hidden gems. The songs are familiar but the performances may not be, such as Bronski Beat singing Smalltown Boy for the first time on the BBC, Rihanna's rockier version of Umbrella, Sophie Ellis-Bextor covering Pulp's Do You Remember the First Time? and Kate Bush pairing up for a tango during Hounds of Love

programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 1
programme.desc: Expect the unexpected on this journey through the BBC's archive, which includes surprising songs and rare performances taken from shows that may have been forgotten. Featuring appearances by Jimi Hendrix, MC Hammer, Dusty Springfield, Tammy Wynette, the Beach Boys, Pet Shop Boys and John Martyn backed by Phil Collins

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: Sam Ryder, Jeff Stelling, Ella Eyre and Princess and Junior Andre continue their 7,500km race. The third leg sees the teams leave behind the ancient jungles of Borneo to reach the island of Sulawesi, an Indonesian wonderland that lies far from the tourist trail. But with the end of Ramadan fast approaching, the teams must negotiate the crowds heading home for Eid al-Fitr

programme.title: Bill's Included
programme.desc: When Bill's wife walks out on him for the gardener, he's left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students. Bill is thrilled to meet his new housemates - Christian, Zahra, Hettie, and James - but when Christian keeps leaving the fridge door open, he has to come up with a scheme to get it shut without ruining his image as a relaxed, fun landlord. Comedy, starring Rob Brydon

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest national and international stories as they break

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: In a special edition from North Sutherland, Dougie Vipond steps out into a vast expanse of blanket peat bog known as the Flow Country, charting the changes in its land use and its recent designation as a Unesco world heritage site. Arlene Stuart catches up with Joyce Campbell to see how she has made the switch from traditional hill farming to regenerative agriculture, and Leanna Fernandez meets biologists working to protect precious sea trout populations at Loch Hope

programme.title: Beechgrove Repotted
programme.desc: A look at gardens and gardeners who are growing in the far corners of Scotland. From battling with the elements on the tip of Sutherland to a sub-tropical garden paradise in the Borders and growing with no soil, across the bridge over the Atlantic on the Island of Seil these gardens and gardeners are all gardening on the very edges of Scotland

programme.title: A Cook Abroad: Tony Singh's India
programme.desc: Edinburgh chef Tony Singh travels to the state of Punjab to trace his family's roots and discover whether his mum's Punjabi cooking is authentic. He visits Amritsar during the festival of Diwali, receives an exclusive invitation to eat and cook with a maharajah and meets the Nihang, an order of nomadic Sikh warriors. Tony discovers how the Sikh religion and the Punjab's troubled past have created a food and culture like no other, and ends his epic adventure at his ancestral home in New Delhi with his 93-year-old uncle

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress learns about the art of patisserie in Paris, which is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world, sampling the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and a dahlia

programme.title: The Man Who Never Was
programme.desc: Second World War spy drama based on on a true story, starring Clifton Webb. Spring, 1943: as the Allies plan to invade Europe through Sicily, they must deceive the enemy into expecting the attack elsewhere. So Lieutenant Commander Montagu proposes a daring and ingenious plan.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: In Harthill, Scotland, Martel Maxwell encounters a house with a safety order attached to it, which means certain rooms cannot be accessed. Owain Wyn Evans heads to south Wales to see a sizeable unit with lots of development potential. Meanwhile, in Lincolnshire, Dion Dublin does all he can to escape the rain

programme.title: MOTD Live: Women's Super League
programme.desc: Arsenal v West Ham United (Kick-off 2.30pm). Coverage of the match between the London rivals at Emirates Stadium. Arsenal made a disappointing start to the season by their own high standards, but will be expecting to claim three points against a team they thrashed 5-0 in last season's corresponding fixture, with Chloe Kelly scoring a hat-trick

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Longleat in Wiltshire, where expert Claire Rawle spots an unusual Tibetan teapot among the offerings brought in for valuation and it leads to the discovery of similar artefacts. The goods all go under the hammer and with worldwide interest on the objects, there is the potential for a record-breaking sale. Meanwhile, Paul explores Longleat House to find out more about its Elizabethan architecture and controversial creator

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: The teams enter Australia, where the language barriers may have disappeared - only to have been replaced by financial difficulties for all four pairs. Princess and Junior Andre raise funds by herding cattle in the Outback, while Sam Ryder and friend Kaz try to boost their funds working at an avocado farm. Jeff Stelling is in unfamiliar territory when he and son Matt stay at a backpackers' hostel and Ella Eyre and Nana head to the coastal wetlands, where they sleep just a few hundred metres from saltwater crocodiles

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: A calf is discovered without a mother on the Isle of Vallay, leaving Carianne to locate the missing mother and reunite them. In Inverkip, Rachel and Camy are heading to the hills to help any cheviot sheep in need of a midwife, and in South Ayrshire, the Barclay family work round the clock to ensure their flock of beltex ewes safely deliver this year's crop of lambs

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva takes a boat trip down the Seine with chef Eric Ripert and writer Lindsay Shapiro to explore the story of French gastronomy through a seven-course fine-dining meal. At the heart of this tale is Auguste Escoffier, who invented and improved hundreds of classic dishes, revolutionised front of house. and put French haute cuisine on the global map

programme.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Part two of two. The second leg of Simon's journey begins at the Giant's Causeway, before visiting a kelp farm on Rathlin Island. He heads to the Dark Hedges in Co Antrim, one of the filming locations from Game of Thrones, and visits Belfast for the July 12 parades, discovering how the event has divided the city. He also learns more about Oliver Cromwell's influence on Ireland, attends the Gaze film festival, and meets monkeys at an animal sanctuary in the Wicklow mountains

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul travel to Co Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime. They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of a rowing boat. Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey, but Bob has a supposedly foolproof method to try

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: After weeks of travelling, filming and constant attention, life on the road is taking its toll on Bill Murray, but with his brothers Joel and Johnny along for the ride, family offers an escape from fame. The Murrays reflect on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf bound nine siblings together, but by the time they reach Cruit Island in Co Donegal, family reflection gives way to golfing rivalry

programme.title: Rewarding
programme.desc: Special measures put Sinead under pressure as the team training day sparks a bet between Fidelma, Cyril and Francis. Nicola chaperones Joe to his Granda Lips' funeral. Comedy, starring Vittorio Angelone and Hannah McClean

programme.desc: Mark Carruthers looks at the political developments of the week and questions policy makers on the key issues

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Mum goes out to a baby shower and leaves Dad to do the evening routine alone, Bluey misses her and wants her to come back. At first Dad tries to entertain the kids by playing a few rounds of follow the leader and some 'come here and go away' on the swing, but his attempts to distract the kids only last until Bluey starts feeling sad again. After they chat about the fun Mum is probably having at the baby shower, inspiration strikes and Bluey stages her own mock baby shower in the playroom. After dinner and bedtime, Mum comes home to find the whole family happy and snoozing.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo's desire for a pet is tested, when Dad transforms his hand into the chaotic Emu, Shaun. As Shaun turns the house upside down, ignoring their commands, Mum advises Bluey to remain 'calm and controlled'. So, when an unruly Shaun escapes the lead on a walk and runs for the prickle bushes, Bluey summons her inner-mum and stops the bird in its tracks with a calm command. Now that Bluey has got the upper hand, Dad is run ragged, as Shaun must do everything they say at the park. A tired Dad bids Shaun farewell... just in time for the girls to introduce four baby emus Shaun left behind!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey questions why they need good manners, Dad tells her it's because they're not wild animals! So Mum slips Bluey a magic asparagus that turns anyone into whatever animal she wants! Now with Mum, Dad and Bingo running around as chickens, mice and meerkats, Bluey is loving her new rule free life, but soon Lion Mum starts stalking the neighbours, Walrus Dad is going to the bathroom on her toys and Parrot Bingo eats the asparagus! Now they're all stuck and Bluey has to get Parrot Bingo to say 'Dogs' and turn them all back to normal. Perhaps being wild isn't all it's cracked up to be!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum get into a debate with Dad about the definition of teasing. As they recall all the times he's been a big teaser, Dad argues that he was only playing

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey builds herself the perfect make-believe playhouse out of the couch cushions and is delighted when Bingo, Mum and Dad all build their own houses next door! Their new neighbourhood is fantastic, until Bingo takes over Bluey's reading nook with her growing menagerie of farm animals! Unsure how to resolve the situation amicably, Bluey reaches out to Mum (who's having issues of her own dealing with a constantly noisy Dad). When Mum demonstrates the power of being firm yet polite with Dad, Bluey is able to find a compromise with Bingo that restores peace to their tiny neighbourhood.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At bedtime, Bingo panics when she can't find her beloved toy, Floppy. With Mums help, they retrace their steps backwards through the game they played that day to help Bingo remember. Starting with the balcony where they cooked a chickenrat egg, then the bathroom where Dad laid the egg in the laundry. Further back is the Living Room where they turned Dad into a chickenrat in the first place! But the trail goes cold as they can't find Floppy anywhere. On the verge of losing hope, Bingo suddenly remembers and races to the balcony to find that her toy was hidden in the chickenrat egg all along.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: During a quick trip to the shops Bluey, Bingo and Dad play a game of 'Kids', where Bluey plays Mum, Bingo is her cute baby, Snowdrop, and Dad is her sulky son, Diddums. Not only does Bluey hamper Dad's efforts to buy groceries, by buying nothing but junk food, but she also prefers the secretly naughty Snowdrop over Dad and even embarrasses him in front of his friends. When Dad rebels and shows how much of a handful he can really be, Bluey puts her foot down and declares that Snowdrop is her favourite child. Diddums is devastated and Bluey finally recognises why Dads don't pick favourites.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Mum and Dad collapse on the couch after a busy day, they give Bluey and Bingo five minutes until bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mt MumandDad! Bluey hurries ahead, too impatient to wait for Bingo as she packs her camping supplies, leading to accusations of cheating. All their bickering wakes the rumbling mountain and an avalanche of pillows and tickles sends them scurrying for shelter in Bingo's tent. Waiting for the storm to pass, Bingo breaks out her supplies and Bluey apologises for cheating. When the storm passes, they make for the summit and plant their flag together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: While on a camping holiday in the bush, Bluey makes a new friend, a French speaking boy named Jean-Luc. They may not understand the same language, but that doesn't stop them spending their days laughing, playing, planting seeds and hunting for a wild Daddy pig. But one morning, Bluey is heartbroken to discover that Jean-Luc and his family have packed up and gone home. That night Mum tells Bluey that special people come in and out of our lives and she must always cherish the good times. Many years later, a teenage Bluey sits beneath the tree grown from their seeds and sees Jean-Luc once more.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey loves playing hide and seek, but the family are convinced she will get distracted and forget to find them. Bluey promises to stay focused and, after a count to twenty, the game is on! But her promise quickly comes undone when she uncovers Chattermax (a noisy old toy) hidden under the sink. Bluey is distracted and forgets their game, leaving her frustrated family stuck hiding. It's only when she rediscovers how noisy and annoying Chattermax can be, and needs help shutting it off, that Bluey at last harnesses her ability to focus, remembers the abandoned game and finds everyone at last.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Indy and Rusty love playing the Mums and Dads, but they can't agree on who'll stay home to look after the baby. Looking for a new partner to babysit while she works, Indy finds herself faced with Mackenzie's digging obsession, Snickers constant distraction and Winton's gentle befuddlement. Rusty also has it bad, as Bluey pops him in a pram and insists he be her baby! programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Roller-hockey enthusiast Luke Jarvis is given £12,000 to plan his wedding to family-oriented bride-to-be Jaydene Coomber, coming up with a skating-themed ceremony that is all about fun, and a three-day stag party that blows a significant hole in his budget. Lisa, Chris, their kids and Grandma move into a motorhome as Jonathan renovates their log-cabin interiors and illegal lattice stairs. Drew warns that their long wish list must be chopped down

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Lincolnshire and Yorkshire are the settings for the latest culinary contest. First to host are loved-up Mel and Bianca, who hope to impress with their South African menu. Day two sees Jaq and Jim attempt to blow away the opposition, while Chris and Liz present a posh take on some Yorkshire classic dishes. There is also a surprise in store for Bianca

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Straight-talking Mel and partner Patrick host night one in the north-east Lincolnshire town of Grimsby with a traditional menu, followed by seasoned ravers Amber and Ryan. Their goat's cheese starter is not to everyone's taste on the second evening, and tensions run high on the final night as hosts Vanessa and Steve won't take any rudeness from Mel. It's not long before sparks fly around the table

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: The double-team version of the popular dinner-party challenge arrives in Worthing and Portsmouth, where three more couples put their culinary skills to the test. First up are pensioner duo Bill and Hilary, who surprise everyone with their liberal attitudes. Next to host are children's entertainer Doug and his ever-tolerant partner Patsy, who combine fine dining with hippy sensibilities, and finally, 22-year-old hip-hop enthusiasts Micaela and Sanchez prepare a menu with a Jamaican-Filipino twist. With all the evenings complete, the contestants convene one more time to determine the winners

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Couples compete in Bognor Regis, West Sussex, with Carl and Brianha kicking off proceedings with an evening inspired by the glitz and glamour of the French Riviera. Day two sees down-to-earth couple Mark and Lisa cook up some collapsing fish cakes and a Thai curry that proves too hot for some. Finally it's Justin and Karen's turn with a fine dining menu that the pair are convinced will deliver them the £1,000 prize

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Bowlero is a global bowling company with thousands of employees and hundreds of centres. It became a bowling giant almost overnight when it took over AMF and Bowlmor Lanes. Colie Edison created every element of the Bowlero brand. Now she wants to go undercover to find out how the new Bowlero is working for staff and customers. As her alter ego Michelle, who recently lost her job as a court reporter and now wants to find a second career, Colie works as a trainee manager, a lane server, an event host and a trainee facilities manager

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Yanni's in Seattle, where he clashes with defiant owner Peter Avgoustiou, a chef so set in his ways that he hasn't allowed any changes to his menu since the Greek restaurant opened in 1984. Peter's family is concerned the business is becoming trapped in the past, and standards are slipping, but he seems determined to stick to his guns

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to the Prohibition Grille in Everett, Washington, where he meets belly dancer-turned-restaurateur Rishi Brown, who is making all the wrong moves with her business. Distracted from the task of improving her menu by performing for customers, she's oblivious to the disastrous dishes being served from her own kitchen

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to Nashville, Tennessee, the spiritual home of country music, but his visit begins on a sour note at Chappy's Cajun restaurant. Chef John Chapman's careless methods have damaged his reputation, but he blames the local clientele rather than his less-than-appetising food and disturbing kitchen practices. Can Gordon get through to this stubborn owner and save the eatery from disaster?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay revisits three of the most difficult cases he has taken on since the series began. First, he returns to Cafe Hon in Baltimore, Maryland, where owner Denise Whiting was trapped in a nasty battle with the community and had threatened the locals with lawsuits. Next, the chef goes back to Chiarella's in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. When he first visited owners Tommy and Dina DeFino, the business was struggling so badly that Tommy had completely lost his confidence and wife Dina had lost her patience. On his final stop, Gordon travels to Leone's in Montclair, New Jersey, where Rose Leone was depending on her lazy son Michael to run the restaurant

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: A look at what happened after Gordon Ramsay headed to Scottsdale, Arizona, where he met husband-and-wife bistro owners Samy and Amy Bouzaglo, who revealed a shocking contempt for customer feedback. The chef faced the biggest challenge of the series to save Amy's Baking Company - and a media furore unfolded after the episode was broadcast

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown

Nina Conti joins Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley looks after the letters and numbers at the board

programme.title: Greg Davies: The Back of My Mum's Head

programme.title: Tooth Fairy

But that bad attitude comes back to haunt him after he dashes the hopes of his girlfriend's daughter - he's sentenced to work as a tooth fairy, and the tutu and wings are non-negotiable.

programme.title: Arctic Ascent with Alex Honnold
programme.desc: World-class rock climber Alex Honnold launches a first-ever Greenlandic expedition to climb a 4,000-foot sea cliff. First his team must cross a massive glacier and collect precious scientific data from this remote part of the world. Enroute to the upper reaches of the glacier, the team begins a 1,500-foot ascent of a never-before climbed rock wall.

programme.title: Arctic Ascent with Alex Honnold
programme.desc: Alex and the team are hit by deadly ice fall as they make a first ascent of an unnamed 1,500-foot rock wall. They then set out on the first-ever crossing of the Renland Ice Cap where they face snowstorms and deep, deadly crevasses. After surviving a whiteout, they battle to get off the ice and get their first glimpse of the 4000-foot sea cliff Ingmikortilaq, their final climbing objective.

programme.title: Arctic Ascent with Alex Honnold
programme.desc: The final stage of the epic Greenland expedition gets underway. Alex and the other professional climbers begin their ascent of one of the biggest unclimbed walls on the planet, and discover that it could be the most dangerous climb they've ever attempted. Meanwhile the science team get some unexpected results about one of the most important glaciers in Greenland.

programme.title: The Yorkshire Auction House

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Vintage bike restorer Tim Gunn faces a huge challenge when 80-year-old Peter Swash arrives at the workshop with an ancient penny-farthing in tow. The bicycle was barely rideable when he first came across it, but after patching it up with makeshift components, Peter spent a happy childhood riding around the country lanes of Cheshire. Now, 65 years later, Peter's keen to get back on board - but with no seat post, no saddle, no brakes and wheels that don't turn, it's going to take all Tim's expertise and experience to get this rare and marvellous machine back on the road.
Master saddlemaker Suzie Fletcher takes on the repair of a battered leather briefcase with a very proud history. Owner Betty was given it by her parents 65 years ago to mark the occasion of her qualification as an engineer - according to Betty, the first ever female member of the Institute for Structural Engineers. Armed with her briefcase, Betty blazed a trail for gender equality, and Suzie declares herself greatly honoured to take on the repair.
And Steve Fletcher brings all his expertise to bear on the repair of an old clocking-on clock from the bustling British Rail depot in Crewe. Owner Bob spent 25 years clocking on to his shifts on this very same clock, which holds a great deal of emotional significance for him. But the job takes an unexpected turn for Steve when he discovers the existence of a mystery cog that has no obvious place in the mechanism.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Metal worker Dom Chinea takes on the challenge of a battered old barber's pole that stood proudly outside a London barber's shop for decades. Harry's barber shop opened in London's Holborn in 1968 and established itself - and Harry - as a local legend, with the iconic pole a permanent fixture until it closed its doors 35 years later. Now Harry's son Caner has brought the empty metal casing to the barn, hoping Dom can bring it whirring back to life. But lacking not just a motor, but also the iconic red and white pole itself, Dom finds himself with a bigger than expected job on his hands. And it doesn't help when the repair gets off to the worst possible start.
Fine-art conservator Lucia Scalisi takes on the restoration of a significant early work by eminent Nigerian artist Ben Enwonwu. The colourful artwork has faded over time, and the 75-year-old varnish is yellowing badly, but it's the tear down the middle of the painting that's in most dire need of repair. Lucia brings all her skills to bear on the fix, and owner Norma can barely believe her eyes when she sees the finished result.
And Will Kirk undertakes the dramatic transformation of a wooden writing case that had lain hidden and undiscovered under the eaves of the family attic for several decades. Cracked and charred it may be, but the case is of huge significance to owner Alan Thompson, thanks to the documents he discovered inside it, which quite literally changed his life.

programme.desc: The Harpers gather to celebrate Christmas once more - although unlike previous festive specials, this one reveals how the family will be faring 30 years from now. programme.desc: Derek inspects old cop cars including a Rover P6 complete with radio, sirens and V8 engine, and a former Mod waves ciao to his collection of 1960s Italian scooters.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels to leafy Hatch End in north-west London, where he meets the great-nephew of the famous illustrator William Heath Robinson. Michael continues his journey through Slough and Stoke Poges before reaching Windsor, where he surveys the great walls of the castle, chief residence of the British monarch and the oldest and largest occupied castle in the world

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo resumes his tour of the Home Counties in the historic town of Guildford. Later, in Chilworth, he follows his 1936 Bradshaw's guide to Newlands Corner on the slopes of the North Downs. Eventually he crosses into Hampshire to reach Aldershot

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his post-war exploration of northwest England in Bradford, Shipley and Hebden Bridge. In Bradford's Centenary Square, he encounters local literary giant, JB Priestley. At Shipley station, Michael discovers a nature reserve in the middle of the car park. Finally the Calder Valley Line delivers the presenter to the photogenic station at Hebden Bridge

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo stops at Mattoon, Illinois, where he gets a taste of the early life that shaped President Abraham Lincoln, though struggles to split one rail compared with Lincoln's estimated 700 a day. The political pundit then heads to Kentucky, where a bloody conflict proved decisive in victory for Lincoln's Union. Aboard a paddle steamer on the lower Mississippi, Michael hears about the life of former river boat captain Samuel Clemens, better known as Mark Twain, and in Memphis, Tennessee, uncovers the story of a devastating epidemic. In the home of the Blues, Michael joins some Elvis fans at Graceland

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Industrial Age
programme.desc: Fred visits the North East, a region rich in transport history, to explore the development of Britain's railways, from the first steam locomotives to the record-breaking Mallard. A visit to York's National Railway Museum offers the chance to ride a replica of Stephenson's Rocket, while at Ffestiniog Railway he learns about the computer-aided design process used for new locomotives

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Industrial Age
programme.desc: The former steeplejack recalls the golden age of shipbuilding, examining the skills of engineers who turned Britain into one of the leading manufacturing nations, and visits Bristol to pay tribute to his personal hero Isambard Kingdom Brunel. He also travels to Scotland for a voyage on the paddle steamer Waverley

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Age of Steam
programme.desc: The development of steam power, from the earliest experiments in the ancient world to modern-day nuclear power stations. Fred travels to Cornwall to investigate the use of early engines to pump water out of the tin mines

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Age of Steam
programme.desc: The revolution in transport brought about by steam power, charting the technology's development from the earliest colliery railways, through the first passenger train services and to the end of an era in the 1960s

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Islands of America
programme.desc: The presenter travels 1,500 miles to the San Juan Islands in Washington State, just off America's North West Pacific coast, on the border with Canada. There are more than 100 islands, mostly uninhabited. From the San Juan Islands, Martin travels down America's West coast to visit the Channel Islands National Park, which is known as 'America's Galapagos' because of its unique wildlife. Later, Martin takes a 2,000-mile journey across the States to Louisiana, where he visits Avery Island and Delacroix Island

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Man to Manta
programme.desc: The actor embarks on a quest to fulfil his ambition to swim with giant manta rays. His journey starts in the Cayman Islands in the Caribbean, before he moves on to an aquarium in the American state of Georgia. In Ecuador he meets ray expert Dr Andrea Marshall, and in Sri Lanka finds out that the creatures are being hunted by fishermen because of the use of their gills in Chinese medicine. Martin's dream finally comes true when he travels to the Maldives in the Indian Ocean and swims with 40 feeding mantas

programme.title: David Jason's Great British Inventions

programme.title: David Jason's Secret Service

programme.title: Operation Arctic

programme.title: Operation Arctic

Plus, a live report from the tundra on how the bears are getting on

The allied landings in Normandy and their advances through France now offer a tantalising glimmer of hope. By mid-August, a resistance-led insurrection is under way in the capital, in the hopes the allied forces will secure their liberation

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: As the days grow longer, the MacDonalds round up their pregnant Highland cattle on the tiny island of Vallay, off North Uist, for a pre-natal check up and vitamin boost. In the Cairngorms, Jenni's new alpaca arena is finally finished, which means her menagerie of alpacas, donkeys and goats must be moved to their new home. Nikki and Ollie speculate to accumulate in Moray, splashing out on a new honesty shack.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: In a special edition from North Sutherland, Dougie Vipond steps out into a vast expanse of blanket peat bog known as the Flow Country, charting the changes in its land use and its recent designation as a Unesco world heritage site. Arlene Stuart catches up with Joyce Campbell to see how she has made the switch from traditional hill farming to regenerative agriculture, and Leanna Fernandez meets biologists working to protect precious sea trout populations at Loch Hope

programme.title: Craft Christmas at Beechgrove
programme.desc: Jean Johansson presents a programme helping people get ready for Christmas with advice on festive crafts, gifts and baking, beginning with how to light and decorate the tree. Carole Baxter has tips on the garden jobs to be done right now

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Sacked in the Morning
programme.desc: Craig Levein and Amy Irons are joined by author and podcaster Alastair Campbell, who chats about team talks, name-drops and playing with Diego Maradona

programme.title: The Great Food Guys
programme.desc: Chef Nick Nairn and presenter Dougie Vipond go al fresco, making smoked fish scotch eggs with a chunky salad. Singer and actress Clare Grogan joins them in the kitchen to chat and try out the delicious food and drink combination

programme.title: Showpeople: Licensed to Thrill
programme.desc: Documentary following Scotland's show people, delving behind the scenes of the fair and into the homes and lives of this private and close-knit community as they travel across the country. Three generations of the Taylor family set up in Grangemouth, father-and-son duo Trevor and Kristan Smith battle wet weather and family squabbles in Airdrie, while finance guru Sarah Sheeran explains exactly what is involved in buying rides that cost half a million pounds

programme.title: Lover, Liar, Predator
programme.desc: Documentary following four women who discovered they had each been coercively controlled by the same man, and joined forces to end their nightmare and bring him to justice. Jenni, Natalie, Shannon and Robyn waive their anonymity to tell their story in chilling detail, laying bare the confusion, intricacies and frightening realities of coercive control, and revealing how they became trapped by serial predator and sex abuser Aaron Swan. The film unpicks how he got away with his crimes for so long, despite twice being placed on the sex offender register

programme.title: Two Doors Down
programme.desc: Christine locks Sophie in the hut when her daughter refuses to tell her who the father of her baby is, while Cathy has been having therapy and now thinks she can counsel other people. Colin just cannot help himself and cheats when it looks like Eric is going to win a game of darts, and Beth gets caught in the middle. Comedy, starring Arabella Weir, Alex Norton, Doon Mackichan, Jonathan Watson, Elaine C Smith and Sharon Rooney

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Discussion on Scotland's biggest news stories, with analysis from journalists, commentators and guests

programme.title: The Chief
programme.desc: There's a big shock for the top cop when Cameron Miekelson discovers his daughter Ellen is dating an undercover policeman. The Chief's dilemma soon spirals into a moral nightmare as he cannot compromise security arrangements for a controversial visit from an overseas dignitary, but he also has to do the right thing by his family

programme.title: Loop
programme.desc: Scot Squad star Stuart McPherson chats about his Edinburgh festival show, which explores life living with alopecia and the acceptance and resistance the diagnosis brings

programme.title: Splitsville
programme.desc: When Ashley asks husband Carey for a divorce, he turns to friends Julie and Paul for support. Carey is stunned to discover their secret to happiness is an open marriage. However, when Carey and Julie cross a line, the arrangement unleashes jealousy and chaos, forcing both couples to confront what they want from love and commitment. Romantic comedy, starring Dakota Johnson, Adria Arjona, and Michael Angelo Covino, who also co-wrote and directed

programme.title: Forbidden Fruits
programme.desc: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch coven with co-workers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin challenges their sisterhood, forcing the trio to confront their inner darkness. As tensions rise and the coven's secrets threaten to spill, they must face their fears or all meet a violent end. Comedy horror, starring Lili Reinhart

programme.title: Finnegan's Foursome
programme.desc: Two rival brothers and their adult children travel to Ireland to scatter their father's ashes, turning clashing egos and comic mishaps into an unexpected week of family bonding. Comedy drama written, directed by and starring Edward Burns, with Brian d'Arcy James and Erica Hernandez

programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
programme.desc: A freelance reporter returns to Chicago for the holidays and is assigned to profile Darlene, a devoted Bears fan attending her 500th game. Darlene plays matchmaker, bringing the reporter together with her grandson Matt, a firefighter, over the festive season. Romantic drama, starring Lyndsy Fonseca

programme.title: My Christmas Cowboy
programme.desc: After a humiliating college audition, Meg builds a career producing news in Texas. Former crush Billy, now a disgraced Hollywood host, returns home for Christmas. When Meg's injured father asks Billy to host the ranch's Reindeer Roundup, riding lessons rekindle resentment and affection, helping them discover confidence and possibly love. Romantic drama, starring Amy Acker and Luke Macfarlane

programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: Mistletoe and Mimosas
programme.desc: Claire Bennett inherits Uncle Lou's beloved Christmas bar in New York and plans to sell it before Christmas. But when Zach, manager of a rival club, wants to buy it, they compete in events to attract customers. As rivalry turns to romance, Claire and Zach reconsider their priorities together. Romantic drama, starring Tamera Mowry-Housley and Kristoffer Polaha

programme.title: Passenger
programme.desc: After witnessing a horrific crash, a young couple are haunted by a demonic presence that won't stop until it claims them. Horror thriller, starring Jacob Scipio, Lou Llobell and Melissa Leo

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Reminders of Him
programme.desc: Kenna Rowan emerges from a seven-year prison sentence, and returns to the hometown where she was held legally responsible for the death of her boyfriend, Scotty Landry. She is grimly resolved to confront ghosts of the past so she can finally meet the daughter she was forced to give up. Drama, starring Maika Monroe

programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart and Anna Faris. Chris was once an overweight loser, but is now slim, successful and a compulsive womaniser. Returning to his home town, he becomes determined to win the heart of the girl who was his best friend in high school.

programme.title: Christmas with the Coopers
programme.desc: Four generations of a family meet up to spend Christmas together - and all bring their own problems to the gathering, with a fake boyfriend, an arrest for shoplifting and the demands of single parenthood putting the festive season in jeopardy. Comedy, starring Diane Keaton, John Goodman, Ed Helms and Amanda Seyfried, narrated by Steve Martin as the family dog

programme.desc: Comedy starring Martin Freeman. Despite being traumatised by a bad review years earlier, primary school teacher Paul Maddens is tasked with directing the annual Nativity play. Taunted by a teacher from a rival school, Paul foolishly promises that an old flame, now a Hollywood producer, is coming to see his production.

programme.title: Surviving Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy starring Ben Affleck, James Gandolfini and Christina Applegate. Wealthy advertising executive Drew Latham faces Christmas alone after quarrelling with his girlfriend, so he decides to revisit his old childhood home, only to find it now occupied by the Valco family. Desperate for company, he pays the Valcos to let him spend the holiday season with them as their son. While dad Tom is happy to take the cash, the rest of the clan don't take too kindly to Drew's presence, especially daughter Alicia.

But when a glitch in the system means that a little girl is not going to get her new bike, it falls to Santa's clumsy son Arthur to make sure she isn't disappointed.

Raised by Santa's helpers at the North Pole, human infant Buddy matures into a strapping adult and outgrows his cramped surroundings. His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

programme.title: Scrooged
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy, starring Bill Murray, Karen Allen and featuring Robert Mitchum. Frank Cross, the youngest network president in television history, is a man who hates Christmas and plans to exploit the holidays to attract as many viewers as possible, no matter what it takes. However, Frank is about to be visited by three unconventional ghosts who will go to any lengths to make him change his mean-spirited ways.

programme.title: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Emilia Clarke, Henry Golding and Emma Thompson. London, 2017: life could be better for twenty-something chaos magnet Kate, who has her heart set on being a singer but works all year round as an elf in a Covent Garden store. Then she meets too-good-to-be true Tom. Could romance be in the air?

programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Adam Scott and Toni Collette. When a young boy becomes disenchanted with everything that Christmas stands for, he inadvertently summons up the demonic opposite to Santa Claus who unleashes terror upon his family.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: The second part of the futuristic action adventure based on the novels by Suzanne Collins, starring Jennifer Lawrence. A year on from their victory, Katniss and Peeta embark on a winners' tour of the districts. But before they leave, they are issued with a stark warning by President Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Jennifer Lawrence. Having survived two Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen is taken to the underground District 13. There she meets the rebel leader President Alma Coin who asks the inspirational Katniss to become a spearhead in their push against the might of the Capitol.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: Finale to the action adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence. Despite her importance as a figurehead to the rebel cause, Katniss puts her life on the line to join the front lines on an assault on the Capitol. However, President Snow has some nasty surprises waiting for them, while Peeta's brainwashing makes him increasingly unpredictable.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Jason Lee as a struggling Los Angeles songwriter whose fortunes change when he accidentally brings home a trio of singing chipmunks called Alvin, Simon and Theodore. Together they achieve worldwide success, but it's not long before they discover that the music industry has a shady side.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Justin Long and Jason Lee. Singing sensations Alvin, Simon and Theodore have to put aside their glittering career to face up to the reality of studying. But they and their new musical rivals, The Chipettes, must put their pop prowess to use in order to save the school's music programme by winning a battle of the bands competition.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure starring Jason Lee. High jinks while aboard a cruise liner leads to Alvin and his chipmunk pals being stranded on a remote island. But survival in this jungle paradise proves to be harder than they expected.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. With only three days until Dave pops the question, the trio embark on a desperate road trip across America to sabotage his romantic plans. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley

Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse: The Movie
programme.desc: When Gabby's prized dollhouse ends up with eccentric cat lady Vera, the youngster embarks on a adventure to reunite the Gabby Cats and retrieve her beloved diorama before it's too late. Comedy adventure, starring Laila Lockhart Kraner and Kristen Wiig

programme.title: The Bad Guys 2
programme.desc: Struggling to adjust to their newly minted lives as Good Guys, the Bad Guys are offered one last job by a group of all-female criminals. Animated sequel, featuring the voices of Sam Rockwell, Marc Maron and Craig Robinson

programme.title: The Pirates! In an Adventure with Scientists!
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman Animations, featuring the voices of Hugh Grant, David Tennant and Martin Freeman. Pirate Captain may be the leader of a shambolic crew of buccaneers but he's still determined to win the coveted Pirate of the Year competition, even if it means fighting off fearsome rivals Black Bellamy, Peg-Leg Hastings and Cutlass Liz to see who can amass the most booty.

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A pig who works as a bounty hunter finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Animated comedy, with the voices of Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: Four misfits are yanked through a strange portal into a cubic realm powered by imagination. To return home, they must learn its rules and journey alongside an unlikely master crafter. Director Jared Hess's blockbusting fantasy adventure based on the hit videogame, starring Jack Black, Jason Momoa, Emma Myers and Jennifer Coolidge

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Jamie Foxx. Peter Parker just wants to hang out with his girlfriend but is burdened with having to save New York from a new electrically-charged enemy. Also lurking in the shadows is his increasingly embittered and volatile old friend Harry Osborn.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker. Disgraced cop Brian O'Conner is given the chance to redeem himself by going under cover to entrap a powerful Miami drugs baron.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Jeff Goldblum and Julianne Moore. Past experience tells Dr Ian Malcolm not to get involved with businessman John Hammond's new scheme to build a dinosaur park. However, he reluctantly agrees when he realises that his girlfriend is already on site. On his arrival on the secluded island he soon finds that his fears were well founded.

But the routine voyage becomes a serious mission when his old ship is lured into a deadly trap, placing Kirk and his companions at the mercy of a crazed adversary, the formidable Khan.

In order to prevent the probe destroying the planet, Kirk and his crew visit 1986 San Francisco in order to locate two whales to take back to the future.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier

There, they find themselves caught up in a dangerous quest.

The Squirrels embark on their own individual discoveries outside in rivers, the sea, mountains, the jungle and the desert. They learn how to spot an animal's disguise, better known as its camouflage. They see how birds may try to impress one another, which is in stark contrast to how a horned lizard uses its body to warn other creatures off. A fascinating look at nature!

programme.desc: England v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match of the round-robin stage, held at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. With analysis from Ugo Monye, Sean Fitzpatrick and Danny Care, pitchside reports from Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Ireland v South Africa (Kick-off 4.40pm). All the action from the match at Aviva Stadium, as both teams conclude their round-robin fixtures. programme.title: Daolag-bhreac is Seillean (Ladybird & Bee)
programme.desc: Daolag-bhreac is excited by the latest place he has visited. It just seems amazing

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean (Puffin Rock)
programme.desc:
Tha Mossy air bhioran gus a charaid ùr, Fred, a thoirt gu cruinneachaidh-cluich an sgioba. Ge-tà 's e deargann a th' ann am Fred 's chan eil càch cho toilichte a leithid fhaicinn nam measg... gus an seall Fred g' eil e feumail na dhòigh fhèin!
Mossy is excited to bring his new friend, Fred, to today's playdate, but the rest of the gang are less than enamoured when they learn that Fred is actually a flea! However, Fred soon shows that he is quite useful to have around!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean (Puffin Rock)
programme.desc:
Tha bràmair aig Bernie 's tha i gus tighinn gu dìnnear a-nochd! Ge-tà, chan eil dad a dh'fhios aig Bernie dè chuireas e air dòigh! Tha Oona 's Baba ag aontachadh a chuideachadh ach, le Mossy nam meag, saoil am bi biadh air fhàgail mus nochd i?
Bernie has a girlfriend - and she's on her way to the grotto for dinner! However, Bernie has no idea what to prepare for her! Oona and Baba agree to help him out but, with Mossy joining the fray, will there be any food left for the special guest?

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Fuigheag anticipates a birthday treat, but things don’t work out as they should

programme.title: Losgannan/Froglets
programme.desc:
Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a' dol a chladhach airson ionmhais àrsaidh san t-sloc-gainmhich.
Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Brush invites Hare, Fox, Owl and Tusk for a fancy game of croquet. Jack shows up uninvited and wants to play, too

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag (Pompon Little Bear)
programme.desc:
Gus nach tachair an aon rud a-màireach, ithidh Pompon biadh "glan" gus nach bi aige ri fhiaclan a ghlanadh. Ach a' cheist mhòr: a bheil a leithid a rud ann ri biadh glan?
Pompon missed the sun rising as he had to clean his teeth. To avoid the same happening tomorrow, Pompon decides to eat 'clean' food so as to avoid brushing his teeth. But is there such a thing as 'clean' food?

programme.desc: The locals organise a ceilidh for Old Mary who is recovering from her mill accident. A drunken Boyd confronts Mairead and Cairistiona. Things turn sour between Johan and Murdina resulting in a mysterious fire starting at the hotel

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon learns about life along the border between Finland and Russia. Since Russia’s attack on Ukraine in 2022 the border has closed completely, transforming the lives of people on both sides. In Finland, Ramsay hears the stories of families who have been separated from their loved ones on the other side, meets those responsible for securing the border and hears from people who have lost their livelihood overnight because of its closure

programme.title: Skipinnish aig a' Chaisteal (Shorts)

But the transatlantic swap soon leads to more romantic entanglements for the two women.

But their actions are destined to come back to haunt them.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Oscar-winning horror mystery starring Daniel Kaluuya and Allison Williams. Chris, a young African-American photographer, is understandably anxious when he's invited to stay with his wealthy white girlfriend's parents at their family estate. Admitting she hasn't told them he's black only adds to Chris's apprehension, but mum and dad are warm and welcoming. However, as the weekend unfolds, Chris begins to suspect all is not as it seems.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: Cult mystery thriller starring Kyle MacLachlan, Isabella Rossellini, Dennis Hopper and Laura Dern. Jeffrey Beaumont's corner of small-town America is a pretty and peaceful place. But not far below the idyllic surface lies a dark and violent world, upon which young Jeffrey stumbles when following the trail of a severed ear.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt

With just 60 minutes to buy three items, Russ makes an early pit stop at a stall selling boxed toy cars and a marcasite brooch catches the sisters' attention

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The wildlife found in the polar oceans, from a bowhead whale breaking the sea ice with its skull to breathe to giant sea spiders clamber over ancient glass sponges. With a loss of sea ice, many animals are now weakening, driving animals to adapt in surprising ways, from green sea urchins using discarded shells as sun hats to common seals moving further north, only to provide unfamiliar prey for a young polar bear

Will returning customers be impressed by the changes?

programme.title: A Friend of the Family
programme.desc: Flashbacks reveal how the Berchtolds and Brobergs grew closer. But as Mary Ann and the girls fall under the spell of their fun-loving neighbour, Bob comes to see him as a threat

programme.title: A Friend of the Family
programme.desc: The Brobergs fight to restore a sense of normality as they prepare to face Robert in court. But Jan's anxiety about the mission only snowballs with time. Meanwhile, Mary Ann's unanswered questions about Mexico and her growing disconnect with Bob lead her to a gut-wrenching decision

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa takes up ice hockey and proves so good at the game that she completely transforms her ailing team's fortunes. Dismayed at being outshone by a girl, Bart tries to compensate by becoming a teacher's pet - only to be beaten up by bullies

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer and Marge attend a confectionery convention, where they plan to make off with lots of free sweets. Unfortunately, Homer's love of candy results in him being wrongly accused of sexual harassment by the family's babysitter and smeared by the media. Featuring the guest voice of Dennis Franz (NYPD Blue)

programme.title: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It
programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer meet Amber and Martin Brammah in Waterbeach, Cambridgeshire, who are undecided on whether they should sell their home or completely renovate it. Amber owns a fitness company and runs classes from home, and feels a bigger property would be better for her business. However, Martin feels that it would be better to use their budget to renovate their current family home

programme.title: Sunday Brunch
programme.desc: Highlights of the food and chat show, with Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Frasier persuades Cliff to undergo a course of electric-shock therapy as a means of making friends and influencing people. Kelsey Grammer and John Ratzenberger star

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: In a feeble attempt to prove their masculinity, Norm, Woody and Cliff pretend they've been skydiving - but a revelation from Rebecca makes Sam decide to take the plunge for real. Comedy, starring Ted Danson

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug and Deacon try their luck on the gaming tables in Atlantic City, telling Carrie a white lie to ensure there is no trouble at home - but their night proves far from profitable. Kevin James and Victor Williams star

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug reveals his benevolent side when he decides to become a mentor to an underprivileged child, but is disappointed with the boy assigned to him. Meanwhile, Carrie has to explain to a partner in her law firm why she declared her love for him over the phone. Kevin James and Leah Remini star

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug is duped by his neighbour into buying a water filtration device. He is drawn deeper into trouble when he signs up to be a licensed seller and needs to find 10 more salesmen to follow in his footsteps to recoup his investment. Comedy, starring Kevin James

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Robert is injured in the line of duty and Ray realises he is partly responsible. Unfortunately his bedside manner leaves a lot to be desired, until he grudgingly agrees to Debra's demand to tell his brother how much he cares for him. Comedy, starring Ray Romano, Brad Garrett and Patricia Heaton

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra is angry to discover Ray recorded a Super Bowl game over their wedding video, and forces him to renew his marriage vows as a way of making amends. Comedy, starring Ray Romano and Patricia Heaton

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray's efforts to take an interest in one of Ally's hobbies backfire, leaving him searching for a particularly rare trading card to make amends. American comedy, starring Ray Romano, Madylin Sweeten and Patricia Heaton

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Niles puts Daphne on a diet, unaware she has secret stashes of food hidden all over the place. Roz tries a new perfume guaranteed to have a devastating effect on men, while Frasier sets out to save station manager Kenny's marriage - only to end up dating his wife

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Niles attends a Seattle SuperSonics basketball game with Frasier, where he is plucked out of the crowd at random and offered a big cash prize to sink a half-court shot. David Hyde Pierce stars

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Roz asks Frasier to narrate her documentary on the history of space travel - but he makes such a hash of it she ends up getting rid of him and recruiting former astronaut John Glenn instead. Meanwhile, Niles tries to relive his childhood by entering a kite-flying competition

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Niles and Frasier search for a wealthy patron prepared to give their old school a much-needed cash injection, and soon find the ideal candidate - Martin's new girlfriend. Comedy, starring Kelsey Grammer and David Hyde Pierce, with Barbara Babcock (Hill Street Blues)

programme.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay travels across the United States in search of restaurants in dire need of renovation - and after analysing their situation, he has just 24 hours to bring them back from the brink of disaster. In the second episode, Gordon and his team arrive at Blend on Main in New Jersey, where they get to work renovating the once popular restaurant which has fallen into decline, leaving the owner and chef Lou Smith $500,000 in debt

programme.title: Channel 4 News Summary
programme.desc: Midday news summary

programme.title: Renovation Nation
programme.desc: In Warwickshire, Andrew and Mandy aim to save their crumbling stable block. In Kent, Iain and Miranda create a starlight ceiling for their attic cinema room, and in Yorkshire, Jill and John strip back their entire Victorian villa to create a spacious modern home

programme.title: Escape to Florida
programme.desc: Dublin-born fire captain David is putting on a special drill to impress the new station chief and show how his elite team train to keep the residents of Tequesta safe. In the city of Palm Coast, Judy gets ready to enjoy her well-deserved retirement playing pickleball

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with JB Gill in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels, consonants and numbers

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Chris and Helen hope to find the perfect home in their favourite holiday spot in Greece's eastern Peloponnese for £350k. Can Lee Juggurnauth deliver their Grecian dream?

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Rory Peck Awards
programme.desc: The Oath, co-directed by Louis Hollis, follows a Palestinian doctor based in Israel facing an ethical exploration of upholding the Hippocratic oath in a bitterly divided nation

programme.title: Lawless Britain?: Undercover on the Streets - Dispatches
programme.desc: Ellie Flynn investigates why people feel Britain is becoming a more lawless environment in the face of official crime figures which indicate that violent crime is falling. programme.title: The Plot to Kidnap Holly Willoughby
programme.desc: Documentary about a 36-year-old security guard's plot to kidnap, rape and murder the presenter, which was uncovered by an undercover officer specialising in cybercrime through his online conversations on a covert chatroom. With contributions from his ex-partner, his barrister, a cyber-crime law enforcement specialist and the reporter who covered the case, and with testimony from two women in another cyberstalking case

programme.title: Love Cheats
programme.desc: Real-life cases of romance fraud. A man claiming to be a secret millionaire sweeps divorced kickboxer Wendy and recruitment consultant Christine off their feet, while orchestrating a series of cruel financial traps. programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: On the first night in the West Country, bossy Tam and her husband Stuart's evening of local cuisine impresses some of their guests. On day two Ian, Phil and their houseboat take centre stage, with all the guests excited to get on board - particularly Tam and Stuart, who get to grips with the boat's horn. However, the fishy menu is definitely more sink than swim for some. Finally, competitive American duo Kyle and Renee serve up a surprise Italian menu

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to Brooklyn, New York, to tackle a 55-year-old family business. Owner John Esposito left school at the age of 14 and has worked at his parents' restaurant, Sal's Pizzeria, ever since. Their success meant they could afford to purchase the location next door in the 1990s, naming it Mama Maria after John's mother, who died in 2002. But when he lost his father as well, John became overwhelmed by the responsibility of running both establishments and his livelihood is at risk

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to Wilkinsburg in Pennsylvania, home to Ms Jean's Southern Cuisine, which was opened by retired special-education teacher Jean Gould. During the chef's attempt to save the business from disaster, he discovers her soul-food restaurant resembles a dentist's waiting room and finds a lot of tension between Jean and her employees, who claim she is a Jekyll-and-Hyde character

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Alfonso Ribeiro presents light-hearted entertainment and family-friendly laughs, as viewers' home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will's devotion to his new girlfriend Kathleen is put to the test when an earthquake leaves them trapped in a basement

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will and Carlton try to help Ashley make peace with a school bully, but find convincing their parents to follow suit proves an altogether tougher task

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer forms his own security group to help quell the rising tide of crime and anarchy in Springfield. Unfortunately his actions antagonise local mobster Fat Tony, who threatens to have him killed if he does not leave town. With the guest voice of Joe Mantegna

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: With a little help from Homer and a fortune cookie, Mr Burns meets a woman who agrees to marry him - although her ex-boyfriend is unhappy about the idea. Featuring the guest voice of Julia Louis-Dreyfus (Seinfeld)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: At Halloween, a computer menaces the family, Lisa and Bart embark on a Harry Potter-style adventure and Homer is cursed by a gypsy. With the guest voices of Pierce Brosnan and Matthew Perry

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Moe refurbishes his bar, turning it into a swanky establishment for Springfield's beautiful people. Unfortunately, he alienates all his regulars in the process - so Homer begins selling booze from his garage. With the guest voices of REM

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Despite Beverly's wishes, Jackie's parents allow Adam to watch horror movie A Nightmare on Elm Street, and a family disagreement ensues. Meanwhile, Erica starts hanging out at her old high school and soon realises she's not as popular as she once was

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Murray is angered when he finds out that Adam has no interest in auditioning for a school stage production. Meanwhile, Beverly interferes with Erica's latest career plan

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Hayley's plan for a fun-filled girl's day with Rainer Shine's teenage daughter may be a little more angst-filled than expected, while Luke finds himself in a compromising position with a widow at the club, and unwittingly helps Jay with his petition. At the Pritchett-Tucker home, Gloria, Phil and Cam have formed a secret alliance to ensure their respective mistakes are concealed from their spouses, but Mitchell starts suspecting something just isn't right

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: A simple texting error threatens everything when Manny and Luke put on a fancy winter ball at the school, Mitchell gets a wake-up call when he offers to help, while Jay's thinly veiled attempt to get out of it by pretending to want to spend time with Phil backfires. Vanessa Bayer guest stars as an overbearing mother

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Mitch gets a shock when Cam calls a concierge to save his ruined New Year's Day feast, while Phil's dad Frank causes waves when he brings a date. Gloria and Jay have to decide who should take care of little Joe if something should ever happen to them. Guest starring Kelsey Grammer and Fred Willard

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Cam is incensed that an anonymous and rude parent robbed him of a precious moment with Lily during her recent dance recital and goes to extremes to uncover her identity and give her a piece of his mind. Meanwhile, Jay, Claire and Mitch attend a family wedding and unexpectedly run into Dede at the reception, and Phil and Gloria are on a college tour with Luke and Manny

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: When Lisa's new guinea pig destroys a painting in the family's living room, Marge and Homer pick up a replacement at the Van Houtens' yard sale. However, when they realise their purchase could be a lost, valuable masterpiece they must decide whether to keep all of the possible windfall or share it with Milhouse and his family

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa enters an essay-writing contest to sing the praises of the hero of her choice, so she chooses Homer - and when she makes an accompanying speech that grabs the attention of Brazil's football governing board, the couch potato ends up being recruited as a referee for the 2014 World Cup

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge worries that Lisa has sold herself short when she starts dating a layabout whose only talent is for entering competitions - inadvertently hurting Homer's feelings in the process. Bart befriends a local criminal who goes by the name of Snake. With the guest voice of Zach Galifianakis (The Hangover)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart starts dabbling in the dark arts, only to cast a spell on his teacher that seemingly results in her getting pregnant. Word soon spreads that the mischief-maker is some kind of wizard and he becomes a saviour to childless couples in Springfield. But then he is kidnapped by Big Tony, who wants a champion racehorse to conceive

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: Kathleen-Angel suffers heartbreak alone in the woods and Theresa is forced to confess when her lies catch up with her. Meanwhile, a father and son put their cards on the table

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Two teachers head out on a double date, but when they run into familiar bar patrons, it proves to be an unfortunate distraction; at Ava's first book club meeting, the group ends up in a debate over who would be the best post-apocalyptic leader.

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Philip and Vivian take a romantic weekend break and Geoffrey attends a butlers' convention, so Will and his cousins rent out the house to a production company who are shooting a music video

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will wins $1,000 at the Bel-Air country club fundraiser, and promptly infuriates Philip and Vivian by refusing to donate his windfall to charity. Comedy, starring Will Smith and Alfonso Ribeiro

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: One Day, Married at First Sight Australia, The Apprentice, Boarders and The Rescue are among the shows appraised by the amateur critics. They also offer their thoughts of ITV's news coverage of MP Lee Anderson, following controversial comments he made regarding London Mayor Sadiq Khan. From March 2024

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on shows including Trigger Point, One Day, Married at First Sight Australia, Sort Your Life Out, Into the Congo with Ben Fogle and Earthsounds. They also appraise a feature about rumpology aired on This Morning and BBC news reports on a by-election in Rochdale. From March 2024

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: Oscar-winning historical drama directed by and starring Mel Gibson. Scotland at the end of the 13th century: the young William Wallace sees his father and brother killed by the English. Later, when his sworn enemies execute his wife, Wallace leads the clans in the fight for Scottish independence.

programme.title: The Killing Fields
programme.desc: Biographical war drama starring Sam Waterston, Dr Haing S Ngor and John Malkovich. Cambodia, 1973: American journalist Sydney Schanberg and his guide Dith Pran are operating out of the war-torn ruins of Phnom Penh. When the Khmer Rouge armies enter the city, foreign reporters find themselves the target of hatred and are rounded up, facing the prospect of possible execution.

programme.title: Imitation of Life
programme.desc: Classic melodrama from director Douglas Sirk, starring Lana Turner. Aspiring actress Lora Meredith and her black housekeeper Annie Johnson both struggle to cope with the growing pains and problems of their daughters.

programme.title: Halls of Montezuma
programme.desc: Second World War action drama starring Richard Widmark. With US forces locked in a battle for supremacy against the Japanese in the South Pacific, a tough marine officer leads a patrol on a dangerous mission to capture enemy soldiers for interrogation.

programme.title: To Hell and Back
programme.desc: Biographical war drama starring Audie Murphy. Having spent his childhood in poverty in Texas, young Audie Murphy is turned down as physically unsuitable by the marines and the US Navy. Undeterred, he fights on to become the most decorated American soldier in the Second World War.

programme.title: Bridge of Spies
programme.desc: Spy thriller based on a true story, starring Tom Hanks and Mark Rylance. At the height of the Cold War, it falls to insurance lawyer James B Donovan to represent Soviet spy Rudolf Abel and broker a prisoner swap involving two American men - pilot Francis Gary Powers and student Frederic Pryor.

programme.title: Wrath of Man
programme.desc: Action thriller directed by Guy Ritchie and starring Jason Statham. A new employee working as a security guard for an armoured truck company proves his mettle during an attempted heist. His colleagues are impressed, and then increasingly suspicious about his skill set and motivation.

programme.title: Commando
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. Special Forces Colonel John Matrix retires to his mountain home and steadfastly refuses to return to active service. But when his daughter is kidnapped by South American revolutionaries, Matrix must undertake his most important mission - to rescue her.

programme.title: Ramses the Great: King of Ancient Egypt
programme.desc: The secrets and lies of mighty pharaoh Ramses II, who ruled Egypt from 1279 to 1213BC - one of the longest reigns in pharaonic history. He was a cultural innovator, diplomat and self-promoter. He built monuments all over Egypt and as this documentary reveals became a caricature of his own propaganda for thousands of years

programme.title: Egypt's Unexplained Files
programme.desc: This episode delves into the brainpower behind ancient Egypt's revolutionary breakthroughs in every field, from medicine to engineering. Examining their colossal cities, their artistic masterpieces and their surgical procedures, we reveal that this is a culture whose genius has truly shaped our modern world.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Perplexing historical objects include the Jericho Head, a 9,000-year-old clay-covered artifact. Plus, a 1950s machine built to control the weather and a map that could be the oldest ever found

programme.title: Secrets of Great British Castles
programme.desc: Dan Jones heads to the south-east of England to explore the turbulent history of Dover Castle. He reveals that Henry II ordered its construction not only as a statement of royal power, but also out of guilt for the murder of Thomas Becket, the Archbishop of Canterbury, in 1170. Dan discovers how a vast network of tunnels was used to defend the castle, including underground barracks built during the Napoleonic Wars and a nuclear bunker created during the Cold War

programme.title: Secret Societies: In the Shadows
programme.desc: The history of the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn, which was devoted to the study and practice of occult Hermeticism and metaphysics during the late 19th and early 20th centuries

programme.title: Truthseekers
programme.desc: The mystery surrounding the origin of enchanting crystal skulls. Others think they might be relics from the legendary island of Atlantis or proof that extraterrestrial visited the Aztecs

programme.title: Bone Detectives: Britain's Buried Secrets

Among the bones recovered is an unusual case of grave disturbance, in which the remains of a middle-aged man seem to have been stabbed and beheaded after burial
