programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer's enthusiasm skills land him a job at a secretive company with a mind-altering agenda.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Beverly and Murray grow concerned about Adam's obsession with toys, so try to distract him with a new hobby. Meanwhile, Erica's band the Dropouts decide to audition for reality television talent show Star Search, but their egos threaten the band's future

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Barry realises that as a future doctor, he should be more concerned about Murray's health, so he enlists the Jenkintown Posse and Coach Mellor to help get his father in shape. Meanwhile, Beverly is horrified to learn that Erica and Adam don't want any of the priceless heirlooms in her fancy, never-really-used living room

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Jay shows a bit of favouritism when he and Gloria must deal with Joe's inappropriate Valentine gift-giving and Manny's dating indecisiveness, while Cam and Mitch try to get Lily, Haley and Sal to stand up to the men in their lives, but things don't turn out as planned

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Feeling empowered after his successful DIY project, Phil convinces Jay to invest in a property that he's always wanted to develop. Meanwhile, Claire's newfound love of cooking Sunday dinners hasn't been as successful as she thinks

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Despite their lofty hopes, Phil and Jay's property investment might turn out to be a bust, forcing Phil to rethink his original dream. Meanwhile, Cam lands in the hospital due to a head injury and refuses to have an MRI thanks to a traumatic incident with a well when he was a child. Determined to finally impress Claire and keep her from re-gifting her birthday present, Gloria surprises her with a day of luxury at the office. However, after Claire had to implement some rather harsh budget cuts at work, a massage at her desk may not be sending the right message.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: An online video sets Cam on a quest to restore Fizbo's good name, while Phil is in for a surprise when he meets his future stepbrother and Manny enlists Gloria, Claire and Haley for a read-through of his new play

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart starts dabbling in the dark arts, only to cast a spell on his teacher that seemingly results in her getting pregnant. Word soon spreads that the mischief-maker is some kind of wizard and he becomes a saviour to childless couples in Springfield. But then he is kidnapped by Big Tony, who wants a champion racehorse to conceive

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: There is a big change in Springfield when Homer wakes up one morning to find he and the world around him are made of Lego. To begin with, it seems like a pretty great existence - but Simpson Senior can't quite shake the feeling that everything is far from awesome

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer manages to ruin any chance of building a friendship with his new neighbour, while Marge is concerned about the lack of friends Lisa has, and comes up with a plan to pay one of her classmates to pretend that they have the same interests as her daughter. However, things do not end as planned

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart betrays Milhouse at Springfield Elementary's annual sports day when he seizes the opportunity to win a race rather than save his best friend from the school bullies. Is this the end of their bromance for good? Meanwhile, Homer tries to bring back the 4th of July fireworks when they are cancelled due to budget cuts. With the voices of Glenn Close and former US athlete Edwin Moses

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: Concern grows after Kathleen-Angel doesn't return home, and Sienna is warned to keep things professional at work. Meanwhile, an affair is discovered and a couple plan to elope

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Jacob manages to pull off a school-wide field trip to the park, but when Abbott must share the playground, the fun and games turn competitive. Meanwhile, Mr Johnson enjoys having the empty school to himself

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: The Banks family spends Christmas at a ski lodge, where Will rashly befriends a stranger who betrays his trust by robbing them. Comedy, starring Will Smith

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Hilary gets a new catering job for a swanky Bel-Air party on the strength of exaggerated claims on her CV, so the Banks family has to rescue her

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on shows including The Gentlemen, Casualty, Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?, Crufts 2024, Queens and Martin Compston's Norwegian Fling. They also critique ITV News' coverage of the Princess of Wales' apparently manipulated Mother's Day photograph

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on shows including The Great Celebrity Bake Off for SU2C, Hunted, One Day, Anton & Giovanni's Adventures in Spain, Married at First Sight Australia, Chicken Nugget, This Morning and BBC News

programme.title: Commando
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. Special Forces Colonel John Matrix retires to his mountain home and steadfastly refuses to return to active service. But when his daughter is kidnapped by South American revolutionaries, Matrix must undertake his most important mission - to rescue her.

programme.title: Joyland
programme.desc: Drama starring Ali Junejo, Rasti Farooq and Alina Khan. Unemployed Haider is a disappointment to his traditionalist father, but things seem to be looking up when he gets a job at a theatre. Telling his family that he is the manager, Haider is actually working as a backing dancer for Biba, a trans performer. When he starts to develop feelings for Biba, Haider's life becomes even more complicated.

programme.title: Anne of the Thousand Days
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Richard Burton and Geneviève Bujold. Henry VIII discards his first wife, Catherine of Aragon, for the pretty young Anne Boleyn. Their courtship lasts six years while Henry awaits a divorce. But when their eventual marriage can only produce a daughter and no son and heir, Henry uses this as an excuse to rid himself of his second wife by execution.

programme.title: Cleopatra
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Elizabeth Taylor, Richard Burton and Rex Harrison. 48 BC: Egypt is overrun by Roman forces and Cleopatra is forced to give up the throne. She becomes the lover of Julius Caesar, the Consul of Rome, and bears him a son. When Caesar is assassinated, Cleopatra seeks solace in the arms of Mark Antony.

programme.title: Charlotte Gray
programme.desc: Second World War romantic drama based on the bestselling novel by Sebastian Faulks, starring Cate Blanchett. A young woman volunteers to become a spy when her lover, an RAF pilot, goes missing in occupied France. Parachuted behind enemy lines, she makes contact with members of the local Resistance, but is soon embroiled in a web of betrayal that leads to her own loyalty being questioned.

programme.title: Copshop
programme.desc: Action crime thriller starring Gerard Butler and Frank Grillo. Low-level con artist Teddy Murretto, on the run from the mob, gets himself arrested for his own protection. Unfortunately, the hitman hired to kill Teddy has the same idea, plunging the two into a game of locked-down cat-and-mouse.

programme.title: The Son
programme.desc: Drama starring Hugh Jackman. Peter Miller, a successful businessman, reluctantly agrees to reconnect with the teenage son from his first marriage, who now suffers from severe depression. Having been estranged from one another, the two struggle to reconcile as Peter is forced, gradually, to reckon with his own shortcomings as a parent.

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Lee Mack raises serious questions around the use of cling film, Charlotte Ritchie anoints an insect, and Jamali Maddix nearly chokes on a many-sided dessert. Alex Horne helps coax the trio - as well as fellow contestants Mike Wozniak and Sarah Kendall - as they attempt to complete Greg Davies' tasks

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats
programme.desc: Irreverent panel show hosted by Jimmy Carr. Two teams answer questions based on opinion polls carried out around the country to see who best understands what is going on in Britain today

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown Christmas Special

programme.desc: Joe DiDomizio, CEO of travel retailer Hudson Group, goes undercover to ensure the company is fighting fit for the future. The businessman hopes to find that the company's vow to be 'the traveller's best friend' is being upheld by his employees

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Greg Miller, CEO of the Larry H Miller Group of Companies and co-owner of National Basketball Association team the Utah Jazz, goes undercover. Since his father died he has made many changes to the organisation, and posing as a contestant on a reality TV competition to win a dream job, he works among his own staff to see if his dad's legacy still lives on

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Amateur dramatics enthusiasts Ryan and Kitty kick off proceedings in Liverpool, with an experimental menu, but they have a tough crowd to please. Night two's hosts are hairdresser Karen and builder Alun who throw a more sophisticated evening, but parts of their menu resemble breakfast. Finally, it's the turn of Birkenhead couple Tony and Debby to host with what they think is a winning formula

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Liverpool, beautician Pam and ex-footballer Joey, serve up an Italian menu that confuses their guests. On day two, Mike and Gaynor impress with their Thai menu although one guest, Danielle, is dumbfounded by the fishcake starter, thinking it's a fish and a cake. Finally, youngsters Ste and Danielle treat their guests to an American themed menu and Danielle's hidden talent, which leaves everyone gawping

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Groom-to-be and survival enthusiast Tom plans an outdoor wedding on a remote Scottish island, and wants to put his survival skills to the test with a woodland ceremony and a rugged reception. However, his future bride Sue dreams of a traditional wedding day in a stately home

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Groom-to-be David plans a dance flash mob wedding in a shopping centre in front of hundreds of people for his fiancee Kelly. Her dreams of becoming a dancer were cut short by illness, so David wants to celebrate the passion she had to give up by putting her at the centre of attention. However, the bride-to-be wants a small intimate wedding where she can forget about her condition

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Mary needs help managing a tiny parking lot in Van Nuys, California. Ivy goes on the prowl for a bike, while Dave scores a therapeutic locker

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Brandi and Jarrod bring an old friend along to do some heavy lifting, and Shana and Edwina crack themselves up with some snappy accessories

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Rick Forman, founder and CEO of New Jersey-based discount clothing store Forman Mills, goes incognito among his own staff posing as a contestant on a reality show. He plans to go undercover because he intends to double the number of stores in the next year and wants to make sure that all the outlets are doing well so that revenue doubles too

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Jessica Herrin, the founder and CEO of direct sales company Stella & Dot, goes undercover. She pretends to be a reality show contestant to access the workforce and find out whether her original vision for the firm is still being carried out as the organisation grows

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Halloween special in which children have trouble with their costumes and pups dress up for the holiday. Plus, jump scares galore

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Kenny indulges in Perris, California. Also, Jarrod's lousy locker doesn't offer him any protection and Rene's tools end up being older than he expects.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Rene makes a costly gamble. Meanwhile, Brandi wades through trash and Ivy and Pops clear up confusion over a massive mysterious mechanism.

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: It's the final night of the charter, but there's still heaps of drama to dish out with a captain's reprimand, an unlikely hookup and another huge argument

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.desc: A young man who has had a severe reaction to a recreational drug is wheeled into resus by paramedics, and senior sister Jen and the medical team face a challenge to calm their patient down so they can treat him. programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: Schizophrenic Graham, 75, is brought to King's College Hospital after being stabbed in the neck by a stranger on his doorstep, and needs a CT scan to reveal the extent of his wound. programme.title: 24 Hours in Police Custody: A Family Vendetta
programme.desc: Part one of a two-part special. Police receive a 999 call to an address in the quiet Cambridgeshire village of Bluntisham after a man has been fatally shot. Within minutes, a new emergency call is received for another shooting in another village just a 10-minute drive away. The new victim is the father of the first man found dead. Detectives establish that the motive for the double murder could lie in a dispute over who should have custody of the child of the first victim

programme.title: 24 Hours in Police Custody: A Family Vendetta

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The competition moves to the Windy Bottom B&B in Maidstone, Kent, where owners Gloria Barnett and Dave Goulding try to impress their guests with a trip to Leeds Castle. programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The third visit is to the Jolly Carter pub in Bolton, Greater Manchester, run by Phil and Angie Sutcliffe. Despite a few nerves about the accommodation not measuring up, the room inspections go well, but the guests' verdict on the afternoon's roller disco remains to be seen

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: John Humberstone hosts at the 18-room Alexandra Hotel in Llandudno, where he hopes the scaffolding on the outside of his establishment will not ruin his chances. programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The contestants featured on the show reunite to revisit the highs and lows of their various stays, and as the B&B owners confront their critics face to face, they discover what the rival parties really thought of the quality of service that they encountered. After the deliberations are over, the winning guest house is announced

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: On the first night in Peterborough, 39-year-old land surveyor and part-time musician Muneer hopes to win over his guests with a menu based on Pakistani recipes passed down through his family for generations. The authenticity extends beyond his food, with Muneer seating his guests on the floor of his specially dressed dining room. His guests include driving instructor Christine, hairdresser Ben, fiery Brazilian Rosie and fridge salesman Gregory. While his food receives mixed reviews, His guests discover his master plan for musical success, suffer bad jokes and find out that one of their fellow diners believes in mermaids

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Peterborough, driving instructor Christine hopes her vegetarian cuisine will grab her the £1,000 prize. But she's worried about being in the firing line, after Rosie compared Muneer's food to vomit on the first night. Now Moony's determined to give Rosie a public dressing down. However, with everyone dreading Christine's meat-free and bland-sounding menu, Rosie may not be the only one who has to bite her lip

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Peterborough, mobile hairdresser Ben plans a gourmet night. Most of his guests are looking forward to some meat after Christine's vegetarian feast the night before. And after laid-back Muneer and critical Rosie seem to have put their tension behind them at Christine's, Ben's determined to take things up a notch as he entertains his guests with his amazing body art, cooking skills and pet crabs

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Fridge salesman Gregory serves up a Spanish menu in Peterborough, accompanied by a charm offensive that he hopes will win him the £1,000 prize. Will it work or will the guests give him the cold shoulder?

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Fiery Brazilian Rosie is confident that her night will be the best of the week in Peterborough. After Gregory used packet mixes, Rosie is determined to show him how to throw a dinner party by making everything from scratch. She's ruffled a few feathers throughout the week with her brutally honest critiques, and her guests, roused for retribution, scour every element of her Brazilian night for any faults, from her samba dancers to her authentic pig-ear stew

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The week begins at the Old Rose & Crown in Birmingham, with hosts Andrew and Jo Hodges. But problems with paintwork and missing milk leave them with some meaty feedback to chew over.

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Jill and Inez host the second visit of the week, at Middlewick in Glastonbury. The guests are confounded by a cottage next to a camping pod, and the avocado breakfast offering.

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: At The Griffin Inn in Lincolnshire, hosts Jamie and Leila take the guests on a tour of their family heritage. Guest Jo dishes the dirt on Jamie's decorating, and damp patches are a problem.

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The final visit of the week is to Crossroads House in Carlisle, owned by Julie and Alistair Musgrave, who pride themselves on their full English fry-up and Cumberland banger. Jamie and Leila are surprised by the B&B's roadside location but impressed by their newly spick-and-span room, while Jill and Inez dig into the mismatched decor in theirs. At drinks, Julie and Alistair reveal their entrepreneurial ambitions and are confident their breakfast offering will bring home the win. In the morning, Jamie and Leila are feeling rough after a restless night whilst in the kitchen Julie is experiencing a last-minute crisis of confidence

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The B&B owners meet for the last time to trade feedback, starting with The Old Rose & Crown, where Jamie and Leila lay into the linen. Things take an emotional turn when Julie and Alistair chew over their bad breakfast score. There are harsh truths, heated debates and disagreements as the payments are revealed before the winner is finally announced

programme.title: American Pickers

Twenty-seven-year-old Nick is looking for a companion and housemate, with the help of his parents

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: The staff of King's College Hospital treat patients involved in traffic accidents. programme.desc: Tim Medhurst and Hettie Jago head deep into Surrey, England's most wooded county, where Tim is hoping to make use of his coin expertise and Hettie is first to the jewellery section. In Mole Valley, Ashtead, Tim takes on a plaster bust and some salt-glazed Toby jugs and Hettie finds an Italian gilt box and a brass dancing figure

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: Richard is reunited with a flamboyant car from his time on the Grand Tour. A new apprentice joins the team and is put to work fixing a pre-war Sunbeam that's needed for a wedding and the Smallest Cog race team take part in an endurance race in Anglesey.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Clare Collier from Cambridge brings in a sweet reminder of her childhood, for the attention of clock restorer Steve Fletcher. The art deco chiming clock belonged to her great-grandmother. The mischievous old lady would leave secret sweets on the clock for Clare and her sister at bedtime. The clock has been silent for over 25 years, and the wooden casing is dull and dirty. Steve gives the mechanism a good soak and scrub up, then carefully reassembles all the workings, getting it ticking and chiming once again. Will gives the woodwork a spruce up and crafts a few wooden sweeties for the top, much to Clare's delight.
John McMuldroch from Merseyside is here to see bear repair duo Julie Tatchell and Amanda Middleditch, accompanied by his late mother's beloved teddy bear. John's mother Joan was a big part of his life, and the bear was very special to her. At the age of 65, the bear is now in dire need of the bear ladies' attention. His limbs are loose, his paws damaged and his growler no longer works. Amanda and Julie lovingly take him apart, remove the old stuffing, then cleverly reconstruct his paws and replace the growler so that he can greet John on his return.
Angela Hodge from Rochester brings a treasure trove of memories for silversmith and vintage camera enthusiast Brenton West. The 3D photo viewer was her mother's and was used to display wonderful 3D images of her wedding day in 1958. Sadly the glass screen is now cracked and many of the slides are damaged, rendering it inoperable. Angela lost her mother recently, and she would love to get a glimpse of her parents on their special day. Brenton goes to work restoring the vintage viewer using ingenious replacements for the battery power source and the tiny lightbulb that illuminates the magical images.

programme.title: Special Ops: To Catch a Criminal
programme.desc: The return of the documentary series that follows the investigations of specialist units within UK police forces created to crack the toughest of cases, from cyber heists, romance fraud and people trafficking to drug rings and murder. With access to some of Britain’s most talented detectives, the series explores the investigations, methods and evidence that has put some of the UK’s most dangerous criminals behind bars. Each episode features 'evidential police footage' as they take on criminals and hunt for clues to solve the cases. The series offers a first-hand experience of the work of the elite units on the front line while witnessing their bravery, skill and compassion amid tragedy and loss. The series also discovers how detectives operate in the interview room, how forensics bring a case into focus, and how expert CCTV and digital analysis create timelines and evidence to catch a criminal, and the impact these crimes have on the communities they serve. The suspicious demise of a woman at the cult-like Wiltshire retreat of a self-proclaimed 'healer' sparks a global investigation and a link to a death in Australia

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick visits Tintagel, Cornwall's most mythical place, which was an important trading port with Europe and the birthplace of perhaps Britain's greatest legend - the tale of King Arthur. He also learns how the Methodists were important to Cornwall, and how they would cook a rather unusual bun during feast days, and meets a family on the Roseland Peninsula who are continuing the surprisingly ancient tradition of growing an exotic spice - saffron

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick explores the rich and diverse history of West Penwith, the farthest point west in mainland Britain. He visits Lamorna Cove, made famous through song and art, and the Unesco-protected tin and copper mining area of Botallack, where he talks to a mining explorer. The chef also follows an ancient track in search of Cornwall's oldest building and reveals how, as a young lad on the Lizard Peninsula, he fell in love for the first time and tasted his first French fish stew - known as a bouillabaisse

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: As the chef's Cornish odyssey nears its end, he takes a break in the city of Truro, where he discovers an unusual ghost story and tours the magnificent cathedral. He also meets a family passionate about offal, who prepare Rick a meal of pickled ox tongue and beef heart tacos, and in the county's most northerly parish he tells the story of an eccentric vicar who would retrieve the bodies from nearby shipwrecks and bury them in his church graveyard

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: The chef champions the food, history, music, art and culture of the county, beginning by reflecting on his early days running a nightclub in Padstow. He goes for a bracing dip in Bude's sea pool, while in Sennen Cove off Land's End, Rick braves the notoriously wild Atlantic waters to learn about the ancient fishing method of handlining

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British
programme.desc: Si King and Dave Myers create classic puddings and explore the history and traditions behind Britain's favourite desserts. They also take part in the world black-pudding throwing competition in Lancashire

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: With Tim playing King Lear in Bristol, he and Prunella Scales tour the city and some West Country waterways further afield that include a trip to Devon.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Richard Hammond takes a look at the BMW 6 Series cabriolet, and Jeremy Clarkson explores whether the VW Golf GTI has gone back to its roots. There is an investigation to see if it is possible to purchase a Porsche for a snip, and Cliff Richard is the Star in a Reasonably Priced Car

programme.title: Speed with Guy Martin
programme.desc: The racing fan sets out to break the record for the world's fastest gravity-powered sled, taking expert advice from Winter Olympic gold medallist Amy Williams. Guy experiences his first taste of going blisteringly fast on ice at the famous Cresta Run in the Swiss ski resort of St Moritz, before a crack team of engineers helps him build a prototype toboggan. Then it's on to Andorra in the Pyrenees, where he hopes to steer himself into the record books on the new speed ski slope Pista Riberal

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: The DIY SOS team are out of their comfort zone this week, joining forces with two world-famous institutions - Great Ormond Street Hospital and the Chelsea Flower Show - for a special challenge. Gardener Chris Beardshaw has promised his gold medal-winning garden from the flower show to the hospital - now all Nick Knowles and his fellow builders have to do is crane the display across London and rebuild it on the hospital. programme.title: DIY SOS: Veteran Street

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance
programme.desc: The paramedics race to a lorry driver with a branch through his windscreen and a man with an irregular heartbeat, and help a family faced with a heart-breaking decision.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: In north-east London, crew members Niamh, Isobel and Gary are dispatched to a 25-year-old patient who has fallen while scaling the walls at a climbing centre. He needs urgent treatment to put the broken bones back in alignment, otherwise he might lose a foot. Rob and Nikita attend a 37-year-old female with Rett syndrome - a rare genetic disorder that impedes brain development. They are touched to hear the positive impact the ambulance service has had on the patient's life, as they discover the severity of unrelenting challenges that come with the life-limiting disability. Narrated by Christopher Eccleston

programme.title: The Body in the Bag
programme.desc: The case of Gareth Williams, a GCHQ employee on secondment to MI6, who was found dead inside a padlocked duffel bag in the bath of his London flat in 2010. The case has become one of the biggest unsolved mysteries in recent British history, and even now, 12 years after Williams' death, the public are still waiting for answers as to what happened to the 31-year-old codebreaker. Through interviews with former detectives, forensic investigators, MPs and people who knew Gareth, along with archive footage and reconstruction, this documentary re-examines the case in a bid to get to the bottom of the events that lead to Williams' untimely death - asking did he act alone or were other forces involved?

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Two British classics head into to the Mathewsons' auction room, Dave heads to North Manchester to pick up an Austin A30 and a Morris 8 E with an alternative paint job.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Austin Healeys are classic British vehicles that are difficult to tame. Paul and Charlie have the rare chance to pick up a trio of these iconic cars in varying conditions.

programme.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
programme.desc: Simon and Henry head to Wiltshire. Henry is feeling happy because they're going to an old WWII airfield. Simon decides to restore a 1970's caravan while Henry opts for a boat.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo heads for Farnborough, Hampshire, famous today for its airshow and home to what was then the Royal Aircraft Establishment. In Basingstoke he visits a glorious neo-Gothic stately home set in the North Wessex Downs

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels from London's Docklands to the Barbican, examining the story of the arrival at Tilbury in 1948 of the Empire Windrush, which brought more than a thousand passengers from the Caribbean to work in Britain. In Limehouse, Michael reflects on the Labour Party's landslide victory at the post-war general election of 1945 and hears what drove new prime minister Clement Attlee to strive for social change

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores East Anglia between the wars, beginning at Sutton Hoo in Suffolk, where archaeologists discovered a 27-metre-long Anglo-Saxon ship in 1939. In the Essex village of Dedham, he unearths a nasty brush between painters, with art experts explaining the antipathy between traditional artist Alfred Munnings and the modern art school established in the village by Cedric Morris

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits several of London's most famous locations, beginning on the South Bank, where the 1951 Festival of Britain drew more than eight and a half million visitors to admire fantastical buildings designed to inspire and celebrate the best of British in art, science and industry. After a spin on the London Eye, built to celebrate the millennium, Michael takes the London Underground to Chelsea to find out about Elizabeth David, one of the most influential cookery writers of the 20th century, and also heads to Covent Garden and Regent's Park

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: How the morale of the Third Reich, boosted by Germany's initial military successes, was shattered by the devastating defeat at Stalingrad, relentless Allied bombing raids and an attempt on Hitler's life. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: The history of the concentration camp, charting its origins as a place to hold political prisoners through its development into a mechanised factory for mass murder. The first episode features the accounts of Polish inmates held there prior to the Holocaust, Jewish survivors and a former SS officer, who discusses being placed in charge of a firing squad

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce and the team visit Battle Abbey in East Sussex, where items brought along include an incredibly rare Beatles guitar with an enviable history, which turns out to be one of the most valuable items ever seen on the show. Also featured are royal letters from Queen Victoria's children, a pawned diamond ring that saved a family from the poorhouse, a rare ninth-century gold coin and some valuable Chinese surprises.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents from the grounds of Salisbury Cathedral in Wiltshire, where the experts value decorative objects and rarities belonging to the public. An eclectic mix includes one of Napoleon's razors, letters from Enid Blyton and an item of Queen Victoria's underwear, as well as a hand-painted Christmas card from the Second World War and original drawings of comic-book character Judge Dredd

programme.title: The Real Des: The Dennis Nilsen Story
programme.desc: Following on from the three-part drama about the serial killer Dennis Nilsen, this documentary explores the personality of the man behind the crimes - on the surface a mild-mannered civil servant who admitted to murdering up to 15 young men over a four-year period in the late 1980s and early 1980s, disposing of their bodies in the garden and down the drain. The film includes footage of an interview Nilsen gave to ITV at Albany Prison in 1992, contributions from victims' families and insights from criminologist David Wilson, who corresponded with Nilsen over several decades. Narrated by David Tennant

programme.title: My Family Christmas Special 2008
programme.desc: Susan is outraged when Ben, ever the romantic, buys her a vacuum cleaner for Christmas, so in a desperate attempt to make amends, he gets her a necklace instead. However, when he discovers it for sale at half the price the following day, he is determined to return it and buy it again at the bargain rate - but the no-nonsense jeweller (guest star Julian Clary) is having none of it. To make matters worse, Susan turns up and the Harpers end up getting trapped in the department store overnight. Meanwhile, Janey, Michael and Alfie decide to give Susan and Ben a thoughtful present for a change, but despite their best efforts, it does not turn out quite as planned. Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker star in the festive special from 2008

programme.desc: Nick Knowles meets midwife and kidney patient Sascha, who has to undergo intense dialysis sessions for hours on end, five days a week. Determined to help, the DIY SOS team, bolstered by the local tradespeople and volunteers of Welwyn Garden City, renovate her home to include a dedicated dialysis room, offering her the chance of many more years with her family

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: The DIY SOS team are out of their comfort zone this week, joining forces with two world-famous institutions - Great Ormond Street Hospital and the Chelsea Flower Show - for a special challenge. Gardener Chris Beardshaw has promised his gold medal-winning garden from the flower show to the hospital - now all Nick Knowles and his fellow builders have to do is crane the display across London and rebuild it on the hospital. It's a hugely ambitious build, with tricky logistics and emotional volunteers. But knowing how much the garden will prove welcome respite for families, the team is determined not to fail

programme.title: DIY SOS: Veteran Street

programme.title: Gadar: Ek Prem Katha
programme.desc: A love story set against the backdrop of the 1947 Partition of India. It follows Tara Singh, a Sikh truck driver who rescues a Muslin girl, Sakina, from a crazed mob during communal riots. Later, as happily married parents they discover Sakina's father is still alive who was previously thought to have died in the riots. Sakina is invited to stay with her father, now the mayor of Lahore in Pakistan, upon reaching the city she learns of her father's plans - plans that include forcing Sakina to forget about her family and start life anew in Pakistan. Tara and Sakinas love endures despite the chaos of Partition and familial opposition. Indian Hindi-language romantic drama, starring Sunny Deol, Ameesha Patel and Amrish Puri
